--!strict
-- Viewer for a flowrpotdevs-model build. Generated places put Data and Mesh beside this script's
-- target in ReplicatedStorage.FlowrpotModel; this client script builds every part as an exact
-- mesh, plays the reveal (rest, open, hold, return) with the idle sway, and runs the dust.
--
-- EditableMesh has a strict client memory budget, so the parts build ONE AT A TIME: each finished
-- mesh becomes opaque DataModel content and its editable copy is destroyed. A part whose mesh
-- fails is drawn as a box of its size, and the Output names it.

local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FlowrpotModel")
local Data = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Data")) :: any
local Mesh = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Mesh")) :: any

local PAUSE = 2.5 -- seconds at rest between reveals
-- An empty texture draws each mote as a solid square, which matches the studs. The soft glow
-- texture it replaced could not be seen at 0.16 studs against a daylight sky (Anvilwing v4.3).
local MOTE = ""
local SPARK = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"

local model = Instance.new("Model")
model.Name = Data.name

local parts: { BasePart } = table.create(#Data.parts)
local exactCount, blockCount = 0, 0
local keepAlive = {}

local function buildExact(p): BasePart?
	local m = Mesh[p.id]
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local em = AssetService:CreateEditableMesh()
		if not em then
			error("CreateEditableMesh returned nil (client editable memory used up)")
		end
		local v, f = m.v, m.f
		-- unshared corners: every triangle gets its own vertices, so the normals are flat
		for k = 1, #f, 3 do
			local a = (f[k] - 1) * 3
			local b = (f[k + 1] - 1) * 3
			local c = (f[k + 2] - 1) * 3
			em:AddTriangle(
				em:AddVertex(Vector3.new(v[a + 1], v[a + 2], v[a + 3])),
				em:AddVertex(Vector3.new(v[b + 1], v[b + 2], v[b + 3])),
				em:AddVertex(Vector3.new(v[c + 1], v[c + 2], v[c + 3]))
			)
		end
		local content = Content.fromObject(em)
		local okOpaque, res, opaque = pcall(function()
			return AssetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync(content)
		end)
		local useOpaque = okOpaque and opaque ~= nil and res ~= nil and res.Name == "Success"
		local part = AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(if useOpaque then opaque else content, {
			CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box,
		})
		if useOpaque then
			em:Destroy()
		else
			table.insert(keepAlive, em)
		end
		return part
	end)
	if ok then
		exactCount += 1
		return result
	end
	warn(
		string.format(
			"[%s] exact mesh failed for %s %s, box stand-in: %s",
			Data.name,
			p.id,
			p.name,
			tostring(result)
		)
	)
	return nil
end

local function restCFrame(r): CFrame
	return CFrame.new(r[10], r[11], r[12], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7], r[8], r[9])
end

local rests: { CFrame } = table.create(#Data.parts)
local centres: { CFrame } = table.create(#Data.parts)
for i, p in Data.parts do
	local part = buildExact(p)
	if not part then
		blockCount += 1
		local box = Instance.new("Part")
		box.Size = Vector3.new(
			math.max(p.size[1], 0.05),
			math.max(p.size[2], 0.05),
			math.max(p.size[3], 0.05)
		)
		part = box
	end
	local bp = part :: BasePart
	bp.Name = p.id .. " " .. p.name
	bp.Anchored = true
	bp.CanCollide = false
	bp.CanQuery = false
	bp.CanTouch = false
	bp.CastShadow = true
	bp.Material = if p.material == "Neon" then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	bp.Color = Color3.fromHex(p.hex)
	bp.Transparency = 1 - p.opacity
	rests[i] = restCFrame(p.rest)
	centres[i] = CFrame.new(p.center[1], p.center[2], p.center[3])
	bp.CFrame = rests[i] * centres[i]
	bp.Parent = model
	parts[i] = bp
	if i % 8 == 0 then
		task.wait() -- keep the client responsive while the meshes build
	end
end
model.Parent = workspace
print(
	string.format(
		"[%s] %d exact meshes, %d box stand-ins, %d triangles, %d studs (%d editable kept)",
		Data.name,
		exactCount,
		blockCount,
		Data.triangles,
		Data.studs,
		#keepAlive
	)
)

-- Joints: a part turns with its parent's delta, then its own rotation about the pivot.
local jointOf: { [number]: any } = {}
for _, j in Data.joints do
	jointOf[j.index] = j
end

local function smooth(u: number): number
	u = math.clamp(u, 0, 1)
	return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end

local function angleAt(j, t: number, clock: number): number
	local w
	if t < j.start + j.ease then
		w = if j.ease > 0 then smooth((t - j.start) / j.ease) else (if t >= j.start then 1 else 0)
	elseif t < j.start + j.ease + j.hold then
		w = 1
	else
		w = 1 - (if j.ret > 0 then smooth((t - j.start - j.ease - j.hold) / j.ret) else 1)
	end
	local a = j.rest + (j.catch - j.rest) * w
	if j.idle ~= 0 and j.idlePeriod > 0 then
		a += j.idle * math.sin(2 * math.pi * clock / j.idlePeriod + math.rad(j.idlePhase))
	end
	return a
end

local deltas: { CFrame } = table.create(#Data.parts)
local cframes: { CFrame } = table.create(#Data.parts)
local function pose(t: number, clock: number)
	for i, p in Data.parts do
		local d = if p.parent > 0 then deltas[p.parent] else CFrame.identity
		local j = jointOf[i]
		if j then
			local deg = angleAt(j, t, clock)
			if deg ~= 0 then
				local piv = Vector3.new(j.pivot[1], j.pivot[2], j.pivot[3])
				local axis = Vector3.new(j.axis[1], j.axis[2], j.axis[3])
				d = d
					* CFrame.new(piv)
					* CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, math.rad(deg))
					* CFrame.new(-piv)
			end
		end
		deltas[i] = d
		cframes[i] = d * rests[i] * centres[i]
	end
	workspace:BulkMoveTo(parts, cframes, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
end

-- Dust: fine motes and a few four-point sparkles around the feet and flanks, a burst as the
-- reveal opens. Motes stay where they were emitted, so a moving model leaves a short trail.
type Dust = { emitter: ParticleEmitter, burst: number }
local dust: { Dust } = {}
if Data.dust then
	local D = Data.dust
	local fade = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.15),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	-- motes pop in, hold their size and shrink away
	local moteSize = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, D.moteSize * 0.4),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, D.moteSize),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, D.moteSize * 0.85),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	local twinkle = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, D.sparkleSize),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	for _, d in D.emitters do
		local sparkle = d.kind == "sparkle"
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a.Name = "Dust_" .. d.id
		a.Position = Vector3.new(d.offset[1], d.offset[2], d.offset[3])
		a.Parent = parts[d.index]
		local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		e.Name = "Dust_" .. d.id
		local c = if sparkle then D.sparkleColors else D.moteColors
		e.Texture = if sparkle then SPARK else MOTE
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromHex(c[1]), Color3.fromHex(c[2]))
		-- additive light vanishes against a bright sky, so motes keep their own colour
		e.LightEmission = if sparkle then 0.7 else 0.15
		e.LightInfluence = 0
		e.Size = if sparkle then twinkle else moteSize
		e.Transparency = fade
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(D.lifetime[1], D.lifetime[2])
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(D.speed[1], D.speed[2])
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(D.spread, D.spread)
		e.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, D.lift, 0)
		e.Drag = D.drag
		e.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		e.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-40, 40)
		e.Rate = d.rate
		e.LockedToPart = false
		e.Parent = a
		table.insert(dust, { emitter = e, burst = d.burst })
	end
end

local cycle = Data.revealEnd + PAUSE
local clock = 0
local lastT = -1
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt: number)
	clock += dt
	local t = if Data.revealEnd > 0 then clock % cycle else 0
	local wrapped = t < lastT
	if Data.dust and t >= Data.dust.burstAt and (lastT < Data.dust.burstAt or wrapped) then
		for _, d in dust do
			if d.burst > 0 then
				d.emitter:Emit(d.burst)
			end
		end
	end
	lastT = t
	pose(t, clock)
end)

-- core registry
local CoreRegistry = {}
local registered: {[string]: any} = {}
function CoreRegistry.Configure(core: {[string]: any})
    assert(type(core) == "table", "core registry expects a table")
    for name, module in pairs(core) do
        assert(type(name) == "string" and module ~= nil, "invalid core registration")
        registered[name] = module
    end
end
function CoreRegistry.Get(name: string) return registered[name] end
function CoreRegistry.Require(name: string)
    local module = registered[name]
    assert(module ~= nil, "VectorForge core module is not registered: " .. name)
    return module
end
function CoreRegistry.List()
    local names = {}
    for name in pairs(registered) do table.insert(names, name) end
    table.sort(names)
    return names
end
return CoreRegistry

--!strict
--!native
--!optimize 2

const Actor = script:GetActor()

const Tracks: { [Animator]: { [Animation]: AnimationTrack } } = {}

-- Speed of every track currently held at zero by a Time Stop. A track already
-- in the map is skipped by a later hold — the first one owns the restore.
const HeldSpeeds: { [AnimationTrack]: number } = {}

-- Hold every playing clip of `models` at speed zero, remembering each
-- track's speed. Tracks already held (Speed == 0) are skipped.
const function pauseModels(models: { Model })
	for _, character in models do
		if typeof(character) ~= "Instance" then continue end
		if not character:IsA("Model") then continue end

		const animator = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
		if not animator then continue end

		for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
			if HeldSpeeds[track] ~= nil then continue end
			if track.Speed == 0 then continue end
			HeldSpeeds[track] = track.Speed
			track:AdjustSpeed(0)
		end
	end
end

-- Hand the remembered speeds back to the still-alive tracks and forget the
-- rest.
const function resumeModels(models: { Model })
	for _, character in models do
		if typeof(character) ~= "Instance" then continue end
		if not character:IsA("Model") then continue end

		const animator = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
		if not animator then continue end

		for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
			const speed = HeldSpeeds[track]
			if speed == nil then continue end

			HeldSpeeds[track] = nil
			track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
		end
	end
end

Actor:BindToMessage("PauseAll", function(models: { Model }?)
	if type(models) ~= "table" then return end
	pauseModels(models)
end)

Actor:BindToMessage("ResumeAll", function(models: { Model }?)
	if type(models) ~= "table" then return end
	resumeModels(models)
end)

type AnimationsPlayProps = {
	Priority: Enum.AnimationPriority?,
	Speed: number?,
	FadeInTime: number?,
	Weight: number?,
	-- Looping is a property of the AnimationTrack, not of the Animation asset.
	Looped: boolean?,
}
Actor:BindToMessage(
	"Play",
	function(character: Model, animation: Animation, props: AnimationsPlayProps?)
		const animator = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
		if not animator then return end

		props = props
			or {
				Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action,
				Speed = 1,
				FadeInTime = 0,
				Weight = 1,
			}

		if not Tracks[animator] then
			Tracks[animator] = {}

			animator.Destroying:Once(function()
				Tracks[animator] = nil
			end)
		end

		const track = Tracks[animator][animation] or animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
		Tracks[animator][animation] = track
		track.Looped = props.Looped == true
		track:Play(props.FadeInTime, props.Weight, props.Speed)
	end
)

type AnimationsStopProps = {
	FadeOutTime: number?,
}
Actor:BindToMessage(
	"Stop",
	function(character: Model, animation: Animation, props: AnimationsStopProps?)
		const animator = character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator", true)
		if not animator then return end

		if not Tracks[animator] or not Tracks[animator][animation] then return end

		props = props or {
			FadeOutTime = 0,
		}

		Tracks[animator][animation]:Stop(props.FadeOutTime)
	end
)

-- SOFTWARE.

-- linear algebra
local LA = {}
function LA.Copy(A)
    local B = table.create(#A)
    for i,row in ipairs(A) do B[i] = table.clone(row) end
    return B
end
function LA.Transpose(A)
    local m,n = #A,#A[1]
    local T = table.create(n)
    for j=1,n do T[j]=table.create(m) end
    for i=1,m do for j=1,n do T[j][i]=A[i][j] end end
    return T
end
function LA.Multiply(A,B)
    assert(#A[1] == #B, "matrix dimensions do not conform")
    local C = table.create(#A)
    for i=1,#A do
        C[i]=table.create(#B[1],0)
        for k=1,#B do for j=1,#B[1] do C[i][j] += A[i][k]*B[k][j] end end
    end
    return C
end
function LA.Identity(n)
    local I=table.create(n)
    for i=1,n do I[i]=table.create(n,0); I[i][i]=1 end
    return I
end
function LA.Norm2(x)
    local s=0
    for i=1,#x do s += x[i]*x[i] end
    return math.sqrt(s)
end
return LA

-- numerical guards
local Guards = {}
function Guards.IsFinite(x: number): boolean return x == x and x ~= math.huge and x ~= -math.huge end
function Guards.AssertFiniteArray(x: {number}, label: string?)
    for i,v in ipairs(x) do assert(Guards.IsFinite(v), (label or "array") .. " invalid at " .. i) end
end
function Guards.Clamp(x: number, lo: number, hi: number): number
    assert(lo <= hi, "invalid clamp interval")
    return math.max(lo, math.min(hi,x))
end
function Guards.SafeDivide(a: number,b: number,epsilon: number?): number
    assert(math.abs(b) > (epsilon or 1e-12), "division by near-zero")
    return a/b
end
return Guards

-- Shared domain helpers; standard linear algebra is delegated to VectorForge Core
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local VectorForge = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForge")
local LA = require(VectorForge:WaitForChild("SpectralLinearAlgebra"))
local N = {}
function N.Positive(value,label)
    assert(type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>0 and value<math.huge,(label or "value").." must be positive and finite")
    return value
end
function N.Nonnegative(value,label)
    assert(type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=0 and value<math.huge,(label or "value").." must be nonnegative and finite")
    return value
end
function N.Add(a,b)
    assert(#a==#b,"array dimensions mismatch")
    if type(a[1])=="number" then local out=table.create(#a); for i=1,#a do out[i]=a[i]+b[i] end; return out end
    return LA.Add(a,b)
end
function N.Subtract(a,b)
    assert(#a==#b,"array dimensions mismatch")
    if type(a[1])=="number" then local out=table.create(#a); for i=1,#a do out[i]=a[i]-b[i] end; return out end
    return LA.Subtract(a,b)
end
function N.Scale(a,s)
    if type(a[1])=="number" then local out=table.create(#a); for i=1,#a do out[i]=a[i]*s end; return out end
    return LA.Scale(a,s)
end
function N.Cross3(a,b)
    assert(#a==3 and #b==3,"cross product requires 3-vectors")
    return {a[2]*b[3]-a[3]*b[2],a[3]*b[1]-a[1]*b[3],a[1]*b[2]-a[2]*b[1]}
end
function N.Det3(a)
    assert(#a==3 and #a[1]==3 and #a[2]==3 and #a[3]==3,"expected 3x3 matrix")
    return a[1][1]*(a[2][2]*a[3][3]-a[2][3]*a[3][2])-a[1][2]*(a[2][1]*a[3][3]-a[2][3]*a[3][1])+a[1][3]*(a[2][1]*a[3][2]-a[2][2]*a[3][1])
end
function N.Factorial(n)
    assert(n>=0 and n%1==0 and n<=170,"factorial argument out of range")
    local value=1; for i=2,n do value*=i end; return value
end
function N.Binomial(n,k)
    assert(n>=0 and k>=0 and k<=n and n%1==0 and k%1==0,"invalid binomial arguments")
    return N.Factorial(n)/(N.Factorial(k)*N.Factorial(n-k))
end
function N.ComplexAdd(a,b) return {Re=a.Re+b.Re,Im=a.Im+b.Im} end
function N.ComplexMul(a,b) return {Re=a.Re*b.Re-a.Im*b.Im,Im=a.Re*b.Im+a.Im*b.Re} end
function N.ComplexScale(a,s) return {Re=a.Re*s,Im=a.Im*s} end
function N.ComplexExp(theta) return {Re=math.cos(theta),Im=math.sin(theta)} end
function N.ComplexAbs2(a) return a.Re*a.Re+a.Im*a.Im end
function N.RK4(f,x,t,h)
    local k1=f(x,t); local k2=f(N.Add(x,N.Scale(k1,h/2)),t+h/2)
    local k3=f(N.Add(x,N.Scale(k2,h/2)),t+h/2); local k4=f(N.Add(x,N.Scale(k3,h)),t+h)
    local weighted=N.Add(N.Add(k1,N.Scale(k2,2)),N.Add(N.Scale(k3,2),k4))
    return N.Add(x,N.Scale(weighted,h/6))
end
function N.StumpffC(z)
    if math.abs(z)<1e-7 then return 0.5-z/24+z*z/720-z*z*z/40320 end
    if z>0 then local q=math.sqrt(z); return (1-math.cos(q))/z end
    local q=math.sqrt(-z); return (math.cosh(q)-1)/(-z)
end
function N.StumpffS(z)
    if math.abs(z)<1e-7 then return 1/6-z/120+z*z/5040-z*z*z/362880 end
    if z>0 then local q=math.sqrt(z); return (q-math.sin(q))/(q*q*q) end
    local q=math.sqrt(-z); return (math.sinh(q)-q)/(q*q*q)
end
function N.TensorLinearIndex(indices,shape)
    assert(#indices==#shape,"tensor index rank mismatch"); local linear,stride=1,1
    for axis=#shape,1,-1 do local index=indices[axis]; assert(index>=1 and index<=shape[axis] and index%1==0,"tensor index out of bounds"); linear+=(index-1)*stride; stride*=shape[axis] end
    return linear
end
function N.TensorMultiIndex(linear,shape)
    local total=1; for _,size in ipairs(shape) do N.Positive(size,"tensor dimension"); total*=size end
    assert(linear>=1 and linear<=total and linear%1==0,"linear index out of bounds")
    local rest=linear-1; local indices=table.create(#shape)
    for axis=#shape,1,-1 do indices[axis]=(rest%shape[axis])+1; rest=math.floor(rest/shape[axis]) end
    return indices
end
function N.TridiagonalSolve(lower,diagonal,upper,rhs)
    local n=#diagonal; assert(#rhs==n and #lower==n-1 and #upper==n-1,"tridiagonal dimensions mismatch")
    local c=table.clone(upper); local d=table.clone(rhs); local b=table.clone(diagonal)
    for i=2,n do local m=lower[i-1]/b[i-1]; b[i]-=m*c[i-1]; d[i]-=m*d[i-1] end
    local x=table.create(n); x[n]=d[n]/b[n]
    for i=n-1,1,-1 do x[i]=(d[i]-c[i]*x[i+1])/b[i] end
    return x
end
function N.ChebyshevGrid(n)
    assert(n>=2 and n%1==0,"Chebyshev order must be >= 2")
    local x=table.create(n+1); for j=0,n do x[j+1]=math.cos(math.pi*j/n) end; return x
end
function N.InverseNormalCDF(p)
    assert(p>0 and p<1,"probability must be strictly between zero and one")
    local a={-39.6968302866538,220.946098424521,-275.928510446969,138.357751867269,-30.6647980661472,2.50662827745924}
    local b={-54.4760987982241,161.585836858041,-155.698979859887,66.8013118877197,-13.2806815528857}
    local c={-0.00778489400243029,-0.322396458041136,-2.40075827716184,-2.54973253934373,4.37466414146497,2.93816398269878}
    local d={0.00778469570904146,0.32246712907004,2.445134137143,3.75440866190742}
    local plow=0.02425; local q,r
    if p<plow then q=math.sqrt(-2*math.log(p)); return (((((c[1]*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5])*q+c[6])/((((d[1]*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+d[4])*q+1) end
    if p>1-plow then q=math.sqrt(-2*math.log(1-p)); return -(((((c[1]*q+c[2])*q+c[3])*q+c[4])*q+c[5])*q+c[6])/((((d[1]*q+d[2])*q+d[3])*q+d[4])*q+1) end
    q=p-0.5; r=q*q
    return (((((a[1]*r+a[2])*r+a[3])*r+a[4])*r+a[5])*r+a[6])*q/(((((b[1]*r+b[2])*r+b[3])*r+b[4])*r+b[5])*r+1)
end


function N.FFTComplexRadix2(samples)
    local n=#samples
    assert(n>=1 and bit32.band(n,n-1)==0,"complex radix-2 FFT length must be a power of two")
    local out=table.create(n)
    for i=1,n do
        assert(type(samples[i].Re)=="number" and type(samples[i].Im)=="number","complex sample requires Re and Im")
        out[i]={Re=samples[i].Re,Im=samples[i].Im}
    end
    local j=0
    for i=0,n-2 do
        if i<j then out[i+1],out[j+1]=out[j+1],out[i+1] end
        local bit=math.floor(n/2)
        while bit32.band(j,bit)~=0 do j-=bit; bit=math.floor(bit/2) end
        j+=bit
    end
    local length=2
    while length<=n do
        local root=N.ComplexExp(-2*math.pi/length)
        for start=1,n,length do
            local w={Re=1,Im=0}
            for offset=0,length/2-1 do
                local even=out[start+offset]
                local odd=N.ComplexMul(w,out[start+offset+length/2])
                out[start+offset]=N.ComplexAdd(even,odd)
                out[start+offset+length/2]={Re=even.Re-odd.Re,Im=even.Im-odd.Im}
                w=N.ComplexMul(w,root)
            end
        end
        length*=2
    end
    return out
end

return N

const Children = Fusion.Children

export type Handle = {
	Stunned: Fusion.Value<boolean>,
	Destroy: () -> (),
}

return function(character: Model): Handle
	const scope = Fusion.scoped(Fusion)
	const cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()

	const humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	const head = character:WaitForChild("Head") :: BasePart

	const player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	--- Above own head the bar and the nickname only get in the way of the camera,
	--- so the local player sees just the stun label.
	const isLocal = character == LocalPlayer.Character

	const Health = scope:Value(1)
	const Stunned = scope:Value(false)

	const UpdateHealth = function()
		const ratio = humanoid.Health / math.max(humanoid.MaxHealth, 1)
		Health:set(math.clamp(ratio, 0, 1))
	end

	UpdateHealth()
	cleaner:Connect(humanoid.HealthChanged, UpdateHealth)
	cleaner:Connect(humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"), UpdateHealth)

	scope:New("BillboardGui")({
		Name = "HeadInfo",
		Active = true,
		AlwaysOnTop = true,
		MaxDistance = 50,
		Parent = head,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(4, 2),
		StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0),
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,

		[Children] = {
			scope:New("Frame")({
				Name = "Main",
				Active = true,
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),

				[Children] = {
					scope:New("CanvasGroup")({

-- simulation clock
local Clock = {}
Clock.__index = Clock
function Clock.new(step: number)
    assert(step > 0, "fixed step must be positive")
    return setmetatable({Step=step, Time=0, Frame=0, Accumulator=0}, Clock)
end
function Clock:Advance(delta: number, maxSubsteps: number?)
    assert(delta >= 0, "delta must be nonnegative")
    self.Accumulator += delta
    local count, limit = 0, maxSubsteps or 16
    while self.Accumulator >= self.Step and count < limit do
        self.Accumulator -= self.Step
        self.Time += self.Step
        self.Frame += 1
        count += 1
    end
    return count, self.Accumulator
end
return Clock

	if not self.instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end

	self.View = View(self.instance)

end

-- SOFTWARE.

local BenchmarkUtils = {}

local function median(values)
    local sorted = table.clone(values)
    table.sort(sorted)
    local n = #sorted
    if n == 0 then return nil end
    if n % 2 == 1 then return sorted[(n + 1) / 2] end
    return (sorted[n / 2] + sorted[n / 2 + 1]) / 2
end

function BenchmarkUtils.Measure(name, callback, options)
    options = options or {}
    local warmups = options.WarmupRuns or 2
    local runs = options.MeasuredRuns or 7
    local iterations = options.Iterations or 1

    assert(type(name) == "string")
    assert(type(callback) == "function")
    assert(warmups >= 0 and runs >= 1 and iterations >= 1)

    for _ = 1, warmups do
        for _ = 1, iterations do callback() end
    end

    local samples = {}
    local total = 0
    local minimum = math.huge
    local maximum = 0

    for index = 1, runs do
        local started = os.clock()
        for _ = 1, iterations do callback() end
        local elapsed = os.clock() - started
        samples[index] = elapsed
        total += elapsed
        minimum = math.min(minimum, elapsed)
        maximum = math.max(maximum, elapsed)
    end

    local result = {
        Name = name,
        WarmupRuns = warmups,
        MeasuredRuns = runs,
        IterationsPerRun = iterations,
        SamplesSeconds = samples,
        MeanSeconds = total / runs,
        MedianSeconds = median(samples),
        MinSeconds = minimum,
        MaxSeconds = maximum,
        MeanMillisecondsPerIteration = total / runs / iterations * 1000,
    }

    print(string.format(
        "[VectorForge Benchmark] %s | median %.6f s | mean %.6f ms/iteration",
        name, result.MedianSeconds, result.MeanMillisecondsPerIteration
    ))
    return result
end

function BenchmarkUtils.PrintEnvironment(metadata)
    metadata = metadata or {}
    print("[VectorForge Benchmark] PlaceVersion:", game.PlaceVersion)
    print("[VectorForge Benchmark] JobId:", game.JobId)
    print("[VectorForge Benchmark] Platform:", tostring(metadata.Platform or "Not recorded"))
    print("[VectorForge Benchmark] StudioVersion:", tostring(metadata.StudioVersion or "Not recorded"))
    print("[VectorForge Benchmark] Commit:", tostring(metadata.Commit or "Not recorded"))
end

return BenchmarkUtils

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const GameData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.GameData)

const Player = Crane:CreateComponent({
	Name = "Player",
} :: Crane.ComponentDef<Player>)

type PlayerModuleHost = {
	GetModule: (self: PlayerModuleHost, name: string) -> ClientPlayerModule?,
}

export type ClientPlayerModule = {
	Name: string,
	player: PlayerModuleHost,
	playerProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>,
	gameProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<GameData.GameData>,
	Cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new()),
	onInit: ((self: ClientPlayerModule) -> ())?,
	onStart: ((self: ClientPlayerModule) -> ())?,
	onCharacter: ((self: ClientPlayerModule, character: Model) -> ())?,
	onDestroy: ((self: ClientPlayerModule) -> ())?,
}

function Player.onStart(self: typeof(Player))
	self.Modules = {}
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	self.CharacterModel = nil
	self.ModulesReady = false

	self.Cleaner:Connect(self.instance.CharacterAdded, function(character: Model)
		self:AttachCharacter(character)
	end)

	if self.instance.Character then self:AttachCharacter(self.instance.Character) end
end

function Player:AttachCharacter(character: Model)
	if self.Character then self.Character:Destroy() end

	self.Character = Crane:AddComponent(character, "Character")
	self:OnCharacter(character)
end

function Player:OnCharacter(character: Model)
	self.CharacterModel = character

	if not self.ModulesReady then return end

	for name, module in self.Modules do
		const callback = module.onCharacter
		if not callback then continue end

		const ok, err = pcall(callback, module, character)
		if not ok then warn(`[Player] onCharacter failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
	end
end

function Player.GetModule(self: typeof(Player), name: string): ClientPlayerModule?
	return self.Modules[name]
end

function Player.InitModules(
	self: typeof(Player),
	playerProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>,
	gameProxy: Proxy.ProxyTab<GameData.GameData>
)
	const folder = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client["player-modules"]
	if not folder then
		warn("[Player] player-modules folder is missing")
		return
	end

	for _, instance in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if not instance:IsA("ModuleScript") then continue end

		const content = Crane.Utils.DeepClone(require(instance)) :: ClientPlayerModule
		content.Name = instance.Name
		content.player = self
		content.playerProxy = playerProxy
		content.gameProxy = gameProxy
		content.Cleaner = self.Cleaner:Scope()
		self.Modules[content.Name] = content
	end

	for name, module in self.Modules do
		if not module.onInit then continue end

		const ok, err = pcall(module.onInit, module)
		if not ok then warn(`[Player] onInit failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
	end

	for name, module in self.Modules do
		if not module.onStart then continue end

		const ok, err = pcall(module.onStart, module)
		if not ok then warn(`[Player] onStart failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
	end

	self.ModulesReady = true

	if self.CharacterModel then self:OnCharacter(self.CharacterModel) end
end

function Player.Destroy(self: typeof(Player))
	if self.Modules then
		for name, module in self.Modules do
			if module.onDestroy then
				const ok, err = pcall(module.onDestroy, module)
				if not ok then warn(`[Player] onDestroy failed in module "{name}": {err}`) end
			end

			module.Cleaner:Destroy()
		end
	end

	if self.Cleaner then self.Cleaner:Destroy() end
end

return Player

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)

const JoystickBinds = require(script.Parent.Parent.controls.JoystickBinds)

const HOLD_SEND_INTERVAL = 0.08
const STOP_REPEATS = 4
const STOP_REPEAT_INTERVAL = 0.05
const MAX_AIM_DISTANCE = 120

const SLOT_RANK = { Spec = 1, SubSpec = 2 }

type Slot = "Spec" | "SubSpec"
type Bind = Enum.KeyCode | Enum.UserInputType

type SkillRef = {
	Slot: Slot,
	SkillId: string,
}

type Candidate = SkillRef & {
	Bind: Bind,
}

type PendingStop = {
	Left: number,
	NextAt: number,
}

-- The engine has KeyCode.Unknown; the analyzer does not.
const UNKNOWN_BIND: Bind = (Enum.KeyCode :: any).Unknown

const BindService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "BindService",
})
BindService.Binds = {} :: { [Bind]: { Candidate } }
BindService.Held = {} :: { [string]: SkillRef }
BindService.StopQueue = {} :: { [string]: PendingStop }
BindService.SkillActivated = Crane.Signal()
BindService.Rebinding = false

function BindService.GetSkillData(self: typeof(BindService), ref: SkillRef)
	const skills = self.playerProxy().Skills
	const slotSkills = skills and skills[ref.Slot]
	return slotSkills and slotSkills[ref.SkillId]
end

function BindService.RebuildBinds(self: typeof(BindService))
	const all: { Candidate } = {}
	const parts: { string } = {}

	for slot, _rank in SLOT_RANK do
		const slotName = slot :: Slot
		const skills = self.playerProxy().Skills
		const slotSkills = skills and skills[slotName]
		if not slotSkills then continue end

		for skillId, data in slotSkills do
			const bind = data and data.Parameters and data.Parameters.Bind
			-- Unknown is also what a mouse click reports; never bind it.
			if bind == nil or bind == UNKNOWN_BIND then continue end

			table.insert(all, { Bind = bind :: Bind, Slot = slotName, SkillId = skillId })
			table.insert(parts, `{slotName}:{skillId}:{tostring(bind)}`)
		end
	end

	table.sort(all, function(a, b)
		if SLOT_RANK[a.Slot] ~= SLOT_RANK[b.Slot] then
			return SLOT_RANK[a.Slot] < SLOT_RANK[b.Slot]
		end
		return a.SkillId < b.SkillId
	end)
	table.sort(parts)

	const signature = table.concat(parts, "|")
	if signature ~= self.BindSignature then
		table.clear(self.Held)
		table.clear(self.StopQueue)
		self.BindSignature = signature
	end

	table.clear(self.Binds)
	for _, candidate in all do
		const list = self.Binds[candidate.Bind]
		if list then
			table.insert(list, candidate)
		else
			self.Binds[candidate.Bind] = { candidate }
		end
	end
end

function BindService.InputKey(_self: typeof(BindService), input: InputObject): string
	-- Keep the InputObject: a remapped EnumItem has no KeyCode.
	const remapped = JoystickBinds[input.KeyCode]
	return tostring(input.KeyCode)
		.. "|"
		.. tostring(input.UserInputType)
		.. "|"
		.. tostring(remapped)
end

function BindService.Resolve(
	self: typeof(BindService),
	input: InputObject,
	remapped: Bind?
): { Candidate }?
	if remapped then
		const found = self.Binds[remapped]
		if found then return found end
	end

	return self.Binds[input.KeyCode] or self.Binds[input.UserInputType]
end

function BindService.CanStart(self: typeof(BindService), candidate: Candidate): boolean
	const data = self:GetSkillData(candidate)
	const parameters = data and data.Parameters
	if not parameters or not parameters.Enabled then return false end
	if parameters.ReleaseTime > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return false end

	return self.clientSkills:CanStart(candidate.SkillId)
end

function BindService.Pick(self: typeof(BindService), candidates: { Candidate }): Candidate?
	for _, candidate in candidates do
		if self:CanStart(candidate) then return candidate end
	end

	return candidates[1]
end

function BindService.IsRepeatable(self: typeof(BindService), ref: SkillRef): boolean
	const data = self:GetSkillData(ref)
	const parameters = data and data.Parameters
	return parameters ~= nil and parameters.Toggle ~= true
end

function BindService.AimPointFor(self: typeof(BindService), ref: SkillRef): Vector3?
	const data = self:GetSkillData(ref)
	const parameters = data and data.Parameters
	if not parameters or not parameters.AimRequired then return nil end

	const character = LocalPlayer.Character
	const root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end

	const farPoint = root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector * MAX_AIM_DISTANCE
	const lockService = Crane:GetService("TargetLockService") :: any
	const shiftLocked = (lockService and lockService.Locked == true)
		or UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	if shiftLocked then return farPoint end

	const hit = Mouse.Hit
	if not hit then return farPoint end

	const delta = hit.Position - root.Position
	if delta.Magnitude > MAX_AIM_DISTANCE then
		return root.Position + delta.Unit * MAX_AIM_DISTANCE
	end
	return hit.Position
end

function BindService.SendStart(self: typeof(BindService), candidate: Candidate, key: string)
	self.clientSkills:Activate(candidate.SkillId)
	self.SkillActivated:Fire(candidate.Slot, candidate.SkillId)
	Crane:GetPacket("StartSkill").send({
		Id = candidate.SkillId,
		AimPoint = self:AimPointFor(candidate),
	})

	self.StopQueue[candidate.SkillId] = nil
	self.Held[key] = { Slot = candidate.Slot, SkillId = candidate.SkillId }
end

function BindService.onStart(self: typeof(BindService))
	self.playerProxy =
		Crane:GetService("PlayerService").Proxy :: Proxy.ProxyTab<PlayerData.PlayerData>
	self.clientSkills = Crane:GetService("ClientSkillService")
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Janitor.new()
	self.BindSignature = ""
	self.NextHoldSendAt = 0
	self.RoundRobin = 0

	self.Cleaner:Add(self.playerProxy:Subscribe("AnyChange", { "Skills" }, function()
		self:RebuildBinds()
	end))
	self:RebuildBinds()

	self.Cleaner:Add(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		table.clear(self.Held)
		table.clear(self.StopQueue)
	end))

	self.Cleaner:Add(UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if gameProcessed or self.Rebinding then return end

		const key = self:InputKey(input)
		if self.Held[key] then return end

		const remapped = JoystickBinds[input.KeyCode]
		const candidates = self:Resolve(input, remapped)
		if not candidates then return end

		const chosen = self:Pick(candidates)
		if not chosen then return end

		self:SendStart(chosen, key)
	end))

	self.Cleaner:Add(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		const key = self:InputKey(input)
		const held = self.Held[key]
		if not held then return end
		self.Held[key] = nil

		self.clientSkills:Stop(held.SkillId)
		self.StopQueue[held.SkillId] = {
			Left = STOP_REPEATS,
			NextAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
		}
	end))

	self.Cleaner:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		const now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

		if now >= self.NextHoldSendAt then
			self.NextHoldSendAt = now + HOLD_SEND_INTERVAL

			const keys: { string } = {}
			for key, held in self.Held do
				if not self:IsRepeatable(held) then continue end
				if self.clientSkills:IsBusy(held.SkillId) then continue end
				table.insert(keys, key)
			end

			if #keys > 0 then
				self.RoundRobin = self.RoundRobin % #keys
				const key = keys[self.RoundRobin + 1]
				self.RoundRobin += 1

				const held = self.Held[key]
				if not self.clientSkills:IsActive(held.SkillId) then
					self.clientSkills:Activate(held.SkillId)
				end

				Crane:GetPacket("StartSkill").send({
					Id = held.SkillId,
					AimPoint = self:AimPointFor(held),
				})
			end
		end

		for skillId, pending in self.StopQueue do
			if now < pending.NextAt then continue end

			pending.NextAt = now + STOP_REPEAT_INTERVAL
			pending.Left -= 1
			if pending.Left <= 0 then self.StopQueue[skillId] = nil end

			Crane:GetPacket("StopSkill").send(skillId)
		end
	end))
end

return BindService

-- computational-geometry implementation for CurveSampling
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.

local Module = {}
function Module.Uniform(count,minimum,maximum)
    assert(count>=2 and maximum>minimum,"invalid curve sampling range"); local samples=table.create(count)
    for i=1,count do samples[i]=minimum+(maximum-minimum)*(i-1)/(count-1) end; return samples
end

return Module

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Bridge = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Bridge)
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)

--[[
	Client half of the Crane Bridge.

	Publishes ReplicatedStorage.Bridge, a Request/Response BindableEvent pair an
	agent can address directly from the client DataModel.

	The server never connects to this pair. The container replicates upward, but a
	BindableEvent signal only ever fires on the side that owns the connection, so
	nothing here is reachable from the other side of the boundary.

	Inert outside a Studio playtest. Nothing is created and nothing is stored on
	the service, so there is no callable surface to reach for either.
]]

const BridgeService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "BridgeService",
	LoadOrder = 1000,
})

function BridgeService:onInit()
	if not RunService:IsStudio() then return end

	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	self.Container = Bridge.CreateContainer(ReplicatedStorage, "Bridge")

	self.Cleaner:Add(self.Container.Folder)
	self.Cleaner:Connect(self.Container.Request.Event, function(payload)
		Bridge.Dispatch(payload, self.Container.Response)
	end)
end

return BridgeService

--!native
--!optimize 2

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const SkillsFolder = script.Parent.Parent.skills

--[=[ ClientSkillService

   A local-only skill layer that runs alongside the authoritative server
   skills. BindService still forwards every press/release to the server; this
   service adds immediate client-side prediction (movement, camera, UI) so the
   game feels responsive before replication lands.

   Improvements over the legacy tool-coupled system:
   * Skills are auto-discovered from `client/skills` — no manual registry.
   * Every activation owns a fresh Buttler cleaner, so a skill's state and
     connections can never leak across activations or respawns.
   * A single-activation guard plus an optional `Toggle` mode cover both
     hold-to-cast and press-to-flip skills with one contract.
   * `CanActivate` gates prediction on the replicated CharacterState, and the
     context hands the skill a `Deactivate` callback so it can resync itself
     when the server disagrees (interrupt, restraint, respawn).
   * The replicated `CastingSkill` locks out every client skill while the
     server is casting a different one, including the hold re-send path.

   Contract (each module returns):
     Id: string                      -- matches the server skill id / bind
     Toggle: boolean?                -- press flips state; release is ignored
     CanActivate: (self, ctx) -> boolean?
     Activate: (self, ctx) -> ()     -- ctx.Cleaner owns this activation
     Stop: (self, ctx) -> ()?
]=]

export type ClientSkillContext = {
	Cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new()),
	Character: Model,
	Humanoid: Humanoid,
	CharacterState: any,
	Deactivate: () -> (),
}

export type ClientSkill = {
	Id: string,
	Toggle: boolean?,
	-- One-shot skills (dash, jumps) must not be cut short by InputEnded: the
	-- skill owns its own lifetime through ctx.Deactivate().
	IgnoreRelease: boolean?,
	CanActivate: ((self: ClientSkill, ctx: ClientSkillContext) -> boolean)?,
	Activate: (self: ClientSkill, ctx: ClientSkillContext) -> (),
	Stop: ((self: ClientSkill, ctx: ClientSkillContext) -> ())?,
}

type SkillEntry = {
	Module: ClientSkill,
	Active: boolean,
	Cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new())?,
}

const ClientSkillService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "ClientSkillService",
	LoadOrder = 1,
})

function ClientSkillService.onStart(self: typeof(ClientSkillService))
	self.Skills = {} :: { [string]: SkillEntry }
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	-- Reused by CanStart so the per-frame input checks never allocate.
	self.CheckCleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()

	for _, module in SkillsFolder:GetDescendants() do
		if not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then continue end

		const skill = require(module) :: ClientSkill
		const id = skill.Id or module.Name
		self.Skills[id] = { Module = skill, Active = false, Cleaner = nil }
	end

	self.Cleaner:Add(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		self:ResetAll()
	end))
end

-- Build the per-activation context. Returns nil when there is no living
-- character to act on, which is what keeps prediction off dead/absent rigs.
function ClientSkillService.MakeContext(
	self: typeof(ClientSkillService),
	skillId: string,
	cleaner: typeof(Crane.Buttler.new())
): ClientSkillContext?
	const character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then return nil end

	const humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return nil end

	const source = Crane:GetService("PlayerService").Proxy()
	const characterState = source and source.CharacterState

	return {
		Cleaner = cleaner,
		Character = character,
		Humanoid = humanoid,
		CharacterState = characterState,
		Deactivate = function()
			self:Deactivate(skillId)
		end,
	}
end

--- `CastingSkill` is the id of the skill holding the server's global
--- single-cast lock. Comparing it with the candidate id means a skill can keep
--- predicting itself while every other client skill stays locked out.
local function isBusyCasting(parameters: { CastingSkill: string }?, skillId: string): boolean
	if not parameters then return false end

	const activeSkill = parameters.CastingSkill
	return activeSkill ~= nil and activeSkill ~= "" and activeSkill ~= skillId
end

--- Side-effect-free check used by BindService before it sends a StartSkill
--- packet. Skills with a client module use their own `CanActivate` gate; the
--- rest fall back to the replicated CharacterState, which is also what keeps
--- the check honest for skills that have no local prediction at all.
function ClientSkillService.CanStart(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const source = Crane:GetService("PlayerService").Proxy()
	const state = source and source.CharacterState
	const parameters = state and state.Parameters
	if not state or not parameters then return false end
	if isBusyCasting(parameters, skillId) then return false end

	const now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if parameters.Ragdoll or parameters.Restrain then return false end
	if parameters.Stun and parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > now then return false end

	const character = LocalPlayer.Character
	const humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end

	-- A restanding body is still physically down after the authoritative state
	-- cleared. Block local prediction until the humanoid actually stands up.
	if humanoid.PlatformStand or humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding then
		return false
	end

	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry then return true end
	if entry.Active then return false end

	const module = entry.Module
	if not module.CanActivate then return true end

	const ctx = self:MakeContext(skillId, self.CheckCleaner)
	if not ctx then return false end

	return module.CanActivate(module, ctx) ~= false
end

--- Whether a *different* skill currently owns the server's cast lock. Used by
--- BindService to pause hold re-sends until the cast finishes.
function ClientSkillService.IsBusy(_self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const source = Crane:GetService("PlayerService").Proxy()
	const state = source and source.CharacterState
	return isBusyCasting(state and state.Parameters, skillId)
end

function ClientSkillService.Activate(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry then return false end

	const module = entry.Module

	-- Press-to-flip: a second press while active turns the skill back off.
	if module.Toggle and entry.Active then
		self:Deactivate(skillId)
		return true
	end

	-- Hold-to-cast: ignore repeats while already active.
	if entry.Active then return true end

	-- BindService's hold loop calls Activate directly and never passes through
	-- CanStart, so the busy gate must be enforced here for every client skill.
	if self:IsBusy(skillId) then return false end

	const cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()
	const ctx = self:MakeContext(skillId, cleaner)
	if not ctx then
		cleaner:Destroy()
		return false
	end

	if module.CanActivate and not module.CanActivate(module, ctx) then
		cleaner:Destroy()
		return false
	end

	entry.Active = true
	entry.Cleaner = cleaner
	module.Activate(module, ctx)
	return true
end

function ClientSkillService.Stop(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry then return false end

	-- Toggle and one-shot skills both ignore key release: the latter ends
	-- itself through ctx.Deactivate() when its movement is actually finished.
	if entry.Module.Toggle or entry.Module.IgnoreRelease then return true end

	self:Deactivate(skillId)
	return true
end

function ClientSkillService.Deactivate(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string)
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	if not entry or not entry.Active then return end

	-- Clear the flag first so a resync callback fired during cleanup cannot
	-- re-enter this path.
	entry.Active = false

	const cleaner = entry.Cleaner
	const ctx = cleaner and self:MakeContext(skillId, cleaner)
	if entry.Module.Stop and ctx then entry.Module.Stop(entry.Module, ctx) end

	entry.Cleaner = nil
	if cleaner then cleaner:Destroy() end
end

function ClientSkillService.ResetAll(self: typeof(ClientSkillService))
	for skillId in self.Skills do
		self:Deactivate(skillId)
	end
end

function ClientSkillService.IsActive(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	return entry ~= nil and entry.Active
end

--- Press-to-flip skills must not be auto-repeated while the key is down: every
--- packet would flip the server-side state again.
function ClientSkillService.IsToggle(self: typeof(ClientSkillService), skillId: string): boolean
	const entry = self.Skills[skillId]
	return entry ~= nil and entry.Module.Toggle == true
end

function ClientSkillService.Destroy(self: typeof(ClientSkillService))
	self:ResetAll()
	self.Cleaner:Destroy()
	self.CheckCleaner:Destroy()
end

return ClientSkillService

-- computational-geometry implementation for AABBTree
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.

local Module = {}
function Module.Build(items,leafSize)
    assert(#items>0,"AABB tree requires at least one item"); local limit=leafSize or 4
    local function build(indices)
        local minimum={math.huge,math.huge,math.huge}; local maximum={-math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge}
        for _,index in ipairs(indices) do for axis=1,3 do minimum[axis]=math.min(minimum[axis],items[index].Min[axis]); maximum[axis]=math.max(maximum[axis],items[index].Max[axis]) end end
        local node={Min=minimum,Max=maximum}
        if #indices<=limit then node.Indices=indices; return node end
        local axis=1; if maximum[2]-minimum[2]>maximum[axis]-minimum[axis] then axis=2 end; if maximum[3]-minimum[3]>maximum[axis]-minimum[axis] then axis=3 end
        table.sort(indices,function(a,b) return (items[a].Min[axis]+items[a].Max[axis])<(items[b].Min[axis]+items[b].Max[axis]) end)
        local middle=math.floor(#indices/2); local left,right={},{}
        for i=1,middle do left[i]=indices[i] end; for i=middle+1,#indices do right[#right+1]=indices[i] end
        node.Left=build(left); node.Right=build(right); return node
    end
    local indices=table.create(#items); for i=1,#items do indices[i]=i end
    local root=build(indices); root.Items=items; return root
end
function Module.QueryPoint(tree,point)
    local hits={}; local function contains(node)
        for axis=1,3 do if point[axis]<node.Min[axis] or point[axis]>node.Max[axis] then return false end end; return true
    end
    local function visit(node)
        if not contains(node) then return end
        if node.Indices then for _,index in ipairs(node.Indices) do local item=node.Items and node.Items[index]; if item then table.insert(hits,index) end end
        else visit(node.Left); visit(node.Right) end
    end
    visit(tree); return hits
end

return Module

const Players = game:GetService("Players")
const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- ByteNet shares a 512 B/s client -> server budget between ALL packets, so the
-- reference's 75 Hz full-pose stream cannot be used here. 8 Hz plus diffing the
-- rarely changing fields keeps this stream at ~21-37 B per sample.
const SEND_INTERVAL = 0.125
const VELOCITY_EPSILON = 1
const YAW_EPSILON = 0.02

const ClientStateService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "ClientStateService",
})

const function angleDelta(a: number, b: number): number
	const delta = (a - b) % (math.pi * 2)
	return if delta > math.pi then delta - math.pi * 2 else delta
end

function ClientStateService.onStart(self: typeof(ClientStateService))
	self.Packet = Crane:GetPacket("ClientState")
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Janitor.new()
	self.NextSendAt = 0
	self.LastVelocity = nil :: Vector3?
	self.LastLookYaw = nil :: number?

	-- Client services run inside the Main Actor, where RenderStepped is not
	-- dispatched. Heartbeat is the parallel-safe frame signal here.
	self.Cleaner:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		const now = os.clock()
		if now < self.NextSendAt then return end
		self.NextSendAt = now + SEND_INTERVAL

		const character = LocalPlayer.Character
		const rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not rootPart or not rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

		const velocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		const look = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
		-- Root rotation is yaw-dominant: CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0).LookVector is
		-- (-sin(yaw), 0, -cos(yaw)), so this round-trips exactly on the server.
		const lookYaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)

		const sendVelocity = self.LastVelocity == nil
			or (velocity - (self.LastVelocity :: Vector3)).Magnitude > VELOCITY_EPSILON
		const sendLookYaw = self.LastLookYaw == nil
			or math.abs(angleDelta(lookYaw, self.LastLookYaw :: number)) > YAW_EPSILON

		local IsGrounded = true
		local State = character.Humanoid:GetState()
		if
			State ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics
			and State ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
		then
			IsGrounded = State == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
		end

		self.Packet.send({
			Time = workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
			Position = rootPart.Position,
			Velocity = if sendVelocity then velocity else nil,
			LookYaw = if sendLookYaw then lookYaw else nil,
			IsGrounded = IsGrounded,
		})

		if sendVelocity then self.LastVelocity = velocity end
		if sendLookYaw then self.LastLookYaw = lookYaw end
	end))
end

function ClientStateService.Destroy(self: typeof(ClientStateService))
	self.Cleaner:Destroy()
end

return ClientStateService

-- computational-geometry implementation for ConvexHull3D
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))
local VectorForge = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForge")
local LA = require(VectorForge:WaitForChild("SpectralLinearAlgebra"))

local Module = {}
function Module.BruteForceFaces(points,tolerance)
    assert(#points>=4,"3D hull requires at least four points"); local tol=tolerance or 1e-10; local faces={}; local seen={}
    for i=1,#points-2 do for j=i+1,#points-1 do for k=j+1,#points do
        local ab=Num.Subtract(points[j],points[i]); local ac=Num.Subtract(points[k],points[i]); local normal=Num.Cross3(ab,ac); local magnitude=LA.Norm(normal)
        if magnitude>tol then
            normal=Num.Scale(normal,1/magnitude); local positive,negative=false,false
            for p=1,#points do if p~=i and p~=j and p~=k then local side=LA.Dot(normal,Num.Subtract(points[p],points[i])); if side>tol then positive=true elseif side< -tol then negative=true end end end
            if not (positive and negative) then
                local face={i,j,k}; if positive then face={i,k,j} end
                local key=table.concat(face,":"); if not seen[key] then seen[key]=true; table.insert(faces,{Indices=face,Normal=normal}) end
            end
        end
    end end end
    return faces,{Assumption="general position without coplanar face ambiguity"}
end

return Module

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const StarterPlayer = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")

const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const MovementRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.MovementRules)

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

--[=[ MovementService

   Applies the authoritative movement parameters replicated into the player
   proxy (`CharacterState.Parameters`) to the local Humanoid, layered with any
   number of client-side minimum WalkSpeed sources (Run prediction, cutscenes,
   etc.). The highest minimum wins, clamped by the server's maximum, so a local
   prediction can never override a server restraint.
]=]

const MovementService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "MovementService",
	LoadOrder = -5,
})

function MovementService.Apply(self: typeof(MovementService))
	const humanoid = self.Humanoid
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

	-- The proxy is rebuilt on respawn and its CharacterState is briefly empty;
	-- applying defaults then would snap the humanoid.
	const source = self.PlayerService.Proxy()
	const characterState = source and source.CharacterState
	if not characterState or not characterState.Parameters then return end

	const parameters = characterState.Parameters
	local minWalkSpeed = parameters.MinWalkSpeed
	for _, speed in self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds do
		minWalkSpeed = math.max(minWalkSpeed, speed)
	end

	humanoid.WalkSpeed = MovementRules.GetWalkSpeed(minWalkSpeed, parameters.MaxWalkSpeed)

	const jumpPower = MovementRules.GetJumpPower(parameters.MaxJumpPower)
	humanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower
	humanoid.JumpHeight = (jumpPower / MovementRules.BaseJumpPower)
		* StarterPlayer.CharacterJumpHeight
end

function MovementService.SetLocalMinWalkSpeed(
	self: typeof(MovementService),
	source: string,
	speed: number?
)
	if speed then
		self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds[source] = speed
	else
		self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds[source] = nil
	end

	self:Apply()
end

function MovementService.Attach(self: typeof(MovementService), character: Model)
	self.CharacterVersion += 1
	const version = self.CharacterVersion
	table.clear(self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds)

	self.Humanoid = nil
	const humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	if version ~= self.CharacterVersion then return end

	self.Humanoid = humanoid
	self:Apply()
end

function MovementService.onStart(self: typeof(MovementService))
	self.PlayerService = Crane:GetService("PlayerService")
	self.LocalMinWalkSpeeds = {}
	self.CharacterVersion = 0
	self.Cleaner = Crane.Buttler.new()

	self.Cleaner:Add(
		self.PlayerService.Proxy:Subscribe(
			"AnyChange",
			{ "CharacterState", "Parameters" },
			function()
				self:Apply()
			end
		)
	)

	self.Cleaner:Add(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		self:Attach(character)
	end))

	if LocalPlayer.Character then self:Attach(LocalPlayer.Character) end
end

function MovementService.Destroy(self: typeof(MovementService))
	self.CharacterVersion += 1
	self.Cleaner:Destroy()
end

return MovementService

-- computational-geometry implementation for CurvatureEstimator
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))
local VectorForge = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForge")
local LA = require(VectorForge:WaitForChild("SpectralLinearAlgebra"))

local Module = {}
function Module.ThreePoint2D(a,b,c)
    local ab=LA.Norm(Num.Subtract(b,a)); local bc=LA.Norm(Num.Subtract(c,b)); local ca=LA.Norm(Num.Subtract(a,c))
    Num.Positive(ab*bc*ca,"triangle side product")
    local twiceArea=math.abs((b[1]-a[1])*(c[2]-a[2])-(b[2]-a[2])*(c[1]-a[1]))
    return 2*twiceArea/(ab*bc*ca)
end
function Module.FromDerivatives(first,second)
    local cross=Num.Cross3(first,second); local speed=LA.Norm(first); Num.Positive(speed,"curve speed")
    return LA.Norm(cross)/(speed^3)
end

return Module

-- computational-geometry implementation for MeshSmoothing
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))

local Module = {}
function Module.Laplacian(vertices,adjacency,lambda,iterations)
    assert(#vertices==#adjacency,"mesh vertex/adjacency mismatch"); assert(lambda>=0 and lambda<=1,"smoothing factor must be in [0,1]")
    local current={}; for i,v in ipairs(vertices) do current[i]=table.clone(v) end
    for _=1,(iterations or 1) do
        local nextVertices={}
        for i,v in ipairs(current) do
            if #adjacency[i]==0 then nextVertices[i]=table.clone(v)
            else
                local average=table.create(#v,0); for _,neighbor in ipairs(adjacency[i]) do average=Num.Add(average,current[neighbor]) end
                average=Num.Scale(average,1/#adjacency[i]); nextVertices[i]=Num.Add(Num.Scale(v,1-lambda),Num.Scale(average,lambda))
            end
        end
        current=nextVertices
    end
    return current
end

return Module

const RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
const UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
const Mouse = Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
const Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const PlayerData = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.schemas.PlayerData)
const Proxy = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Proxy)

const TargetLockService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "TargetLockService",
})

function TargetLockService:Lock()
	const humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	const root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart

	const target = Mouse.Target
	if not target then return end

	if (target.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 50 then return end

	const targetHumanoid = target.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if not targetHumanoid then return end

	const targetRoot = target.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	if not targetRoot then return end

	--hum.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(1.75,0,0) -- I assume this is about the right camera offset.
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false --Disable the automatic rotation since we are the ones setting it.

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(
		"ShiftLock",
		Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value,
		function(deltaTime)
			if humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then return end

			if not root or not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end
			if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 50 then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end

			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter --Set the mouse to center every frame.

			root.CFrame = root.CFrame:Lerp(
				CFrame.new(
					root.Position,
					Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X, root.Position.Y, targetRoot.Position.Z)
				),
				deltaTime * 5
			) --Set the root part to the camera's rotation
		end
	)

	RunService:BindToRenderStep(
		"ShiftLockCamera",
		Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 5,
		function(deltaTime)
			if not root or not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end
			if (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 50 then
				self:Unlock()
				return
			end

			const targetVector = (root.Position - targetRoot.Position).Unit
			Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position, targetRoot.Position)
				:ToWorldSpace(CFrame.new(humanoid.CameraOffset + Vector3.new(3, 4, 14)))
		end
	)

	self.Locked = true
end

function TargetLockService:Unlock()
	const humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	const root = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	humanoid.AutoRotate = true --Let the humanoid handle the camera rotations again.

	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShiftLock") -- Allow mouse to move freely.
	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShiftLockCamera")
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default

	self.Locked = false
end

function TargetLockService:onStart()
	self.Locked = false

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if gameProcessed then return end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonSelect then
			if self.Locked then
				self:Unlock()
			else
				self:Lock()
			end
		end
	end)
end

return TargetLockService

-- computational-geometry implementation for NURBSCurve
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))

local Module = {}
function Module.Basis(i,p,u,knots)
    if p==0 then return if (knots[i]<=u and u<knots[i+1]) or (u==knots[#knots] and i==#knots-p-1) then 1 else 0 end
    local left=0; local right=0; local d1=knots[i+p]-knots[i]; local d2=knots[i+p+1]-knots[i+1]
    if d1>0 then left=(u-knots[i])/d1*Module.Basis(i,p-1,u,knots) end
    if d2>0 then right=(knots[i+p+1]-u)/d2*Module.Basis(i+1,p-1,u,knots) end
    return left+right
end
function Module.Evaluate(controlPoints,weights,degree,knots,u)
    assert(#controlPoints==#weights,"NURBS control point/weight mismatch"); Num.Positive(#controlPoints,"control point count")
    local dimension=#controlPoints[1]; local numerator=table.create(dimension,0); local denominator=0
    for i=1,#controlPoints do local basis=Module.Basis(i,degree,u,knots)*weights[i]; denominator+=basis; numerator=Num.Add(numerator,Num.Scale(controlPoints[i],basis)) end
    Num.Positive(math.abs(denominator),"NURBS rational denominator")
    return Num.Scale(numerator,1/denominator)
end


-- Rational curve denominator and a scale-aware singularity diagnostic.
function Module.WeightSum(basis,weights)
    assert(#basis==#weights,"basis and weight count mismatch")
    local denominator=0
    for i=1,#basis do
        assert(weights[i]>=0,"NURBS weights must be nonnegative")
        denominator+=basis[i]*weights[i]
    end
    return denominator
end

-- Evaluate rational basis functions R_i=N_i*w_i/sum_j(N_j*w_j).
function Module.RationalBasis(basis,weights,tolerance)
    local denominator=Module.WeightSum(basis,weights)
    assert(math.abs(denominator)>(tolerance or 1e-12),"NURBS rational denominator is singular")
    local rational=table.create(#basis)
    for i=1,#basis do rational[i]=basis[i]*weights[i]/denominator end
    return rational,denominator
end

return Module

-- computational-geometry implementation for TriangleIntersection
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))
local VectorForge = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForge")
local LA = require(VectorForge:WaitForChild("SpectralLinearAlgebra"))

local Module = {}
function Module.RayMollerTrumbore(origin,direction,triangle,tolerance)
    local eps=tolerance or 1e-10; local v0,v1,v2=triangle[1],triangle[2],triangle[3]
    local edge1=Num.Subtract(v1,v0); local edge2=Num.Subtract(v2,v0); local h=Num.Cross3(direction,edge2); local a=LA.Dot(edge1,h)
    if math.abs(a)<eps then return nil end
    local f=1/a; local s=Num.Subtract(origin,v0); local u=f*LA.Dot(s,h); if u<0 or u>1 then return nil end
    local q=Num.Cross3(s,edge1); local v=f*LA.Dot(direction,q); if v<0 or u+v>1 then return nil end
    local t=f*LA.Dot(edge2,q); if t<eps then return nil end
    return t,{u=u,v=v,w=1-u-v},Num.Add(origin,Num.Scale(direction,t))
end

return Module

-- computational-geometry implementation for BezierCurve
-- Assumptions: coordinates use a consistent caller-defined length unit; predicates and parameter values require non-degenerate input geometry unless noted.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))

local Module = {}
function Module.Evaluate(controlPoints,t)
    assert(#controlPoints>=2 and t>=0 and t<=1,"invalid Bezier input")
    local work={}; for i,p in ipairs(controlPoints) do work[i]=table.clone(p) end
    for level=#work-1,1,-1 do for i=1,level do work[i]=Num.Add(Num.Scale(work[i],1-t),Num.Scale(work[i+1],t)) end end
    return work[1]
end
function Module.DerivativeControlPoints(controlPoints)
    local degree=#controlPoints-1; assert(degree>=1,"Bezier curve degree must be at least one")
    local result=table.create(degree)
    for i=1,degree do result[i]=Num.Scale(Num.Subtract(controlPoints[i+1],controlPoints[i]),degree) end

end

-- computational-geometry implementation for CatmullRomSpline

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))

local Module = {}
function Module.Evaluate(p0,p1,p2,p3,t,tension)
    local tau=tension or 0.5; local t2=t*t; local t3=t2*t
    local a=Num.Scale(p1,2); local b=Num.Scale(Num.Subtract(p2,p0),tau)
    local c=Num.Add(Num.Add(Num.Scale(p0,2),Num.Scale(p1,-5)),Num.Add(Num.Scale(p2,4),Num.Scale(p3,-1)))
    local d=Num.Add(Num.Add(Num.Scale(p0,-1),Num.Scale(p1,3)),Num.Add(Num.Scale(p2,-3),p3))
    return Num.Scale(Num.Add(Num.Add(a,Num.Scale(b,t)),Num.Add(Num.Scale(c,t2),Num.Scale(d,t3))),0.5)
end

return Module

const ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
const ForgeVFX = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.ForgeVFX)
const LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
const Crane = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.packages.Crane)
const PlayerComponent = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client.components.Player)
const Configuration = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.client.Configuration

const EffectsFolder = ReplicatedStorage.shared.effects

type Effect = {
	Validate: (self: Effect, data: any?) -> boolean,
	onStart: (self: Effect, data: any?) -> (),
	onStop: (self: Effect, data: any?) -> (),
}

const VFXService = Crane:CreateService({
	Name = "VFXService",
})
VFXService.Effects = {} :: { [string]: Effect }

function VFXService.onStart(self: typeof(VFXService))
	ForgeVFX.init()

	for i, module in EffectsFolder:QueryDescendants("ModuleScript") do
		self.Effects[module.Name] = require(module)
	end

	const StartVFXPacket = Crane:GetPacket("StartVFX")
	const StopVFXPacket = Crane:GetPacket("StopVFX")

	StartVFXPacket.listen(function(data: { name: string, args: { unknown } })
		self:StartEffect(data.name, data.args[1])
	end)

	StopVFXPacket.listen(function(data: { name: string, args: { unknown } })
		self:StopEffect(data.name, data.args[1])
	end)
end

-- Effects are registered at onStart, but Rojo can sync a new effect module a
-- little later than the service boots. Resolve it on demand instead of losing
-- the packet entirely.
const function resolveEffect(self: typeof(VFXService), name: string): Effect?
	if self.Effects[name] then return self.Effects[name] end

	for _, module in EffectsFolder:QueryDescendants("ModuleScript") do
		if module.Name ~= name then continue end
		const effect = require(module) :: Effect
		self.Effects[name] = effect
		return effect
	end
	return nil
end

function VFXService:StartEffect(name: string, data: any?)
	const effect = resolveEffect(self, name)
	if not effect then
		Crane.Utils.Log(script.Name, `Can't find VFX with name {name}`, "error")
		return
	end

	if effect.Validate and not effect:Validate(data) then return end

	effect:onStart(data)
end

function VFXService:StopEffect(name: string, data: any?)
	const effect = resolveEffect(self, name)
	if not effect then
		Crane.Utils.Log(script.Name, `Can't find VFX with name {name}`, "error")
		return
	end

	if effect.onStop then effect:onStop(data) end
end

return VFXService

const ClientSkillService = require(script.Parent.Parent.services.ClientSkillService)

type Context = ClientSkillService.ClientSkillContext

--[=[ Dash (client prediction)

   The server stays authoritative for cooldown and i-frames, but the local
   player owns its own character physics. Applying the mover here makes the
   dash feel instant; the server skill deliberately skips it for player-owned
   characters and still creates one for NPCs.

   Animation is also owned by this client through the shared "Dash" effect, so
   the server never starts or stops an animation for the local player.
]=]

-- ReleaseTime is now server time and is directly comparable on the client.
-- The local timer still drives prediction on the same frame as the press;
-- the server remains the final validator.
local LastActivateAt = -math.huge

local function canActivate(_self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context): boolean
	const state = ctx.CharacterState
	if not state or not state.Parameters then return false end

	const parameters = state.Parameters
	const now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	if ctx.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	if parameters.Stun and parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > now then return false end
	if parameters.Ragdoll then return false end
	if parameters.Restand then return false end
	if parameters.Restrain then return false end
	if
		ctx.Humanoid.PlatformStand
		or ctx.Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
	then
		return false
	end
	if now - LastActivateAt < DashMovement.Config.Cooldown then return false end

	return true
end

local function activate(_self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context)
	LastActivateAt = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

	const rootPart = ctx.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not rootPart then
		ctx.Deactivate()
		return
	end

	const playerService = Crane:GetService("PlayerService")
	const vfxService = Crane:GetService("VFXService")

	const moveDirection = DashMovement.GetDirection(ctx.Humanoid.MoveDirection, rootPart.CFrame)
	const mover = DashMovement.Apply(rootPart, moveDirection)
	ctx.Cleaner:Set("DashMover", mover, "Destroy")

	-- The shared Dash effect derives the animation direction from the vector
	-- itself. No server-side start/stop for the local player.
	-- Proxy().Spec / .SubSpec hold spec UUIDs, not config names. Skins are keyed
	-- by the name inside Specs[uuid], so resolve it first (and prefer the slot
	-- that actually owns Dash).
	const playerData = playerService.Proxy()
	const skills = playerData.Skills
	const dashSlot = if skills and skills.SubSpec and skills.SubSpec.Dash then "SubSpec" else "Spec"
	const specId = if dashSlot == "SubSpec" then playerData.SubSpec else playerData.Spec
	const specConfig = playerData.Specs and playerData.Specs[specId]
	const specName = specConfig and specConfig.Name
	if specName and specName ~= "None" then
		vfxService:StartEffect("Dash", {
			Character = ctx.Character,
			SpecData = { SpecId = specName, SkinId = "None" },
			-- The effect picks the animation from the object-space normal; a
			-- world vector would select the wrong Dash side.
			Normal = mover.Normal,
		})
	end

	ctx.Cleaner:Add(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
		-- The shared mover holds one world-fixed direction and eases down to a
		-- fixed exit speed; deactivating only removes the constraint.
		if not DashMovement.Update(mover, deltaTime) then ctx.Deactivate() end
	end))

	-- Resync: if the authoritative state says the character can no longer dash,
	-- drop the local prediction immediately instead of waiting for key release.
	ctx.Cleaner:Add(
		playerService.Proxy:Subscribe("AnyChange", { "CharacterState", "Parameters" }, function()
			const state = playerService.Proxy().CharacterState
			if not state or not state.Parameters then return end

			const parameters = state.Parameters
			const castingSkill = parameters.CastingSkill
			if
				(castingSkill and castingSkill ~= "" and castingSkill ~= "Dash")
				or parameters.Ragdoll
				or parameters.Restand
				or parameters.Restrain
				or ctx.Humanoid.PlatformStand
				or ctx.Humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding
				or ctx.Humanoid.Health <= 0
				or (parameters.Stun and parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
			then
				ctx.Deactivate()
			end
		end)
	)
end

local function stop(_self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context)
	ctx.Cleaner:Remove("DashMover")
end

const Dash: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill = {
	Id = "Dash",
	IgnoreRelease = true,
	CanActivate = canActivate,
	Activate = activate,
	Stop = stop,
}

return Dash

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForgeShared")
local Num = require(Shared:WaitForChild("NumericalKernels"))
local VectorForge = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VectorForge")
local LA = require(VectorForge:WaitForChild("SpectralLinearAlgebra"))

local Module = {}
function Module.GoldenSection(evaluate,target,lower,upper,tolerance)
    local ratio=(math.sqrt(5)-1)/2; local a,b=lower,upper; local c=b-ratio*(b-a); local d=a+ratio*(b-a)
    local function distance2(t) return LA.Dot(Num.Subtract(evaluate(t),target),Num.Subtract(evaluate(t),target)) end
    while b-a>(tolerance or 1e-8) do
        if distance2(c)<distance2(d) then b=d; d=c; c=b-ratio*(b-a) else a=c; c=d; d=a+ratio*(b-a) end
    end
    local parameter=(a+b)/2; local point=evaluate(parameter); return parameter,point,math.sqrt(distance2(parameter))
end

return Module

const MovementRules = require(ReplicatedStorage.shared.MovementRules)
const ClientSkillService = require(script.Parent.Parent.services.ClientSkillService)

type Context = ClientSkillService.ClientSkillContext

--[=[ Run (client prediction)

   Press-to-flip sprint. The server owns the real `MinWalkSpeed` parameter;
   this skill only predicts it locally so the speed change is felt on the same
   frame as the press, then resyncs itself the moment the authoritative value
   disagrees (server toggled it off, an interrupt landed, the character died).

   No tool state is involved: the gate reads the replicated CharacterState
   directly through MovementRules.CanRun.
]=]

const Run: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill = {
	Id = "Run",
	Toggle = true,
}

function Run.CanActivate(self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context): boolean
	const characterState = ctx.CharacterState
	if not characterState or not characterState.Parameters then return false end

	const parameters = characterState.Parameters
	const humanoidState = ctx.Humanoid:GetState()

	return MovementRules.CanRun({
		Alive = ctx.Character.Parent ~= nil and humanoidState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,
		Stunned = parameters.Stun.ExpiresAt > workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
		Ragdolled = parameters.Ragdoll,
		Restrained = parameters.Restrain,
		Blocking = characterState.Blocking,
		Physics = humanoidState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
	})
end

function Run.Activate(self: ClientSkillService.ClientSkill, ctx: Context)
	const movement = Crane:GetService("MovementService")
	movement:SetLocalMinWalkSpeed("Run", MovementRules.RunSpeed)
	ctx.Cleaner:Add(function()
		movement:SetLocalMinWalkSpeed("Run", nil)
	end)

	-- Resync: when the server's authoritative minimum drops below the sprint
	-- speed, the prediction is stale — hand it back without waiting for a press.
	const playerService = Crane:GetService("PlayerService")
	ctx.Cleaner:Add(playerService.Proxy:Subscribe(
		"AnyChange",
		-- Watch the whole Parameters subtree so a CastingSkill change is
		-- heard too; the callback still only acts on MinWalkSpeed / lock.
		{ "CharacterState", "Parameters" },
		function()
			const state = playerService.Proxy().CharacterState
			const parameters = state and state.Parameters
			if not parameters then return end

			-- A different skill taking the cast lock ends the prediction
			-- immediately; our own cast must not cut the sprint short.
			const castingSkill = parameters.CastingSkill
			if castingSkill and castingSkill ~= "" and castingSkill ~= "Run" then
				ctx.Deactivate()
			end

			const min = parameters.MinWalkSpeed or 0
			if min < MovementRules.RunSpeed then ctx.Deactivate() end
		end
	))
end

return Run
