--!strict
--[[
	PNG and base64, written out by hand.

	Studio gives a screenshot as an EditableImage, which hands over raw RGBA
	bytes and nothing else. There is no encoder anywhere in the engine's API, and
	no base64 either -- `HttpService` has JSONEncode and nothing adjacent -- so
	getting a picture from Studio to an agent means producing both here.

	The compression is deliberately none at all. Deflate's stored mode wraps the
	bytes in block headers and changes nothing else, which is legal zlib and a
	valid PNG; a real compressor would take far longer to write and run, and the
	image is downscaled before it reaches this point, so the saving would be on
	something already small. Correctness is worth more than bytes here.
]]

local Png = {}

-- Standard CRC-32, built once. The per-byte loop is 8 shifts; a 256-entry table
-- turns each byte into one lookup, which matters over a megabyte of pixels.
local crcTable: { number } = {}
do
	for index = 0, 255 do
		local value = index
		for _ = 1, 8 do
			if value % 2 == 1 then
				value = bit32.bxor(0xEDB88320, bit32.rshift(value, 1))
			else
				value = bit32.rshift(value, 1)
			end
		end
		crcTable[index] = value
	end
end

local function crc32(data: buffer, from: number, count: number): number
	local crc = 0xFFFFFFFF
	for offset = from, from + count - 1 do
		local index = bit32.band(bit32.bxor(crc, buffer.readu8(data, offset)), 0xFF)
		crc = bit32.bxor(crcTable[index], bit32.rshift(crc, 8))
	end
	return bit32.bxor(crc, 0xFFFFFFFF)
end

--[[
	Adler-32, which zlib carries and PNG readers check.

	The modulo runs every 4096 bytes rather than every byte: both accumulators
	stay well inside 2^53 over that span, so the arithmetic is exact and the cost
	is paid a few thousand times instead of a few million.
]]
local function adler32(data: buffer, length: number): number
	local a, b = 1, 0
	local index = 0
	while index < length do
		local chunkEnd = math.min(index + 4096, length)
		while index < chunkEnd do
			a += buffer.readu8(data, index)
			b += a
			index += 1
		end
		a %= 65521
		b %= 65521
	end
	return bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(b, 16), a)
end

local function writeU32(out: buffer, offset: number, value: number)
	buffer.writeu8(out, offset, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(value, 24), 0xFF))
	buffer.writeu8(out, offset + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(value, 16), 0xFF))
	buffer.writeu8(out, offset + 2, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
	buffer.writeu8(out, offset + 3, bit32.band(value, 0xFF))
end

--[[
	One PNG chunk: length, type, payload, CRC over type and payload.
]]
local function writeChunk(out: buffer, offset: number, kind: string, payload: buffer, payloadLength: number): number
	writeU32(out, offset, payloadLength)
	buffer.writestring(out, offset + 4, kind)
	if payloadLength > 0 then
		buffer.copy(out, offset + 8, payload, 0, payloadLength)
	end
	writeU32(out, offset + 8 + payloadLength, crc32(out, offset + 4, payloadLength + 4))
	return offset + 12 + payloadLength
end

--[[
	Encodes 8-bit RGB pixels as a PNG.

	`rgb` holds width * height * 3 bytes, row-major, no padding. Alpha is dropped
	before this point: a screenshot has none worth keeping and carrying it would
	add a quarter to every byte that follows.
]]
function Png.encode(rgb: buffer, width: number, height: number): buffer
	-- PNG wants a filter byte at the start of every scanline. Filter 0 means
	-- "stored as-is", which is what makes the rest of this a straight copy.
	local rowBytes = width * 3
	local rawLength = (rowBytes + 1) * height
	local raw = buffer.create(rawLength)
	for row = 0, height - 1 do
		local target = row * (rowBytes + 1)
		buffer.writeu8(raw, target, 0)
		buffer.copy(raw, target + 1, rgb, row * rowBytes, rowBytes)
	end

	-- zlib: 0x78 0x01 header, stored deflate blocks, Adler-32 trailer.
	local MAX_BLOCK = 65535
	local blocks = math.max(1, math.ceil(rawLength / MAX_BLOCK))
	local zlibLength = 2 + blocks * 5 + rawLength + 4
	local zlib = buffer.create(zlibLength)
	buffer.writeu8(zlib, 0, 0x78)
	buffer.writeu8(zlib, 1, 0x01)

	local readOffset = 0
	local writeOffset = 2
	for index = 1, blocks do
		local size = math.min(MAX_BLOCK, rawLength - readOffset)
		buffer.writeu8(zlib, writeOffset, if index == blocks then 1 else 0)
		-- LEN then its one's complement, both little-endian.
		buffer.writeu8(zlib, writeOffset + 1, bit32.band(size, 0xFF))
		buffer.writeu8(zlib, writeOffset + 2, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(size, 8), 0xFF))
		buffer.writeu8(zlib, writeOffset + 3, bit32.band(bit32.bnot(size), 0xFF))
		buffer.writeu8(zlib, writeOffset + 4, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(bit32.bnot(size), 8), 0xFF))
		buffer.copy(zlib, writeOffset + 5, raw, readOffset, size)
		readOffset += size
		writeOffset += 5 + size
	end
	writeU32(zlib, writeOffset, adler32(raw, rawLength))

	local header = buffer.create(13)
	writeU32(header, 0, width)
	writeU32(header, 4, height)
	buffer.writeu8(header, 8, 8) -- bit depth
	buffer.writeu8(header, 9, 2) -- colour type 2: truecolour RGB
	buffer.writeu8(header, 10, 0) -- deflate
	buffer.writeu8(header, 11, 0) -- adaptive filtering
	buffer.writeu8(header, 12, 0) -- no interlace

	local total = 8 + (12 + 13) + (12 + zlibLength) + 12
	local out = buffer.create(total)
	-- Signature: the high bit and the CRLF pair catch transports that would
	-- mangle the file without anyone noticing.
	buffer.writeu8(out, 0, 0x89)
	buffer.writestring(out, 1, "PNG\r\n")
	buffer.writeu8(out, 6, 0x1A)
	buffer.writeu8(out, 7, 0x0A)

	local offset = writeChunk(out, 8, "IHDR", header, 13)
	offset = writeChunk(out, offset, "IDAT", zlib, zlibLength)
	writeChunk(out, offset, "IEND", buffer.create(0), 0)
	return out
end

local BASE64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

--[[
	Base64, three bytes at a time.

	Assembled into a table of chunks and concatenated once at the end. Appending
	to a string in a loop would rebuild the whole thing on every pass, which over
	a megabyte is the difference between prompt and unusable.
]]
function Png.base64(data: buffer): string
	local length = buffer.len(data)
	local pieces: { string } = {}
	local index = 0

	while index + 3 <= length do
		local a, b, c = buffer.readu8(data, index), buffer.readu8(data, index + 1), buffer.readu8(data, index + 2)
		local packed = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(a, 16), bit32.lshift(b, 8), c)
		table.insert(
			pieces,
			string.sub(BASE64, bit32.rshift(packed, 18) + 1, bit32.rshift(packed, 18) + 1)
				.. string.sub(BASE64, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 12), 63) + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 12), 63) + 1)
				.. string.sub(BASE64, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 6), 63) + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 6), 63) + 1)
				.. string.sub(BASE64, bit32.band(packed, 63) + 1, bit32.band(packed, 63) + 1)
		)
		index += 3
	end

	local remaining = length - index
	if remaining == 1 then
		local a = buffer.readu8(data, index)
		local packed = bit32.lshift(a, 16)
		table.insert(
			pieces,
			string.sub(BASE64, bit32.rshift(packed, 18) + 1, bit32.rshift(packed, 18) + 1)
				.. string.sub(BASE64, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 12), 63) + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 12), 63) + 1)
				.. "=="
		)
	elseif remaining == 2 then
		local a, b = buffer.readu8(data, index), buffer.readu8(data, index + 1)
		local packed = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(a, 16), bit32.lshift(b, 8))
		table.insert(
			pieces,
			string.sub(BASE64, bit32.rshift(packed, 18) + 1, bit32.rshift(packed, 18) + 1)
				.. string.sub(BASE64, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 12), 63) + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 12), 63) + 1)
				.. string.sub(BASE64, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 6), 63) + 1, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(packed, 6), 63) + 1)
				.. "="
		)
	end

	return table.concat(pieces)
end

--[[
	Nearest-neighbour downscale, RGBA in and RGB out.

	The fallback path. `Capture` scales on the engine side now -- see
	`Capture.resample` -- because this loop is six buffer calls per output pixel
	in Luau and nearest-neighbour is the wrong filter for the job: at the usual
	2x reduction it does not "keep thin edges", it deletes every other row and
	column outright, which is exactly where one-pixel GUI text lives. This stays
	for the cases the engine path cannot take: a Studio without
	`CreateEditableImage`, or a target wider than the 1024 an EditableImage can
	be created at.
]]
function Png.downscaleToRgb(rgba: buffer, width: number, height: number, targetWidth: number): (buffer, number, number)
	local scale = math.min(1, targetWidth / width)
	local outWidth = math.max(1, math.floor(width * scale))
	local outHeight = math.max(1, math.floor(height * scale))
	local out = buffer.create(outWidth * outHeight * 3)

	for row = 0, outHeight - 1 do
		local sourceRow = math.min(height - 1, math.floor(row / scale))
		local sourceRowBase = sourceRow * width * 4
		local targetRowBase = row * outWidth * 3
		for column = 0, outWidth - 1 do
			local sourceColumn = math.min(width - 1, math.floor(column / scale))
			local source = sourceRowBase + sourceColumn * 4
			local target = targetRowBase + column * 3
			buffer.writeu8(out, target, buffer.readu8(rgba, source))
			buffer.writeu8(out, target + 1, buffer.readu8(rgba, source + 1))
			buffer.writeu8(out, target + 2, buffer.readu8(rgba, source + 2))
		end
	end

	return out, outWidth, outHeight
end

return Png

local Components = App.Components
local Util = Components.Util

local Fusion = require(Polaris.Packages.Fusion)

local Theme = require(App.Theme)
local default = require(Util.default)
local stripProps = require(Util.stripProps)

local New = Fusion.New
local Out = Fusion.Out
local Value = Fusion.Value
local Hydrate = Fusion.Hydrate
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local OnChange = Fusion.OnChange
local Children = Fusion.Children
local peek = Fusion.peek

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Started",
	"Changed",
	"Finished",
	"Font",
	"Color",
	"PlaceholderColor",
	"Scaled",
}

type Props = {
	Started: (() -> ())?,
	Changed: ((text: string) -> ())?,
	Finished: ((text: string) -> ())?,
	AutomaticSize: Enum.AutomaticSize?,
	Font: Fusion.CanBeState<Font>?,
	Color: Fusion.CanBeState<Color3>?,
	PlaceholderColor: Fusion.CanBeState<Color3>?,
	Scaled: boolean?,
	[any]: any,
}

return function(props: Props): TextBox
	local text = Value("")

	return Hydrate(New("TextBox") {

local function Button(props: ButtonProps): TextButton
	local isHovered = Value(false)
	local isPressed = Value(false)

	local state = getState({
		Hovered = isHovered,
		Pressed = isPressed,
	})

	local color = animate(
		Computed(function(use)
			return use(props.IsSelected) and use(Theme.Colors.Brand) or use(Theme.Colors.Background)
		end),
		state
	)

	local children = if props.IsFirst
		then {
			Corner {},
			New "Frame" {
				AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
				Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 1),
				BackgroundColor3 = color,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			},
		}
		elseif props.IsLast then {
			Corner {},
			New "Frame" {
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 1),
				BackgroundColor3 = color,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			},
		}
		else {}

	if not props.IsFirst then
		table.insert(
			children,
			New "Frame" {
				Size = UDim2.new(0, Theme.BorderThickness, 1, 0),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Border,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
			}
		)
	end

	return Hydrate(New "TextButton" {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Regular,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		TextSize = Theme.TextSize.Large,
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		TextColor3 = Computed(function(use)
			return use(props.IsSelected) and use(Theme.Colors.TextBranded) or use(Theme.Colors.Text)
		end),
		[OnEvent "InputBegan"] = function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
				isHovered:set(true)
			elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				isPressed:set(true)
			end
		end,
		[OnEvent "InputEnded"] = function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
				isHovered:set(false)
			elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				isPressed:set(false)
			end
		end,
		[OnEvent "Activated"] = function()
			if props.Activated then
				props.Activated()
			end
		end,
		[Children] = children,
	})(stripProps(props, BUTTON_COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS))
end

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Selected",
	"Options",
	"Value",
}

type Props = {
	Selected: ((option: string) -> ())?,
	Options: { string },
	Value: Fusion.CanBeState<boolean>?,
	[any]: any,
}

return function(props: Props): Frame
	local value = isState(props.Value) and props.Value or Value(props.Value or props.Options[1])

	return Hydrate(Box {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Theme.CompSizeY.Small),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
		[Children] = {
			List {
				FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
				HorizontalFlex = Enum.UIFlexAlignment.Fill,
				Spacing = 0,
			},
			ForValues(props.Options, function(_, option)
				return Button {
					Text = option,
					IsSelected = Computed(function(use)
						return use(value) == option
					end),
					Activated = function()
						if option == peek(value) then
							return
						end

						value:set(option)

						if props.Selected then
							props.Selected(option)
						end
					end,
					IsFirst = option == props.Options[1],
					IsLast = option == props.Options[#props.Options],
				}
			end, cleanup),
		},
	})(stripProps(props, COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS))
end

local Polaris = script:FindFirstAncestor("Polaris")
local App = Polaris.App
local Components = App.Components
local Util = Components.Util

local Fusion = require(Polaris.Packages.Fusion)

local Theme = require(App.Theme)
local stripProps = require(Util.stripProps)

local New = Fusion.New
local Hydrate = Fusion.Hydrate

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Padding",
	"Horizontal",
	"Vertical",
	"Left",
	"Right",
	"Top",
	"Bottom",
}

type Props = {
	-- Mode 1
	Padding: number?,
	-- Mode 2
	Horizontal: number?,
	Vertical: number?,
	-- Mode 3
	Left: number?,
	Right: number?,
	Top: number?,
	Bottom: number?,
	[any]: any,
}

return function(props: Props): UIPadding
	local left, right
	local top, bottom

	if props.Left or props.Right or props.Top or props.Bottom then
		local padding = props.Padding or 0

		left = UDim.new(0, props.Left or padding)
		right = UDim.new(0, props.Right or padding)
		top = UDim.new(0, props.Top or padding)
		bottom = UDim.new(0, props.Bottom or padding)
	elseif props.Horizontal or props.Vertical then
		local padding = props.Padding or 0
		local horizontal = UDim.new(0, props.Horizontal or padding)
		local vertical = UDim.new(0, props.Vertical or padding)

		left = horizontal
		right = horizontal
		top = vertical
		bottom = vertical
	else
		local padding = UDim.new(0, props.Padding or Theme.Padding)

		left = padding
		right = padding
		top = padding
		bottom = padding
	end

	return Hydrate(New "UIPadding" {
		PaddingLeft = left,
		PaddingRight = right,
		PaddingTop = top,
		PaddingBottom = bottom,
	})(stripProps(props, COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS))
end

local Polaris = script:FindFirstAncestor("Polaris")
local App = Polaris.App
local Components = App.Components
local Util = Components.Util

local Fusion = require(Polaris.Packages.Fusion)

local stripProps = require(Util.stripProps)
local isState = require(Util.isState)

local Hydrate = Fusion.Hydrate
local Observer = Fusion.Observer
local peek = Fusion.peek

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Toolbar",
	"Name",
	"ToolTip",
	"Image",
}

type ToolbarButtonProps = {
	Toolbar: PluginToolbar,
	Name: string,
	ToolTip: string,
	Image: Fusion.CanBeState<string>,
	[any]: any,
}

return function(props: ToolbarButtonProps): PluginToolbarButton
	local button = props.Toolbar:CreateButton(props.Name, props.ToolTip, peek(props.Image))
	button.ClickableWhenViewportHidden = true

	if isState(props.Image) then
		plugin.Unloading:Once(Observer(props.Image):onChange(function()
			button.Icon = peek(props.Image)
		end))
	end

	return Hydrate(button)(stripProps(props, COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS))
end

local plugin = script:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Plugin")

local Polaris = script:FindFirstAncestor("Polaris")
local App = Polaris.App
local Components = App.Components
local Util = Components.Util

local Fusion = require(Polaris.Packages.Fusion)

local stripProps = require(Util.stripProps)
local isState = require(Util.isState)
local default = require(Util.default)

local Hydrate = Fusion.Hydrate
local peek = Fusion.peek

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Id",
	"InitialDockTo",
	"InitialEnabled",
	"OverrideEnabled",
	"FloatingSize",
	"MinimumSize",
	"Closed",
}

type WidgetProps = {
	Id: string?,
	InitialDockTo: Enum.InitialDockState?,
	InitialEnabled: boolean?,
	OverrideEnabled: boolean?,
	FloatingSize: Vector2?,
	MinimumSize: Vector2,
	Closed: (() -> ())?,
	[any]: any,
}

return function(props: WidgetProps): DockWidgetPluginGui
	local floatingSize = props.FloatingSize or props.MinimumSize

	local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGui(
		props.Id or peek(props.Name),
		DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(
			props.InitialDockTo or Enum.InitialDockState.Float,
			default(props.InitialEnabled, true),
			default(props.OverrideEnabled, false),
			floatingSize.X,
			floatingSize.Y,
			props.MinimumSize.X,
			props.MinimumSize.Y
		)
	)

	if isState(props.Enabled) then
		props.Enabled:set(widget.Enabled)
	end

	if props.Closed then
		widget:BindToClose(props.Closed)
	end

	widget.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	props.Title = props.Name

	return Hydrate(widget)(stripProps(props, COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS))
end

local Polaris = script:FindFirstAncestor("Polaris")
local App = Polaris.App
local Components = App.Components
local Util = Components.Util

local Fusion = require(Polaris.Packages.Fusion)

local Theme = require(App.Theme)
local stripProps = require(Util.stripProps)

local New = Fusion.New
local Hydrate = Fusion.Hydrate
local Children = Fusion.Children

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Duration",
}

local DOT_COUNT = 3
local DOT_SIZE = 7
local DOT_SPACING = 6

type Props = {
	Duration: number?,
	[any]: any,
}

-- Pulsing dots, drawn with plain frames: no image assets, so it matches the
-- widget theme and does not pull a bitmap in for a 12px animation.
return function(props: Props): Frame
	local duration = props.Duration or 1
	local dots = {}

	local children = {
		New "UIListLayout" {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, DOT_SPACING),
		},
	}

	for i = 1, DOT_COUNT do
		local dot = New "Frame" {
			Name = `Dot{i}`,
			LayoutOrder = i,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(DOT_SIZE, DOT_SIZE),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Colors.Text,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			[Children] = {
				New "UICorner" {
					CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0),
				},
			},
		}

		dots[i] = dot
		table.insert(children, dot)
	end

	local root = Hydrate(New "Frame" {
		Name = "Spinner",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(DOT_COUNT * DOT_SIZE + (DOT_COUNT - 1) * DOT_SPACING, DOT_SIZE),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		[Children] = children,
	})(stripProps(props, COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS))

	local function step()
		local now = os.clock() / duration

		for i, dot in dots do
			local phase = (now + (i - 1) / DOT_COUNT) % 1
			local wave = math.abs(math.sin(phase * math.pi))

			dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.75 - 0.65 * wave
		end
	end

	step()

	local connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)

	root.Destroying:Once(function()
		connection:Disconnect()
	end)

	return root
end

local stripProps = require(Util.stripProps)

local Hydrate = Fusion.Hydrate

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Font",
	"Color",
	"Scaled",
}

type Props = {
	Font: Fusion.CanBeState<Font>?,
	Color: Fusion.CanBeState<Color3>?,
	Scaled: boolean?,
	[any]: any,
}

return function(props: Props): TextLabel
	return Hydrate(New("TextLabel") {
		FontFace = props.Font or Theme.Fonts.Regular,
		TextColor3 = props.Color or Theme.Colors.Text,
		TextSize = Theme.TextSize.Large,
		AutomaticSize = props.Scaled and Enum.AutomaticSize.None or Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		TextScaled = props.Scaled,
		[Children] = props.Scaled and New("UITextSizeConstraint") {

local Polaris = script:FindFirstAncestor("Polaris")
local App = Polaris.App
local Components = App.Components
local Util = Components.Util

local Fusion = require(Polaris.Packages.Fusion)

local Theme = require(App.Theme)
local animate = require(Util.animate)
local stripProps = require(Util.stripProps)
local getTextSize = require(Util.getTextSize)
local getState = require(Util.getState)

local Border = require(Components.Border)

local New = Fusion.New
local Value = Fusion.Value
local Hydrate = Fusion.Hydrate
local OnEvent = Fusion.OnEvent
local Computed = Fusion.Computed
local Children = Fusion.Children

local COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS = {
	"Activated",
	"Solid",
}

type Props = {
	Activated: (() -> ())?,
	Solid: Fusion.CanBeState<boolean>?,
	[any]: any,
}

return function(props: Props): TextButton
	local isHovered = Value(false)
	local isPressed = Value(false)

	local state = getState({
		Hovered = isHovered,
		Pressed = isPressed,
	})

	local color = animate(
		Computed(function(use)
			return use(props.Solid) and use(Theme.Colors.Brand) or use(Theme.Colors.Background)
		end),
		state
	)

	local size = props.Size
		or Computed(function(use)
			local text = use(props.Text)
			local size = getTextSize(text)

			return UDim2.fromOffset(size.X + 22, Theme.CompSizeY.Large)
		end)

	-- Solid buttons carry the Polaris gradient instead of a flat fill
	local gradientColor = Computed(function(use)
		return ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, use(Theme.Colors.BrandCyan)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, use(Theme.Colors.BrandViolet)),
		})
	end)

	local gradientEnabled = Computed(function(use)
		return use(props.Solid) and true or false
	end)

	return Hydrate(New "TextButton" {
		Text = "Button",
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Regular,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		TextSize = Theme.TextSize.Large,
		Size = size,
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		TextColor3 = Computed(function(use)
			return use(props.Solid) and use(Theme.Colors.TextBranded) or use(Theme.Colors.Text)
		end),
		[OnEvent "InputBegan"] = function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
				isHovered:set(true)
			elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				isPressed:set(true)
			end
		end,
		[OnEvent "InputEnded"] = function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
				isHovered:set(false)
			elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				isPressed:set(false)
			end
		end,
		[OnEvent "Activated"] = function()
			if props.Activated then
				props.Activated()
			end
		end,
		[Children] = {
			Border {},
			New "UIGradient" {
				Enabled = gradientEnabled,
				Rotation = 12,
				Color = gradientColor,
			},
		},
	})(stripProps(props, COMPONENT_ONLY_PROPS))
end

local App = Polaris.App

local Theme = require(App.Theme)

local Spring = Fusion.Spring
local Computed = Fusion.Computed

return function(
	goal: Fusion.StateObject<Color3>,
	state: Fusion.Computed<Enum.GuiState>,
	speed: Fusion.CanBeState<number>?,
	damping: Fusion.CanBeState<number>?
): Fusion.Spring<Color3>
	return Spring(
		Computed(function(use)

			local state = use(state)

			local isDark = use(Theme.IsDark)

				return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v * (isDark and 1.3 or 0.9))
			elseif state == Enum.GuiState.Press then
				return Color3.fromHSV(h, s, v * (isDark and 1.5 or 0.8))
			else
				return goal
			end
		end),
		speed or Theme.SpringSpeed,
		damping or Theme.SpringDamping
	)
end

local Fusion = require(Polaris.Packages.Fusion)

local Computed = Fusion.Computed

type Input = {
	Pressed: Fusion.StateObject<boolean>?,
	Hovered: Fusion.StateObject<boolean>?,
}

return function(input: Input): Fusion.Computed<Enum.GuiState>
	local isPressed = input.Pressed
	local isHovered = input.Hovered

	return Computed(function(use)
		if use(isPressed) then
			return Enum.GuiState.Press
		elseif use(isHovered) then
			return Enum.GuiState.Hover
		else
			return Enum.GuiState.Idle
		end
	end)
end

--!nocheck
-- Reusable Style L creature rig builder for Roblox Studio.
-- Creates anchored stud-style Parts/WedgeParts joined with Weld and Motor6D (never WeldConstraint).

local RigBuilder = {}

function RigBuilder.validate(model: Model): (boolean, { string })
	local issues: { string } = {}
	if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
		table.insert(issues, "Expected a Model instance")
		return false, issues
	end
	if not model.PrimaryPart then
		table.insert(issues, model.Name .. ": PrimaryPart is missing")
	end

	local partCount = 0
	for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			partCount += 1
		elseif d:IsA("WeldConstraint") then
			table.insert(issues, model.Name .. ": WeldConstraint found (" .. d:GetFullName() .. "); use Weld instead")
		end
	end

	if partCount == 0 then
		table.insert(issues, model.Name .. ": Model has no BaseParts")
	else
		local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
		local minY = cf.Y - size.Y * 0.5
		if math.abs(minY) >= 0.05 then
			table.insert(issues, string.format("%s: feet must touch Y = 0 (minY = %.3f)", model.Name, minY))
		end
	end

	local pivotPos = model:GetPivot().Position
	if pivotPos.Magnitude >= 1e-3 then
		table.insert(
			issues,
			string.format(
				"%s: pivot must sit at origin (got %.3f, %.3f, %.3f)",
				model.Name,
				pivotPos.X,
				pivotPos.Y,
				pivotPos.Z
			)
		)
	end

	return #issues == 0, issues
end

function RigBuilder.new(name: string, parentFolder: Instance?)
	local rig = Instance.new("Model")
	rig.Name = name
	local B = {}

	local function makePart(
		className: "Part" | "WedgePart",
		partName: string,
		size: Vector3,
		cf: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		studs: boolean?,
		mat: Enum.Material?,
		transparency: number?
	): BasePart
		local p = Instance.new(className) :: BasePart
		p.Name = partName
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cf
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat or (if studs then Enum.Material.Plastic else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		p.TopSurface = if studs then Enum.SurfaceType.Studs else Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.FrontSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.BackSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.LeftSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.RightSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		if transparency ~= nil and transparency > 0 then
			p.Transparency = transparency
		end
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CastShadow = partName == "Body"
		p.Parent = rig
		return p
	end

	function B.blk(
		partName: string,
		size: Vector3,
		cf: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		studs: boolean?,
		mat: Enum.Material?,
		transparency: number?
	): Part
		return makePart("Part", partName, size, cf, color, studs, mat, transparency) :: Part
	end

	function B.wedge(
		partName: string,
		size: Vector3,
		cf: CFrame,
		color: Color3,
		studs: boolean?,
		mat: Enum.Material?,
		transparency: number?
	): WedgePart
		return makePart("WedgePart", partName, size, cf, color, studs, mat, transparency) :: WedgePart
	end

	-- Weld (not WeldConstraint: those break when cloned and scaled with ScaleTo).
	function B.weld(parent: BasePart, child: BasePart)
		local w = Instance.new("Weld")
		w.Name = "RigWeld"
		w.Part0 = parent
		w.Part1 = child
		w.C0 = parent.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(child.CFrame)
		w.Parent = parent
	end

	-- Articulated Motor6D turning about world-space `pivot`.
	function B.motor(jointName: string, p0: BasePart, p1: BasePart, pivot: Vector3)
		local m = Instance.new("Motor6D")
		m.Name = jointName
		m.Part0 = p0
		m.Part1 = p1
		m.C0 = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(pivot))
		m.C1 = p1.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(pivot))
		m.Parent = p0
	end

	function B.finish(body: BasePart): Model
		rig.PrimaryPart = body
		body.PivotOffset = body.CFrame:Inverse()
		if parentFolder then
			local old = parentFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
			if old then
				old:Destroy()
			end
			rig.Parent = parentFolder
		end
		return rig
	end

	function B.validate(): (boolean, { string })
		return RigBuilder.validate(rig)
	end

	return B
end

return RigBuilder

local PLUGIN_VERSION = require("./src/Version")
local DEFAULT_PORT = 47318
local CODE_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ23456789"

-- Only the edit data model talks to the broker.
if not RunService:IsEdit() then
	return
end

local function newPairingCode(): string
	-- GUIDs are the only unpredictable source available to plugins.
	local hex = string.gsub(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), "[^%x]", "")
	local code = ""
	for i = 1, 20, 2 do
		local byte = tonumber(string.sub(hex, i, i + 1), 16) :: number
		local index = byte % #CODE_ALPHABET + 1
		code ..= string.sub(CODE_ALPHABET, index, index)
	end
	return code
end

local toolbar = plugin:CreateToolbar("Keywright")
local button = toolbar:CreateButton("Keywright", "Show the Keywright panel", "")
local widget = plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGuiAsync(
	"KeywrightPanel",
	DockWidgetPluginGuiInfo.new(Enum.InitialDockState.Right, false, false, 300, 240, 200, 120)
)
widget.Title = "Keywright"
button.Click:Connect(function()
	widget.Enabled = not widget.Enabled
end)

local view = Panel.new(widget)
view.setStatus(Panel.describe("stopped"))

-- A test build carries one more module, which makes chosen edits fail on purpose so that
-- what Studio does then can be checked. The plugin as released has no such module. A
-- session from a test build says so in its version, and so does the panel.
local store: Settings.Store = {
	get = function(key: string): any
		return plugin:GetSetting(key)
	end,
	set = function(key: string, value: any)
		plugin:SetSetting(key, value)
	end,
	wait = function(seconds: number)
		task.wait(seconds)
	end,
	decode = function(text: string): any
		return HttpService:JSONDecode(text)
	end,
	encode = function(value: any): string
		return HttpService:JSONEncode(value)
	end,
}
local version = PLUGIN_VERSION
local fault = script.Parent:FindFirstChild("Fault")
if fault and fault:IsA("ModuleScript") then
	local Fault = require(fault) :: any
	Fault.install(Edit, Recording)
	store = Fault.settings(store)
	version ..= "+fault"
	view.addNotice("Test build: some edits fail on purpose.")
end
view.setVersion(`v{version}`)
local settings = Settings.new(store)

local sessionId = string.lower((string.gsub(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), "[^%x]", "")))
local methods, _, panel = Handlers.create()

local connection: any = nil

-- The id of a credential the broker said it no longer knows. That refusal comes before the
-- broker has proved itself, so anything holding the port could send it. So the stored
-- credential is kept, and only this session pairs again; a new pairing replaces it.
local refused: string? = nil

local function start()
	local port = settings.read(Settings.PORT)
	local stored = settings.credential()
	local credential = if stored and stored.id ~= refused then stored else nil
	local code = if credential then nil else newPairingCode()
	view.setPairing(code)
	view.setNote("")
	connection = Connection.start({
		port = if type(port) == "number" then port else DEFAULT_PORT,
		session = {
			id = sessionId,
			placeName = game.Name,
			placeId = game.PlaceId,
			pluginVersion = version,
		},
		credential = credential,
		pairingCode = code,
		onRequest = Handlers.dispatcher(methods),
		onCancel = function(reason: string)
			Preview.cancel(reason)
		end,
		onState = function(state, detail)
			local text: string, tone: Panel.Tone = Panel.describe(state, detail)
			view.setStatus(text, tone)
		end,
		onCredential = function(newCredential)
			view.setPairing(nil)
			if newCredential then
				-- The connection now uses this one: a later refusal is of this one.
				credential = newCredential
				if not settings.saveCredential(newCredential) then
					view.setNote("Paired for this session, but the credential could not be saved.")
				end
			else
				refused = if credential then credential.id else refused
				view.setNote("Pairing is needed again. Turn agent access off and on to get a new code.")
			end
		end,
	})
end

-- A proposed replacement of a clip: shown on the panel, and settled only there. The oldest
-- one waiting is shown; the rest wait their turn. Below it, a line stays to say what was
-- last decided.
local shown: string? = nil
local stopped: string? = nil

local function showProposals()
	local waiting = Proposals.pending()
	local first = waiting[1]
	shown = if first then first.clipId else nil
	if first then
		local more = if #waiting > 1 then ` ({#waiting - 1} more waiting)` else ""
		local note = if stopped then `\n{stopped}` else ""
		view.setProposal(
			`It would replace the clip "{first.source}" with its working copy "{first.name}". Nothing is replaced unless you choose it.{more}{note}`
		)
		-- A person has to see it to settle it.
		widget.Enabled = true
	else
		view.setProposal(nil)
	end
end
local stopProposals = Proposals.subscribe(function()
	stopped = nil
	showProposals()
end)
-- What became of the proposal just decided, in words that stay on the panel.
local function report(clipId: string)
	local settled = Proposals.get(clipId)
	if not settled or settled.status == "pending" then
		return
	end
	view.setOutcome(
		if settled.status == "approved"
			then `Replaced the clip "{settled.source}" with "{settled.name}". Undo (Ctrl+Z) puts it back.`
			elseif settled.reason == Handlers.REJECTED_IN_STUDIO then `Kept the clip "{settled.source}" as it is.`
			else `The clip "{settled.source}" was not replaced: {settled.reason or "the proposal no longer applied."}`
	)
end
view.approve.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local deciding = shown
	if deciding then
		stopped = panel.decide(deciding, true)
		report(deciding)
		showProposals()
	end
end)
view.reject.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local deciding = shown
	if deciding then
		panel.decide(deciding, false)
		report(deciding)
	end
end)

-- Whether access is on is remembered for this place, so that reloading the plugin or
-- reopening the place does not turn it off. A place that has never been saved to Roblox
-- cannot be told from any other such place, so for it access is off every time.
local function remember(on: boolean)
	if settings.rememberAccess(game.PlaceId, on) then
		return
	end
	if on then
		view.setNote("Agent access is on, but could not be remembered for this place.")
	else
		-- Access is off for now either way. Not saying so would let it come back unseen.
		view.setNote(
			"Agent access is off, but Studio did not save that, so it may turn on again the next time this place opens. Turn it on and off again to retry."
		)
	end
end

view.toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if connection then
		connection.stop()
		connection = nil
		-- A preview in progress gives up its screenshot.
		Preview.cancel("agent access was turned off")
		view.setPairing(nil)
		view.setNote("")
		view.setAccess(false)
		remember(false)
	else
		view.setAccess(true)
		start()
		remember(true)
	end
end)

if settings.accessOn(game.PlaceId) then
	-- A person turned access on for this place earlier and has not turned it off.
	view.setAccess(true)
	start()
end

plugin.Unloading:Connect(function()
	stopProposals()
	view.destroy()
	-- An undo recording still open now would never be finished, and Studio would refuse
	-- every later one.
	pcall(Recording.abandon)
	if connection then
		connection.stop()
	end
	-- A preview interrupted by the unload must not leave its clone in the place.
	Preview.sweep()
end)

--!strict
-- Cmos.lua -- MC146818 RTC and the PC's battery-backed CMOS RAM.
--
-- The clock starts at 2026-01-01 12:00:00 (Thursday) and advances one second
-- per 1,193,182 emulated Machine.run steps, i.e. one second per PIT input
-- count. Time never comes from the host. Date rollover uses the real month
-- lengths and Gregorian leap years. Time/date/alarm registers are formatted
-- from status B (BCD/binary, 12/24-hour) and may be written by the guest.
--
-- Status A rate bits select the periodic interrupt rate from the 32.768 kHz
-- divider. The divider bits are stored but the emulated time base is always
-- 32.768 kHz (the PC board's crystal). Status C PF/AF/UF are set by events and
-- IRQF is asserted when the matching status B enable is set; reading status C
-- clears all four. The update-in-progress bit is asserted for the last 244 us
-- of each second.

const band, bor, bnot, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bnot, bit32.rshift

const Cmos = {}
Cmos.__index = Cmos

const PIT_INPUT_HZ = 1193182
const RTC_INPUT_HZ = 32768
const UIP_STEPS = 291 -- 244 us at the 1.193182 MHz PIT input

const STATUS_B_24H = 0x02
const STATUS_B_DM = 0x04
const STATUS_B_UIE = 0x10
const STATUS_B_AIE = 0x20
const STATUS_B_PIE = 0x40
const STATUS_B_SET = 0x80
const STATUS_C_UF = 0x10
const STATUS_C_AF = 0x20
const STATUS_C_PF = 0x40
const STATUS_C_IRQF = 0x80
const ENABLE_MASK = bor(STATUS_B_UIE, STATUS_B_AIE, STATUS_B_PIE)
const ALARM_IGNORE = 0xC0

export type RtcState = {
	regA: number,
	regB: number,
	regC: number,
	regD: number,
	period: number,
	phase: number,
	clockTicks: number,
	second: number,
	minute: number,
	hour: number,
	dayOfWeek: number,
	day: number,
	month: number,
	year: number,
	century: number,
	alarmSecond: number,
	alarmMinute: number,
	alarmHour: number,
}

export type DiskGeometry = { cylinders: number, heads: number, sectors: number }

export type Config = {
	memorySize: number?,
	floppyType: number?,
	-- Primary-channel ATA disks (index 1 = master, 2 = slave). Their presence
	-- and geometry go in the AT fixed-disk bytes: 0x12 type nibbles (0xF =
	-- extended type in 0x19/0x1A), type 47 user parameters at 0x1B/0x24, the
	-- same layout QEMU writes. Win9x's ESDI_506 only claims a disk on a legacy
	-- (non-PCI) controller when CMOS lists it.
	hardDisks: { DiskGeometry? }?,
	-- Initial RTC date/time (default 2026-01-01 12:00). Win9x verifies
	-- Authenticode signatures against this clock; its 1999-era Microsoft
	-- certificates have long expired, so an era-appropriate date avoids the
	-- "Java Package Manager ... 800B010B" and DllRegisterServer failures that
	-- a real machine with today's date also gets.
	rtcDate: { year: number, month: number, day: number, hour: number?, minute: number? }?,
}

export type Cmos = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		index: number,
		nmiMasked: boolean,
		fixedDisk: { [number]: number },
		memorySize: number,
		floppyType: number,
		ram: { [number]: number },
		shutdown: number,
		rtc: RtcState,
		stepsPerSecond: number,
		uipSteps: number,
		lastReadIndex: number,
		lastReadValue: number,
		readCount: number,
		trace: { string },
		in8: (self: Cmos, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Cmos, port: number, value: number) -> boolean,
		advance: (self: Cmos, steps: number) -> boolean,
		advanceSeconds: (self: Cmos, seconds: number) -> boolean,
		irqPending: (self: Cmos) -> boolean,
		setShutdown: (self: Cmos, value: number) -> (),
	},
	Cmos
))

local function toBcd(value: number): number
	return band(math.floor(value / 10), 0x0F) * 16 + value % 10
end

local function fromBcd(value: number): number?
	const high = band(rshift(value, 4), 0x0F)
	const low = band(value, 0x0F)
	if high > 9 or low > 9 then
		return nil
	end
	return high * 10 + low
end

local function isLeapYear(year: number): boolean
	return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 ~= 0 or year % 400 == 0)
end

const MONTH_DAYS = { 31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31 }

local function daysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number
	if month == 2 and isLeapYear(year) then
		return 29
	end
	return MONTH_DAYS[month] or 31
end

local function rtcPeriod(regA: number): number
	const rate = band(regA, 0x0F)
	if rate == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	const frequency = rshift(RTC_INPUT_HZ, rate - 1)
	if frequency == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(1, math.floor(PIT_INPUT_HZ / frequency + 0.5))
end

local function newRtcState(): RtcState
	const regA = 0x26
	return {
		regA = regA,
		regB = 0x02,
		regC = 0,
		regD = 0x80,
		period = rtcPeriod(regA),
		phase = 0,
		clockTicks = 0,
		second = 0,
		minute = 0,
		hour = 12,
		dayOfWeek = 5, -- 2026-01-01 is a Thursday (Sunday = 1)
		day = 1,
		month = 1,
		year = 26,
		century = 20,
		alarmSecond = 0,
		alarmMinute = 0,
		alarmHour = 0,
	}
end

local function formatValue(self: Cmos, value: number): number
	if band(self.rtc.regB, STATUS_B_DM) ~= 0 then
		return band(value, 0xFF)
	end
	return toBcd(value)
end

local function formatHour(self: Cmos): number
	const rtc = self.rtc
	const binary = band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_DM) ~= 0
	if band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_24H) ~= 0 then
		return if binary then rtc.hour else toBcd(rtc.hour)
	end
	const pm = rtc.hour >= 12
	local hour12 = rtc.hour % 12
	if hour12 == 0 then
		hour12 = 12
	end
	const value = if binary then hour12 else toBcd(hour12)
	return if pm then bor(value, 0x80) else value
end

local function statusA(self: Cmos): number
	const rtc = self.rtc
	local value = band(rtc.regA, 0x7F)
	if
		band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_SET) == 0
		and rtc.clockTicks >= self.stepsPerSecond - self.uipSteps
	then
		value = bor(value, 0x80)
	end
	return value
end

local function alarmFieldMatches(raw: number, current: number, bcd: boolean): boolean
	if band(raw, ALARM_IGNORE) == ALARM_IGNORE then
		return true
	end
	const value = if bcd then fromBcd(band(raw, 0x3F)) else band(raw, 0x3F)
	return value == current
end

local function alarmHourMatches(rtc: RtcState): boolean
	const raw = rtc.alarmHour
	if band(raw, ALARM_IGNORE) == ALARM_IGNORE then
		return true
	end
	const bcd = band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_DM) == 0
	if band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_24H) ~= 0 then
		const value = if bcd then fromBcd(band(raw, 0x7F)) else band(raw, 0x7F)
		return value == rtc.hour
	end
	const pm = band(raw, 0x80) ~= 0
	const hour12 = if bcd then fromBcd(band(raw, 0x7F)) else band(raw, 0x7F)
	if hour12 == nil or hour12 < 1 or hour12 > 12 then
		return false
	end
	local hour = hour12 % 12
	if pm then
		hour += 12
	end
	return hour == rtc.hour
end

local function alarmMatches(self: Cmos): boolean
	const rtc = self.rtc
	const bcd = band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_DM) == 0
	return alarmFieldMatches(rtc.alarmSecond, rtc.second, bcd)
		and alarmFieldMatches(rtc.alarmMinute, rtc.minute, bcd)
		and alarmHourMatches(rtc)
end

local function advanceDay(self: Cmos)
	const rtc = self.rtc
	rtc.dayOfWeek = (rtc.dayOfWeek % 7) + 1
	if rtc.month < 1 or rtc.month > 12 then
		rtc.month = 1
	end
	if rtc.day < 1 then
		rtc.day = 1
	end
	rtc.day += 1
	const fullYear = rtc.century * 100 + rtc.year
	if rtc.day > daysInMonth(fullYear, rtc.month) then
		rtc.day = 1
		rtc.month += 1
		if rtc.month > 12 then
			rtc.month = 1
			rtc.year += 1
			if rtc.year > 99 then
				rtc.year = 0
				rtc.century = (rtc.century + 1) % 100
			end
		end
	end
end

local function recordUpdate(self: Cmos, events: number): boolean
	const rtc = self.rtc
	const before = rtc.regC
	const newEvents = band(events, bnot(before))
	rtc.regC = bor(before, events)
	if band(newEvents, band(rtc.regB, ENABLE_MASK)) ~= 0 and band(before, STATUS_C_IRQF) == 0 then
		rtc.regC = bor(rtc.regC, STATUS_C_IRQF)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function stepSecond(self: Cmos): boolean
	const rtc = self.rtc
	rtc.second += 1
	if rtc.second >= 60 then
		rtc.second = 0
		rtc.minute += 1
		if rtc.minute >= 60 then
			rtc.minute = 0
			rtc.hour += 1
			if rtc.hour >= 24 then
				rtc.hour = 0
				advanceDay(self)
			end
		end
	end
	local events = STATUS_C_UF
	if alarmMatches(self) then
		events = bor(events, STATUS_C_AF)
	end
	return recordUpdate(self, events)
end

local function advanceWholeSeconds(self: Cmos, seconds: number): boolean
	local remaining = math.floor(seconds)
	if remaining <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local irq = false
	if remaining >= 86400 then
		const days = math.floor(remaining / 86400)
		remaining = remaining % 86400
		for _ = 1, days do
			advanceDay(self)
		end
		local events = STATUS_C_UF
		if alarmMatches(self) then
			events = bor(events, STATUS_C_AF)
		end
		irq = recordUpdate(self, events)
	end
	for _ = 1, remaining do
		if stepSecond(self) then
			irq = true
		end
	end
	return irq
end

local function readStatusC(self: Cmos): number
	const value = self.rtc.regC
	self.rtc.regC = 0
	return value
end

local function decodeField(self: Cmos, value: number, low: number, high: number): number?
	const raw = band(value, 0xFF)
	const decoded = if band(self.rtc.regB, STATUS_B_DM) ~= 0 then raw else fromBcd(raw)
	if decoded == nil or decoded < low or decoded > high then
		return nil
	end
	return decoded
end

local function writeHour(self: Cmos, value: number)
	const rtc = self.rtc
	const bcd = band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_DM) == 0
	if band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_24H) ~= 0 then
		const hour = if bcd then fromBcd(band(value, 0x7F)) else band(value, 0x7F)
		if hour ~= nil and hour <= 23 then
			rtc.hour = hour
		end
		return
	end
	const pm = band(value, 0x80) ~= 0
	const hour12 = if bcd then fromBcd(band(value, 0x7F)) else band(value, 0x7F)
	if hour12 == nil or hour12 < 1 or hour12 > 12 then
		return
	end
	local hour = hour12 % 12
	if pm then
		hour += 12
	end
	rtc.hour = hour
end

local function syncIrq(self: Cmos): boolean
	const rtc = self.rtc
	const was = band(rtc.regC, STATUS_C_IRQF) ~= 0
	if band(rtc.regC, band(rtc.regB, ENABLE_MASK)) ~= 0 then
		rtc.regC = bor(rtc.regC, STATUS_C_IRQF)
	else
		rtc.regC = band(rtc.regC, bnot(STATUS_C_IRQF))
	end
	return not was and band(rtc.regC, STATUS_C_IRQF) ~= 0
end

local function writeRegister(self: Cmos, index: number, value: number): boolean
	const rtc = self.rtc
	if index == 0x0A then
		const oldRate = band(rtc.regA, 0x0F)
		rtc.regA = band(value, 0x7F) -- UIP is read-only
		rtc.period = rtcPeriod(rtc.regA)
		if band(rtc.regA, 0x0F) ~= oldRate or rtc.period == 0 then
			rtc.phase = 0
		end
		return false
	elseif index == 0x0B then
		const wasSet = band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_SET) ~= 0
		const wasPie = band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_PIE) ~= 0
		rtc.regB = band(value, 0xFF)
		if (band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_SET) ~= 0) ~= wasSet then
			rtc.clockTicks = 0
		end
		if (band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_PIE) ~= 0) ~= wasPie then
			rtc.phase = 0
		end
		return syncIrq(self)
	elseif index == 0x0C or index == 0x0D then
		return false
	elseif index == 0x00 then
		const decoded = decodeField(self, value, 0, 59)
		if decoded then
			rtc.second = decoded
		end
		return false
	elseif index == 0x01 then
		rtc.alarmSecond = band(value, 0xFF)
		return false
	elseif index == 0x02 then
		const decoded = decodeField(self, value, 0, 59)
		if decoded then
			rtc.minute = decoded
		end
		return false
	elseif index == 0x03 then
		rtc.alarmMinute = band(value, 0xFF)
		return false
	elseif index == 0x04 then
		writeHour(self, value)
		return false
	elseif index == 0x05 then
		rtc.alarmHour = band(value, 0xFF)
		return false
	elseif index == 0x06 then
		const decoded = decodeField(self, value, 1, 7)
		if decoded then
			rtc.dayOfWeek = decoded
		end
		return false
	elseif index == 0x07 then
		const decoded = decodeField(self, value, 1, 31)
		if decoded then
			rtc.day = decoded
		end
		return false
	elseif index == 0x08 then
		const decoded = decodeField(self, value, 1, 12)
		if decoded then
			rtc.month = decoded
		end
		return false
	elseif index == 0x09 then
		const decoded = decodeField(self, value, 0, 99)
		if decoded then
			rtc.year = decoded
		end
		return false
	elseif index == 0x32 then
		const decoded = decodeField(self, value, 0, 99)
		if decoded then
			rtc.century = decoded
		end
		return false
	end
	self.ram[index] = band(value, 0xFF)
	return false
end

local function extendedKB(self: Cmos): number
	return math.min(0xFFFF, math.floor((self.memorySize - 0x100000) / 1024))
end

local function readRegister(self: Cmos, index: number): number
	const rtc = self.rtc
	if index == 0x00 then
		return formatValue(self, rtc.second)
	elseif index == 0x01 then
		return band(rtc.alarmSecond, 0xFF)
	elseif index == 0x02 then
		return formatValue(self, rtc.minute)
	elseif index == 0x03 then
		return band(rtc.alarmMinute, 0xFF)
	elseif index == 0x04 then
		return formatHour(self)
	elseif index == 0x05 then
		return band(rtc.alarmHour, 0xFF)
	elseif index == 0x06 then
		return formatValue(self, rtc.dayOfWeek)
	elseif index == 0x07 then
		return formatValue(self, rtc.day)
	elseif index == 0x08 then
		return formatValue(self, rtc.month)
	elseif index == 0x09 then
		return formatValue(self, rtc.year)
	elseif index == 0x0A then
		return statusA(self)
	elseif index == 0x0B then
		return rtc.regB
	elseif index == 0x0C then
		return readStatusC(self)
	elseif index == 0x0D then
		return rtc.regD
	elseif index == 0x0E then
		return 0x00
	elseif index == 0x0F then
		return self.shutdown
	elseif index == 0x10 then
		return self.floppyType -- high nibble drive A, low nibble drive B
	elseif index >= 0x10 and index <= 0x2F and self.fixedDisk[index] ~= nil then
		return self.fixedDisk[index]
	elseif index == 0x14 then
		return 0x02 -- FPU present, no equipment bits
	elseif index == 0x15 or index == 0x16 then
		return if index == 0x15 then 0x80 else 0x02 -- 640 KiB base memory
	elseif index == 0x17 or index == 0x18 then
		const kb = extendedKB(self)
		return if index == 0x17 then band(kb, 0xFF) else band(rshift(kb, 8), 0xFF)
	elseif index == 0x30 or index == 0x31 then
		const kb = extendedKB(self)
		return if index == 0x30 then band(kb, 0xFF) else band(rshift(kb, 8), 0xFF)
	elseif index == 0x32 then
		return formatValue(self, rtc.century)
	elseif index == 0x34 or index == 0x35 then
		return 0x00
	end
	return self.ram[index] or 0x00
end

-- Day of week for the RTC (Sunday = 1), Zeller-style.
local function dayOfWeek(year: number, month: number, day: number): number
	local y, m = year, month
	if m < 3 then
		m += 12
		y -= 1
	end
	const k = y % 100
	const j = math.floor(y / 100)
	const h = (
		day
		+ math.floor(13 * (m + 1) / 5)
		+ k
		+ math.floor(k / 4)
		+ math.floor(j / 4)
		+ 5 * j
	) % 7
	-- h: 0 = Saturday .. 6 = Friday; convert to Sunday = 1.
	return (h + 6) % 7 + 1
end

-- Set the RTC calendar (full year, e.g. 1999).
function Cmos.setDate(
	self: Cmos,
	year: number,
	month: number,
	day: number,
	hour: number?,
	minute: number?
)
	const rtc = self.rtc
	rtc.century = math.floor(year / 100)
	rtc.year = year % 100
	rtc.month = month
	rtc.day = day
	rtc.dayOfWeek = dayOfWeek(year, month, day)
	rtc.hour = hour or 12
	rtc.minute = minute or 0
	rtc.second = 0
end

function Cmos.new(config: Config?): Cmos
	const cfg = (config or {}) :: Config
	local self = setmetatable({}, Cmos) :: any
	self.index = 0
	self.nmiMasked = false
	self.memorySize = cfg.memorySize or (16 * 1024 * 1024)
	self.floppyType = cfg.floppyType or 0
	self.ram = {}
	self.shutdown = 0
	self.rtc = newRtcState()
	self.stepsPerSecond = PIT_INPUT_HZ
	self.uipSteps = UIP_STEPS
	self.lastReadIndex = 0
	self.lastReadValue = 0
	self.readCount = 0
	self.trace = {}
	-- SeaBIOS reads the QEMU boot-order words from CMOS 0x38/0x3D before it
	-- looks at fw_cfg bootorder. Nibbles low-to-high are boot priority 101..:
	-- 3 = CD, 2 = HD, 1 = floppy. This puts the ATAPI CD first and stops the
	-- always-present floppy fallback from winning the first attempt.
	self.ram[0x38] = 0x10
	self.ram[0x3D] = 0x23
	if cfg.rtcDate then
		const d = cfg.rtcDate
		Cmos.setDate(self, d.year, d.month, d.day, d.hour, d.minute)
	end
	self.fixedDisk = {}
	const disks = cfg.hardDisks or {}
	local types = 0
	for unit = 1, 2 do
		const geo = disks[unit]
		if geo then
			types = bor(types, if unit == 1 then 0xF0 else 0x0F)
			self.fixedDisk[0x18 + unit] = 47 -- 0x19 / 0x1A: user-defined type
			const base = if unit == 1 then 0x1B else 0x24
			const cyl = math.min(geo.cylinders, 0xFFFF)
			self.fixedDisk[base] = band(cyl, 0xFF)
			self.fixedDisk[base + 1] = band(rshift(cyl, 8), 0xFF)
			self.fixedDisk[base + 2] = band(geo.heads, 0xFF)
			self.fixedDisk[base + 3] = 0xFF -- write precompensation: none
			self.fixedDisk[base + 4] = 0xFF
			self.fixedDisk[base + 5] = bor(0xC0, if geo.heads > 8 then 0x08 else 0) -- control byte
			self.fixedDisk[base + 6] = band(cyl, 0xFF) -- landing zone
			self.fixedDisk[base + 7] = band(rshift(cyl, 8), 0xFF)
			self.fixedDisk[base + 8] = band(geo.sectors, 0xFF)
		end
	end
	if types ~= 0 then
		self.fixedDisk[0x12] = types
		-- Standard CMOS checksum over 0x10-0x2D (big-endian at 0x2E/0x2F).
		local sum = 0
		for index = 0x10, 0x2D do
			sum += readRegister(self, index)
		end
		self.fixedDisk[0x2E] = band(rshift(sum, 8), 0xFF)
		self.fixedDisk[0x2F] = band(sum, 0xFF)
	end
	return self
end

function Cmos.out8(self: Cmos, port: number, value: number): boolean
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	if port == 0x70 then
		self.index = band(value, 0x7F)
		self.nmiMasked = band(value, 0x80) ~= 0
		return false
	end
	if port == 0x71 then
		if #self.trace < 40 then
			self.trace[#self.trace + 1] = ("W%02X=%02X"):format(self.index, value)
		end
		if self.index == 0x0F then
			self.shutdown = value
			return false
		end
		return writeRegister(self, self.index, value)
	end
	return false
end

function Cmos.in8(self: Cmos, port: number): number
	if port == 0x70 then
		return self.index
	elseif port == 0x71 then
		const value = readRegister(self, self.index)
		self.lastReadIndex = self.index
		self.lastReadValue = value
		self.readCount += 1
		if #self.trace < 40 then
			self.trace[#self.trace + 1] = ("R%02X=%02X"):format(self.index, value)
		end
		return value
	end
	return 0xFF
end

-- Advance the clock and periodic divider by `steps` emulated PIT input counts.
-- Returns true only when a newly asserted status C flag toggles IRQF from 0 to
-- 1, so Machine raises IRQ8 exactly once per interrupt edge.
function Cmos.advance(self: Cmos, steps: number): boolean
	const wholeSteps = math.floor(steps)
	if wholeSteps <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	const rtc = self.rtc
	if band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_SET) ~= 0 then
		rtc.clockTicks = 0
		rtc.phase = 0
		return false
	end
	local irq = false
	if rtc.period > 0 and band(rtc.regB, STATUS_B_PIE) ~= 0 then
		const total = rtc.phase + wholeSteps
		if total >= rtc.period then
			rtc.phase = total % rtc.period
			irq = recordUpdate(self, STATUS_C_PF) or irq
		else
			rtc.phase = total
		end
	else
		rtc.phase = 0
	end
	const total = rtc.clockTicks + wholeSteps
	if total >= self.stepsPerSecond then
		const seconds = math.floor(total / self.stepsPerSecond)
		rtc.clockTicks = total % self.stepsPerSecond
		irq = advanceWholeSeconds(self, seconds) or irq
	else
		rtc.clockTicks = total
	end
	return irq
end

-- Advance exactly whole calendar seconds. Intended for tests, host time
-- injection and callers that do not need sub-second RTC phase. Resets the
-- sub-second counter so the next `advance` starts a fresh second.
function Cmos.advanceSeconds(self: Cmos, seconds: number): boolean
	const whole = math.floor(seconds)
	self.rtc.clockTicks = 0
	if whole <= 0 or band(self.rtc.regB, STATUS_B_SET) ~= 0 then
		return false
	end
	return advanceWholeSeconds(self, whole)
end

function Cmos.irqPending(self: Cmos): boolean
	return band(self.rtc.regC, STATUS_C_IRQF) ~= 0
end

function Cmos.setShutdown(self: Cmos, value: number)
	self.shutdown = band(value, 0xFF)
end

return Cmos

--!strict
-- Test build only. Makes an edit go wrong partway through, so that what Studio does with
-- a cancelled or abandoned undo recording can be checked in a throwaway place. The
-- plugin as released does not contain this module.
--
-- Which fault happens is chosen by the name of the working copy being edited. In each
-- case the first operation of the batch is applied and the fault comes before the second:
--
--   "Fault fail"       the batch raises an error, so its recording is cancelled.
--   "Fault stall"      the batch never finishes, so its recording stays open until the
--                      plugin unloads and cancels it.
--   "Fault stall raw"  as above, but the plugin does not cancel it on unload either, to
--                      show what Studio does with a recording nobody finishes.
--   "Fault invalid"    keyframe clips only: the batch finishes, but with a second keyframe
--                      at the time of the first, a structural error no operation can make,
--                      so that a save can be seen to be refused.
--
-- Edits to a working copy with any other name behave as usual.
--
-- Settings can fail too. While the place has anything named "Fault settings" directly in
-- Workspace, every write to the plugin's settings is dropped without an error, as Studio
-- may do when several windows write at once. Reads still work.

local Fault = {}

Fault.FAIL = "Fault fail"
Fault.STALL = "Fault stall"
Fault.STALL_RAW = "Fault stall raw"
Fault.INVALID = "Fault invalid"
Fault.SETTINGS = "Fault settings"

-- `stall` suspends the calling thread for good; a test passes its own.
function Fault.install(Edit: any, Recording: any, stall: (() -> ())?)
	local suspend: () -> () = stall or coroutine.yield
	Edit.fault = function(working: any, index: number)
		if index ~= 2 then
			return
		end
		local name = working.instance.Name
		if name == Fault.FAIL then
			error("test build: this batch fails on purpose after its first operation", 0)
		elseif name == Fault.STALL then
			suspend()
		elseif name == Fault.STALL_RAW then
			Recording.abandon = function(): boolean
				return false
			end
			suspend()
		elseif name == Fault.INVALID then
			for _, child in working.instance:GetChildren() do
				if child:IsA("Keyframe") then
					child:Clone().Parent = working.instance
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Wraps the plugin's settings store. `active` says whether writes are dropped now; a test
-- passes its own.
function Fault.settings(store: any, active: (() -> boolean)?): any
	local dropping: () -> boolean = active
		or function(): boolean
			return workspace:FindFirstChild(Fault.SETTINGS) ~= nil
		end
	local wrapped = table.clone(store)
	wrapped.set = function(key: string, value: any)
		if not dropping() then
			store.set(key, value)
		end
	end
	return wrapped
end

return Fault

--!strict
-- Cpu.lua -- 8086/286/386/486 integer core (bit32 only, no native bitwise ops).
-- r[1..8] = AX CX DX BX SP BP SI DI; SP is r[5]; 8-bit reg i<4 low / i>=4 high.
-- rHi[1..8] holds bits 16-31 on the 386/486 path. EIP is kept in `ip` as a full
-- 32-bit value; 16-bit code masks it to 64 KiB on every fetch.

const band, bor, bxor, bnot, lshift, rshift =
	bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.bxor, bit32.bnot, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const CF, PF, AF, ZF, SF, TF, IFF, DFF, OFLG = 1, 4, 16, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048
const RF = 0x10000
const VM = 0x20000
const NT = 0x4000
const AC = 0x40000
const ALWAYS = 2
const FLAGMASK = 4053 -- CF|PF|AF|ZF|SF|TF|IF|DF|OF (0xFD5)
const FLAGMASK_386 = bor(FLAGMASK, 0x7000, RF, VM, AC) -- 386: IOPL/NT/RF/VM/AC
const FIXEDFLAGS = bor(0xF000, ALWAYS) -- bits 15-12 plus bit 1 read as 1 on 8086
const FIXEDFLAGS_286 = ALWAYS -- 286 real mode: bits 12-15 read as 0

const CR0_PE = 0x00000001
const CR0_EM = 0x00000004
const CR0_TS = 0x00000008
-- ET reads as 1 on a 486 (and on a 386 with a 387); Win9x checks it to
-- decide whether a 387-class coprocessor exists, else it emulates FPU code.
const CR0_ET = 0x00000010
const CR0_WP = 0x00010000
const CR0_PG = 0x80000000

-- Paging TLB entry layout: bits 1-20 hold the frame (phys>>12 for 4 KiB pages,
-- phys>>22 for 4 MiB pages), bit 0 records that the PTE dirty bit is already
-- set, bit 21/22 cache the R/W and U/S AND of PDE and PTE, bit 23 marks 4 MiB
-- entries, bit 24 the PDE PAT bit the reserved-bit fault checks, bits 25-31
-- the epoch that turns a full flush into an increment.
const TLB_D = 1
const TLB_FRAME = lshift(0xFFFFF, 1)
const TLB_FRAME_4M = lshift(0x3FF, 1)
const TLB_RW = lshift(1, 21)
const TLB_US = lshift(1, 22)
const TLB_4M = lshift(1, 23)
const TLB_PAT = lshift(1, 24)

-- Unique sentinel used to unwind a faulting instruction after #PF delivery.
-- Cpu.step only catches it when paging is enabled; every other error still
-- propagates to the host as an unimplemented-hardware diagnostic.
const ABORT_INSTRUCTION = { kind = "cpu-abort" }

const CPU_8086 = 0
const CPU_286 = 1
const CPU_386 = 2

local function cpuLevelValue(value: any): number
	if type(value) == "number" then
		if value >= 386 then
			return CPU_386
		elseif value >= 286 then
			return CPU_286
		end
		return CPU_8086
	end
	if value == "386" or value == "486" or value == "586" or value == "pentium" then
		return CPU_386
	elseif value == "286" then
		return CPU_286
	end
	return CPU_8086
end

export type ModRM = {
	mod: number,
	reg: number,
	rm: number,
	off: number?,
	addr: number?,
	seg: string?,
	spBase: boolean?, -- memory operand addressed through ESP (SIB base 4)
}

export type Descriptor = {
	base: number,
	limit: number,
	access: number,
	flags: number,
	raw0: number,
	raw2: number,
	raw4: number,
	raw6: number,
}

export type Io = {
	in8: (port: number) -> number,
	out8: (port: number, value: number) -> (),
	in16: ((port: number) -> number)?,
	out16: ((port: number, value: number) -> ())?,
	in32: ((port: number) -> number)?,
	out32: ((port: number, value: number) -> ())?,
}

export type InterruptHandler = (n: number) -> ()

export type Cpu = {
	mem: any,
	io: Io,
	config: any,
	fpu: any?,
	level: number,
	fixedFlags: number,
	flagMask: number,
	r: { number },
	rHi: { number },
	es: number,
	cs: number,
	ss: number,
	ds: number,
	fs: number,
	gs: number,
	-- Cached descriptor state per segment register (real mode: base = sel*16,
	-- limit = FFFF; protected mode: GDT/LDT descriptor fields).
	segBase: { [string]: number },
	segLimit: { [string]: number },
	segAccess: { [string]: number },
	segFlags: { [string]: number },
	segSel: { [string]: number },
	ip: number,
	flags: number,
	cr0: number,
	cr3: number,
	cr: { number },
	dr: { number },
	-- Software paging TLB: one slot per linear page (2^20 entries), allocated
	-- on the first paged walk. pfTrack remembers physical page-directory and
	-- page-table frames so stores into them can invalidate what maps through.
	tlb: { [number]: number }?,
	tlbEpoch: number,
	pfTrack: { [number]: number },
	pfCount: number,
	baseOperand32: boolean,
	baseAddress32: boolean,
	pageFaults: number,
	lastPageFault: { addr: number, errorCode: number, write: boolean, user: boolean }?,
	inPageFault: boolean,
	aborting: boolean,
	inSegFault: boolean?,
	abortToken: any,
	descCache: { [number]: any },
	-- Start of the instruction currently executing (architectural fault EIP) and
	-- the pending fault context used when a #PF or synchronous exception frame
	-- is built.
	opIP: number,
	opSP: number,
	opActive: boolean,
	opCS: number,
	faultIP: number?,
	faultCS: number?,
	tsc: number,
	lastIoStringDest: number,
	lastIoStringCount: number,
	lastIoStringPort: number,
	intCounts: { [number]: number },
	traceEnabled: boolean,
	trace: { string },
	traceIndex: number,
	lastIrq: { [string]: number }?,
	lastIrqTrace: { string }?,
	lastIret: { [string]: number }?,
	lastFarCall: { [string]: number }?,
	lastRetf: { [string]: number }?,
	lastSwInt: { [string]: number }?,
	badCsTrace: { string }?,
	gdtr: { base: number, limit: number },
	idtr: { base: number, limit: number },
	ldtr: number,
	ldtrBase: number,
	ldtrLimit: number,
	tr: number,
	trBase: number,
	trLimit: number,
	tr32: boolean,
	operand32: boolean,
	address32: boolean,
	modrmScratch: ModRM,
	halted: boolean,
	-- One-page code-fetch cache for paged mode: the TLB entry it was filled
	-- from, so any TLB change (flush, epoch bump, dirty/PTE invalidation) misses.
	fetchPage: number,
	fetchPhys: number,
	fetchEntry: number,
	fetchEpoch: number,
	fetchKey: number,
	-- 8086 STI/POPF/IRET interrupt shadow: no hardware IRQ is recognized until
	-- the instruction after the flag change has executed.
	irqDelay: number,
	oseg: number?,
	osegReg: string?,
	rep: number?,
	defaultInts: { [number]: InterruptHandler },
	stubSeg: number?,
	intStubs: { [number]: { seg: number, off: number } },
	tripleFaults: number,
	onTripleFault: ((self: Cpu) -> ())?,
	registerStub: (self: Cpu, n: number, seg: number, off: number) -> (),
	rb: (self: Cpu, i: number) -> number,
	wb: (self: Cpu, i: number, v: number) -> (),
	rr: (self: Cpu, i: number) -> number,
	wr: (self: Cpu, i: number, v: number) -> (),
	rr32: (self: Cpu, i: number) -> number,
	wr32: (self: Cpu, i: number, v: number) -> (),
	ensureSeg: (self: Cpu, reg: string) -> (),
	setPE: (self: Cpu, on: boolean) -> (),
	isProtected: (self: Cpu) -> boolean,
	isV86: (self: Cpu) -> boolean,
	cpl: (self: Cpu) -> number,
	code32: (self: Cpu) -> boolean,
	stack32: (self: Cpu) -> boolean,
	ipMask: (self: Cpu) -> number,
	pagingEnabled: (self: Cpu) -> boolean,
	translatePage: (
		self: Cpu,
		addr: number,
		write: boolean,
		user: boolean,
		fetch: boolean?
	) -> number,
	flushTlb: (self: Cpu) -> (),
	flushTlbPage: (self: Cpu, addr: number) -> (),
	trackPageFrame: (self: Cpu, frame: number, kind: number) -> (),

const PARITY: { [number]: number } = {}
for i = 0, 255 do
	local v, bits = i, 0
	while v > 0 do
		bits += band(v, 1)
		v = rshift(v, 1)
	end
	PARITY[i] = (bits % 2 == 0) and PF or 0
end

local function sign8(v: number): number
	if v >= 0x80 then
		return v - 0x100
	end
	return v
end

local function sign16(v: number): number
	if v >= 0x8000 then
		return v - 0x10000
	end
	return v
end

local function sign32(v: number): number
	if v >= 0x80000000 then
		return v - 0x100000000
	end
	return v
end

-- integer division truncated toward zero (IDIV semantics)
local function truncDiv(n: number, d: number): number
	return (math.modf(n / d))
end

local Cpu = {}
Cpu.__index = Cpu

function Cpu.new(mem: any, io: Io?, config: any?): Cpu
	local self = setmetatable({}, Cpu) :: any
	self.mem = mem
	self.io = io or {
		in8 = function()
			return 0
		end,
		out8 = function() end,
	}
	self.config = config or {}
	self.fpu = self.config.fpu
	self.level = cpuLevelValue(self.config.cpuLevel)
	self.fixedFlags = if self.level >= CPU_286 then FIXEDFLAGS_286 else FIXEDFLAGS
	self.flagMask = if self.level >= CPU_386 then FLAGMASK_386 else FLAGMASK
	self.r = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	self.rHi = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	self.es, self.cs, self.ss, self.ds = 0, 0, 0, 0
	self.fs, self.gs = 0, 0
	self.segBase = { es = 0, cs = 0, ss = 0, ds = 0, fs = 0, gs = 0 }
	self.segLimit = { es = 0xFFFF, cs = 0xFFFF, ss = 0xFFFF, ds = 0xFFFF, fs = 0xFFFF, gs = 0xFFFF }
	self.segAccess = { es = 0x93, cs = 0x9B, ss = 0x93, ds = 0x93, fs = 0x93, gs = 0x93 }
	self.segFlags = { es = 0, cs = 0, ss = 0, ds = 0, fs = 0, gs = 0 }
	self.segSel = { es = 0, cs = 0, ss = 0, ds = 0, fs = 0, gs = 0 }
	self.ip = 0
	self.flags = bor(self.fixedFlags, IFF)
	self.cr0 = if self.fpu then CR0_ET else 0
	self.cr = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	self.dr = { 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	self.gdtr = { base = 0, limit = 0 }
	self.idtr = { base = 0, limit = 0 }
	self.ldtr = 0
	self.ldtrBase = 0
	self.ldtrLimit = 0
	self.tr = 0
	self.trBase = 0
	self.trLimit = 0
	self.tr32 = false
	self.operand32 = false
	self.address32 = false
	self.baseOperand32 = false
	self.baseAddress32 = false
	self.modrmScratch =
		{ mod = 0, reg = 0, rm = 0, off = nil, addr = nil, seg = nil, spBase = false }
	self.halted = false
	self.fetchPage = -1
	self.fetchPhys = 0
	self.fetchEntry = -1
	self.fetchEpoch = -1
	self.fetchKey = -1
	self.irqDelay = 0
	self.oseg = nil
	self.osegReg = nil
	self.rep = nil
	self.cr3 = 0
	self.tlb = nil
	self.tlbEpoch = 1
	self.pfTrack = {}
	self.pfCount = 0
	self.pageFaults = 0
	self.lastPageFault = nil
	self.inPageFault = false
	self.aborting = false
	self.abortToken = ABORT_INSTRUCTION
	self.descCache = {}
	self.opIP = 0
	self.opSP = 0
	self.opActive = false

	self.faultIP = nil

	self.lastIoStringCount = 0
