	if cx == 0 then
		cpu.ip = band(cpu.ip + d, cpu:ipMask())
	end
end

-- I/O privilege for protected mode and V86. Real mode is unrestricted. In
-- protected mode, CPL <= IOPL is sufficient; otherwise the 32-bit TSS I/O
-- permission bitmap decides, with a missing/oversized bitmap denying access.
local function ioAllowed(cpu: any, port: number, width: number): boolean
	if not cpu:isProtected() then
		return true
	end
	const iopl = band(rshift(cpu.flags, 12), 3)
	if cpu:isV86() then
		-- V86 ignores IOPL for IN/OUT: the permission bitmap is always consulted,
		-- which is how the Win9x VMM traps and virtualizes device ports.
	elseif cpu:cpl() <= iopl then
		return true
	end
	if not cpu.tr32 or cpu.trLimit < 0x67 then
		return false
	end
	const mapBase = cpu:read16(cpu.trBase + 0x66, true)
	if mapBase >= cpu.trLimit then
		return false
	end
	for index = 0, width - 1 do
		const currentPort = band(port + index, 0xFFFF)
		const byteOffset = mapBase + rshift(currentPort, 3)
		if byteOffset > cpu.trLimit then
			return false
		end
		const mapByte = cpu:read8(cpu.trBase + byteOffset, true)
		if band(mapByte, lshift(1, band(currentPort, 7))) ~= 0 then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function ioIn(cpu: any, port: number, width: number): number
	if not ioAllowed(cpu, port, width) then
		-- #GP(0) before any transfer; unwind so the instruction (and a REP
		-- loop) does not run on in the handler's context.
		cpu:fault(13, 0)
		cpu.aborting = true
		error(ABORT_INSTRUCTION, 0)
	end
	if width == 4 then
		const read32 = cpu.io.in32 :: ((p: number) -> number)?
		if read32 then
			return read32(port)
		end
		return bor(
			cpu.io.in8(port),
			lshift(cpu.io.in8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF)), 8),
			lshift(cpu.io.in8(band(port + 2, 0xFFFF)), 16),
			lshift(cpu.io.in8(band(port + 3, 0xFFFF)), 24)
		)
	elseif width == 2 then
		const read16 = cpu.io.in16 :: ((p: number) -> number)?
		if read16 then
			return read16(port)
		end
		return bor(cpu.io.in8(port), lshift(cpu.io.in8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF)), 8))
	end
	return cpu.io.in8(port)
end

local function ioOut(cpu: any, port: number, width: number, value: number)
	if not ioAllowed(cpu, port, width) then
		cpu:fault(13, 0)
		cpu.aborting = true
		error(ABORT_INSTRUCTION, 0)
	end
	if width == 4 then
		const write32 = cpu.io.out32 :: ((p: number, v: number) -> ())?
		if write32 then
			write32(port, value)
			return
		end
		cpu.io.out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
		cpu.io.out8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
		cpu.io.out8(band(port + 2, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 16), 0xFF))
		cpu.io.out8(band(port + 3, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 24), 0xFF))
	elseif width == 2 then
		const write16 = cpu.io.out16 :: ((p: number, v: number) -> ())?
		if write16 then
			write16(port, value)
			return
		end
		cpu.io.out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
		cpu.io.out8(band(port + 1, 0xFFFF), band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
	else
		cpu.io.out8(port, band(value, 0xFF))
	end
end

-- Exact 32x32 -> 64 multiply for the 486 MUL/IMUL path (the host is
-- double-precision, so splitting into 16-bit limbs keeps every partial exact).
local function mul32(a: number, b: number): (number, number)
	const a0 = band(a, 0xFFFF)
	const a1 = rshift(a, 16)
	const b0 = band(b, 0xFFFF)
	const b1 = rshift(b, 16)
	const p0 = a0 * b0
	const p1 = a0 * b1
	const p2 = a1 * b0
	const p3 = a1 * b1
	const mid = math.floor(p0 / 0x10000) + band(p1, 0xFFFF) + band(p2, 0xFFFF)
	const lo = band(band(p0, 0xFFFF) + band(mid, 0xFFFF) * 0x10000, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	const hi = band(
		p3 + math.floor(p1 / 0x10000) + math.floor(p2 / 0x10000) + math.floor(mid / 0x10000),
		0xFFFFFFFF
	)
	return lo, hi
end

local function negate64(lo: number, hi: number): (number, number)
	const newLo = band(0 - lo, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	const newHi = band(bnot(hi) + (if newLo == 0 then 1 else 0), 0xFFFFFFFF)
	return newLo, newHi
end

-- Restoring division of a 64-bit unsigned value by a 32-bit divisor. Returns
-- (quotient, remainder); callers check the overflow conditions first.
local function div64by32(hi: number, lo: number, divisor: number): (number, number)
	local remainder = 0
	local quotient = 0
	for bit = 63, 0, -1 do
		const sourceBit = if bit >= 32
			then band(rshift(hi, bit - 32), 1)
			else band(rshift(lo, bit), 1)
		remainder = remainder * 2 + sourceBit
		if remainder >= divisor then
			remainder -= divisor
			quotient = quotient * 2 + 1
		else
			quotient = quotient * 2
		end
	end
	return quotient, remainder
end

local function group3(cpu: any, w: boolean)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const op = e.reg
	const width = if not w then 8 elseif cpu.operand32 then 32 else 16
	const readOperand = function(): number
		if width == 32 then
			return cpu:readRM32(e)
		elseif width == 16 then
			return cpu:readRM16(e)
		end
		return cpu:readRM8(e)
	end
	const writeOperand = function(value: number)
		if width == 32 then
			cpu:writeRM32(e, value)
		elseif width == 16 then
			cpu:writeRM16(e, value)
		else
			cpu:writeRM8(e, value)
		end
	end
	if op == 0 or op == 1 then
		const a = readOperand()
		const b = if width == 32
			then cpu:fetch32()
			elseif width == 16 then cpu:fetch16()
			else cpu:fetch8()
		doALU(cpu, 4, a, b, width)
	elseif op == 2 then
		writeOperand(
			band(
				bnot(readOperand()),
				if width == 32 then 0xFFFFFFFF elseif width == 16 then 0xFFFF else 0xFF
			)
		)
	elseif op == 3 then
		writeOperand(doALU(cpu, 5, 0, readOperand(), width))
	elseif op == 4 then
		if width == 32 then
			const lo, hi = mul32(cpu:rr32(0), cpu:readRM32(e))
			cpu:wr32(0, lo)
			cpu:wr32(2, hi)
			cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), hi ~= 0)
		elseif width == 16 then
			const prod = cpu:rr(0) * cpu:readRM16(e)
			cpu:wr(0, band(prod, 0xFFFF))
			cpu:wr(2, band(rshift(prod, 16), 0xFFFF))
			cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), prod > 0xFFFF)
		else
			const prod = cpu:rb(0) * cpu:readRM8(e)
			cpu:wr(0, band(prod, 0xFFFF))
			cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), prod > 0xFF)
		end
	elseif op == 5 then
		if width == 32 then
			const a = sign32(cpu:rr32(0))
			const b = sign32(cpu:readRM32(e))
			const negative = (a < 0) ~= (b < 0)
			local lo, hi = mul32(math.abs(a), math.abs(b))
			if negative then
				lo, hi = negate64(lo, hi)
			end
			cpu:wr32(0, lo)
			cpu:wr32(2, hi)
			const signExt = if band(lo, 0x80000000) ~= 0 then 0xFFFFFFFF else 0
			cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), hi ~= signExt)
		elseif width == 16 then
			const prod = sign16(cpu:rr(0)) * sign16(cpu:readRM16(e))
			cpu:wr(0, band(prod, 0xFFFF))
			cpu:wr(2, band(truncDiv(prod, 0x10000), 0xFFFF))
			cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), prod < -0x8000 or prod > 0x7FFF)
		else
			const prod = sign8(cpu:rb(0)) * sign8(cpu:readRM8(e))
			cpu:wr(0, band(prod, 0xFFFF))
			cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), prod < -0x80 or prod > 0x7F)
		end
	elseif op == 6 then
		if width == 32 then
			const dv = cpu:readRM32(e)
			const hi = cpu:rr32(2)
			const lo = cpu:rr32(0)
			if dv == 0 or hi >= dv then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			const q, rem = div64by32(hi, lo, dv)
			cpu:wr32(0, q)
			cpu:wr32(2, rem)
		elseif width == 16 then
			const dv = cpu:readRM16(e)
			const n = bor(lshift(cpu:rr(2), 16), cpu:rr(0))
			if dv == 0 or n >= lshift(dv, 16) then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			cpu:wr(0, math.floor(n / dv))
			cpu:wr(2, n % dv)
		else
			const dv = cpu:readRM8(e)
			const n = cpu:rr(0)
			if dv == 0 or n >= lshift(dv, 8) then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			cpu:wb(0, math.floor(n / dv))
			cpu:wb(4, n % dv)
		end
	else
		if width == 32 then
			const dvSigned = sign32(cpu:readRM32(e))
			if dvSigned == 0 then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			const nHi = cpu:rr32(2)
			const nLo = cpu:rr32(0)
			const negativeN = band(nHi, 0x80000000) ~= 0
			const negativeD = dvSigned < 0
			local magLo, magHi = nLo, nHi
			if negativeN then
				magLo, magHi = negate64(nLo, nHi)
			end
			const magDiv = math.abs(dvSigned)
			if magHi >= magDiv then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			local q, rem = div64by32(magHi, magLo, magDiv)
			const negativeQ = negativeN ~= negativeD
			if negativeQ then
				if q > 0x80000000 then
					cpu:fault(0)
					return
				end
				q = band(0 - q, 0xFFFFFFFF)
				if rem ~= 0 then
					rem = band(0 - rem, 0xFFFFFFFF)
				end
			elseif q > 0x7FFFFFFF then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			cpu:wr32(0, q)
			cpu:wr32(2, rem)
		elseif width == 16 then
			const dv = sign16(cpu:readRM16(e))
			if dv == 0 then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			const n = sign32(bor(lshift(cpu:rr(2), 16), cpu:rr(0)))
			const q = truncDiv(n, dv)
			const r = n - q * dv
			if q < -0x8000 or q > 0x7FFF then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			cpu:wr(0, band(q, 0xFFFF))
			cpu:wr(2, band(r, 0xFFFF))
		else
			const dv = sign8(cpu:readRM8(e))
			if dv == 0 then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			const n = sign16(cpu:rr(0))
			const q = truncDiv(n, dv)
			const r = n - q * dv
			if q < -0x80 or q > 0x7F then
				cpu:fault(0)
				return
			end
			cpu:wb(0, band(q, 0xFF))
			cpu:wb(4, band(r, 0xFF))
		end
	end
end
H[0xF6] = function(cpu: any)
	group3(cpu, false)
end
H[0xF7] = function(cpu: any)
	group3(cpu, true)
end

H[0xF8] = function(cpu: any)

H[0xF9] = function(cpu: any)

-- An undefined encoding raises #UD. In protected mode and V86 it is delivered
-- through the IDT, where the guest decides what to do (the Win9x VMM reflects it
-- to the VM or terminates the offending program). In real mode an undefined
-- opcode is almost always a slide into data, so keep the loud error there.
local function invalidOpcode(cpu: any, message: string)
	if band(cpu.cr0, 1) ~= 0 then
		cpu:fault(6, nil)
		return
	end
	error(message)
end

H[0xFE] = function(cpu: any)
	local e = cpu:modrm()
	local cf = cpu:getF(CF)
	local res
	if e.reg == 0 then
		res = doALU(cpu, 0, cpu:readRM8(e), 1, false)
	elseif e.reg == 1 then
		res = doALU(cpu, 5, cpu:readRM8(e), 1, false)
	else
		-- FE /2-7 are undefined: #UD in protected mode/V86 (see invalidOpcode).
		invalidOpcode(cpu, ("bad FE /%d at %04X:%04X"):format(e.reg, cpu.cs, cpu.ip - 2))
		return
	end
	cpu:writeRM8(e, res)
	cpu:setbits(CF, cf)
end
H[0xFF] = function(cpu: any)
	local e = cpu:modrm()
	local reg = e.reg
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 4 else 2
	if reg == 0 or reg == 1 then
		const cf = cpu:getF(CF)
		const res = doALU(cpu, reg == 0 and 0 or 5, cpu:readRM(e), 1, if width == 4 then 32 else 16)
		cpu:writeRM(e, res)
		cpu:setbits(CF, cf)
	elseif reg == 2 then
		const target = cpu:readRM(e)
		checkNearTarget(cpu, target)
		if width == 4 then
			cpu:push32(cpu.ip)
		else
			cpu:push16(cpu.ip)
		end
		cpu.ip = target
	elseif reg == 3 then
		const addr = cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, width + 2)
		const ip = if width == 4 then cpu:read32(addr) else cpu:read16(addr)
		const cs = cpu:read16(addr + width)
		cpu:farCall(cs, ip, true)
	elseif reg == 4 then
		const target = cpu:readRM(e)
		checkNearTarget(cpu, target)
		cpu.ip = target
	elseif reg == 5 then
		const addr = cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, width + 2)
		const cs = cpu:read16(addr + width)
		const ip = if width == 4 then cpu:read32(addr) else cpu:read16(addr)
		cpu:farCall(cs, ip, false)
	elseif reg == 6 then
		if width == 4 then
			cpu:push32(cpu:readRM32(e))
		else
			cpu:push16(cpu:readRM16(e))
		end
	else
		invalidOpcode(cpu, ("bad FF /7 at %04X:%04X"):format(cpu.cs, cpu.ip - 2))
	end
end

-- 8086 aliasing: C8/C9 -> RETF imm16/RETF. C0/C1 are *not* 8086 aliases
-- here: 80186+ defines them as shift/rotate r/m,imm8, and Windows 3.0's
-- real-mode drivers emit them (VGA.DRV does `SHR DX,3` = C1 EA 03). Treating
-- C1 as RET pops a saved register as the return address and derails the
-- guest, so implement the 80186 group-2 immediate forms instead.
-- On 286+ C8/C9 are ENTER/LEAVE, so pick at runtime to keep 3.0a identical.
local function enter(cpu: any)
	const size = if cpu.operand32 then cpu:fetch16() else cpu:fetch16()
	const nesting = band(cpu:fetch8(), 0x1F)
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 4 else 2
	const mask = if cpu:stack32() then 0xFFFFFFFF else 0xFFFF
	cpu:pushValue(cpu:rrw(5), width) -- BP
	const frame = cpu:getSP()
	if nesting > 0 then
		local bp = cpu:rrw(5)
		for _ = 1, nesting - 1 do
			bp = band(bp - width, mask)
			const value = if width == 4
				then cpu:read32(cpu:linear("ss", bp, 4))
				else cpu:read16(cpu:linear("ss", bp, 2))
			cpu:pushValue(value, width)
		end
		cpu:pushValue(frame, width)
	end
	cpu:wrw(5, frame)
	cpu:setSP(band(cpu:getSP() - size, mask))
end
local function leave(cpu: any)
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 4 else 2
	cpu:setSP(cpu:rrw(5))
	cpu:wrw(5, cpu:popValue(width))
end
local function jccShort(cpu: any, index: number)
	local d = cpu:fetch8()
	if d >= 0x80 then
		d -= 0x100
	end
	if COND[index + 1](cpu.flags) then
		cpu.ip = band(cpu.ip + d, cpu:ipMask())
	end
end
H[0xC8] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		enter(cpu)
	else
		local n = cpu:fetch16()
		cpu.ip = cpu:pop16()
		cpu.cs = cpu:pop16()
		cpu.r[5] = band(cpu.r[5] + n, 0xFFFF)
	end
end
H[0xC9] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		leave(cpu)
	else
		cpu.ip = cpu:pop16()
		cpu.cs = cpu:pop16()
	end
end

-- 80186+ instructions that collide with the 8086 Jcc aliases at 60-6F.
local function pusha(cpu: any)
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 4 else 2
	const sp = cpu:rrw(4)
	for _, i in ipairs({ 0, 1, 2, 3 }) do
		cpu:pushValue(cpu:rrw(i), width)
	end
	cpu:pushValue(sp, width)
	for _, i in ipairs({ 5, 6, 7 }) do
		cpu:pushValue(cpu:rrw(i), width)
	end
end
local function popa(cpu: any)
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 4 else 2
	for _, i in ipairs({ 7, 6, 5 }) do
		cpu:wrw(i, cpu:popValue(width))
	end
	cpu:popValue(width) -- discard saved SP
	for _, i in ipairs({ 3, 2, 1, 0 }) do
		cpu:wrw(i, cpu:popValue(width))
	end
end
local function bound(cpu: any)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	if e.mod == 3 then
		error("BOUND with register operand")
	end
	const index = sign16(cpu:rr(e.reg))
	const addr = cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, 4)
	const lower = sign16(cpu:read16(addr))
	const upper = sign16(cpu:read16(addr + 2))
	if index < lower or index > upper then
		cpu:fault(5)
	end
end
local function imulImm(cpu: any, wide: boolean)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	if cpu.operand32 then
		const src = sign32(cpu:readRM32(e))
		const imm = if wide then sign32(cpu:fetch32()) else sign8(cpu:fetch8())
		const product = src * imm
		cpu:wr32(e.reg, band(product, 0xFFFFFFFF))
		cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), product < -0x80000000 or product > 0x7FFFFFFF)
		return
	end
	const src = cpu:readRM16(e)
	const imm = if wide then sign16(cpu:fetch16()) else sign8(cpu:fetch8())
	const product = sign16(src) * imm
	cpu:wr(e.reg, band(product, 0xFFFF))
	cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), product < -0x8000 or product > 0x7FFF)
end

H[0x60] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		pusha(cpu)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 0)
	end
end
H[0x61] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		popa(cpu)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 1)
	end
end
H[0x62] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		bound(cpu)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 2)

-- ARPL r/m16, r16: adjust the RPL of a selector. Protected mode only; real mode
-- and V86 raise #UD, which the Win9x VMM uses as a trap marker in ROM.
H[0x63] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level < CPU_286 then
		jccShort(cpu, 3)
		return
	end
	if not cpu:isProtected() or cpu:isV86() then
		cpu:fault(6, nil)
		return
	end
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const dest = cpu:readRM16(e)
	const src = cpu:rr(e.reg)
	if band(dest, 3) < band(src, 3) then
		cpu:writeRM16(e, bor(band(dest, 0xFFFC), band(src, 3)))
		cpu:setbits(ZF, true)
	else
		cpu:setbits(ZF, false)
	end
end
H[0x68] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		if cpu.operand32 then
			cpu:push32(cpu:fetch32())
		else
			cpu:push16(cpu:fetch16())
		end
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 8)
	end
end
H[0x69] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		imulImm(cpu, true)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 9)
	end
end
H[0x6A] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		if cpu.operand32 then
			cpu:push32(band(sign8(cpu:fetch8()), 0xFFFFFFFF))
		else
			cpu:push16(band(sign8(cpu:fetch8()), 0xFFFF))

	end

H[0x6B] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		imulImm(cpu, false)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 11)
	end
end

local function ioString(cpu: any, wide: boolean, input: boolean)
	const size = if wide then (if cpu.operand32 then 4 else 2) else 1
	const delta = if cpu:getF(DFF) then -size else size
	const addrMask = if cpu.address32 then 0xFFFFFFFF else 0xFFFF
	const port = cpu.r[3]
	local count = 1
	if cpu.rep then
		count = if cpu.address32 then cpu:rr32(1) else cpu:rr(1)
		if count == 0 then
			return
		end
	end
	if input and size >= 1 then
		cpu.lastIoStringDest = if cpu.address32 then cpu:rr32(7) else cpu:rr(7)
		cpu.lastIoStringCount = count
		cpu.lastIoStringPort = port
	end
	for _ = 1, count do
		const di = if cpu.address32 then cpu:rr32(7) else cpu:rr(7)
		const si = if cpu.address32 then cpu:rr32(6) else cpu:rr(6)
		if input then
			const dst = cpu:linear("es", di, size)
			if size == 4 then
				cpu:write32(dst, ioIn(cpu, port, 4))
			elseif size == 2 then
				cpu:write16(dst, ioIn(cpu, port, 2))
			else
				cpu:write8(dst, ioIn(cpu, port, 1))
			end
			const next = band(di + delta, addrMask)
			if cpu.address32 then
				cpu:wr32(7, next)
			else
				cpu:wr(7, next)
			end
		else
			const src = cpu:linear(cpu.osegReg or "ds", si, size)
			if size == 4 then
				ioOut(cpu, port, 4, cpu:read32(src))
			elseif size == 2 then
				ioOut(cpu, port, 2, cpu:read16(src))
			else
				ioOut(cpu, port, 1, cpu:read8(src))
			end
			const next = band(si + delta, addrMask)
			if cpu.address32 then
				cpu:wr32(6, next)
			else
				cpu:wr(6, next)
			end
		end
		if cpu.rep then
			if cpu.address32 then
				cpu:wr32(1, band(cpu:rr32(1) - 1, 0xFFFFFFFF))
			else
				cpu:wr(1, band(cpu:rr(1) - 1, 0xFFFF))
			end
		end
	end
end
H[0x6C] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		ioString(cpu, false, true)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 12)
	end
end
H[0x6D] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		ioString(cpu, true, true)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 13)
	end
end
H[0x6E] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		ioString(cpu, false, false)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 14)
	end
end
H[0x6F] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level >= CPU_286 then
		ioString(cpu, true, false)
	else
		jccShort(cpu, 15)
	end
end

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 286/386 protected-mode system instructions (0F xx). Selected only when
-- cpuLevel >= 286; the default 8086 path keeps treating 0F as POP CS.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function loadTable(cpu: any, e: ModRM, which: string)
	if e.mod == 3 then
		error("LGDT/LIDT with register operand")
	end
	const addr = cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, 6)
	const limit = cpu:read16(addr)
	local base
	if cpu.operand32 then
		base = bor(cpu:read16(addr + 2), lshift(cpu:read16(addr + 4), 16))
	else
		base = bor(cpu:read16(addr + 2), lshift(cpu:read8(addr + 4), 16))
	end
	if which == "gdt" then
		cpu.gdtr = { base = base, limit = limit }
	elseif base == 0 and limit == 0 and cpu.idtr.base ~= 0 then
		if cpu.level < CPU_386 then
			-- 286 standard mode uses the zero operand intentionally: IDTR=0/0
			-- makes the following INT3 triple-fault into the BIOS shutdown
			-- handler (protected -> real transition).
			cpu.idtr = { base = 0, limit = 0 }
		else
			-- DOSX's ring-0 dispatcher executes LIDT [DS:0x2A31] with an
			-- uninitialised (all-zero) operand. The intended real-callback table is
			-- the compact 8-entry IDT built at liveBase+0x470. Vector 3 must select
			-- the clear-PE switch helper at 0078:0C63 (the table's default 0053
			-- selector is the PM dispatcher). Keep the live IDT if the compact
			-- signature is absent.
			--
			-- The switch helper runs a second zero LIDT just before clearing PE;
			-- once the compact table is live, keep it (real mode ignores IDTR).
			if cpu.idtr.limit ~= 0x3F then
				const compactBase = cpu.idtr.base + 0x470
				const compactAccess = cpu:read8(compactBase + 3 * 8 + 5)
				const compactType = band(compactAccess, 0x1F)
				if
					compactType == 0x06
					or compactType == 0x07
					or compactType == 0x0E
					or compactType == 0x0F
				then
					const gate = compactBase + 3 * 8
					cpu:write16(gate, 0x0C63) -- real switch helper at 0078:0C63
					cpu:write16(gate + 2, 0x0078)
					cpu:write8(gate + 4, 0)
					cpu:write8(gate + 5, bor(band(compactAccess, 0x60), 0x86))
					cpu:write16(gate + 6, 0)
					cpu.idtr = { base = compactBase, limit = 0x3F }
				end
			end
		end
	else
		cpu.idtr = { base = base, limit = limit }
	end
end

local function storeTable(cpu: any, e: ModRM, which: string)
	if e.mod == 3 then
		error("SGDT/SIDT with register operand")
	end
	const addr = cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, 6)
	const table = if which == "gdt" then cpu.gdtr else cpu.idtr
	cpu:write16(addr, table.limit)
	cpu:write16(addr + 2, band(table.base, 0xFFFF))
	if cpu.operand32 then
		cpu:write16(addr + 4, band(rshift(table.base, 16), 0xFFFF))
	else
		cpu:write8(addr + 4, band(rshift(table.base, 16), 0xFF))
		cpu:write8(addr + 5, 0)
	end
end

local function larLsl(cpu: any, isLar: boolean)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const selector = cpu:readRM16(e)
	const desc = readDescriptor(cpu, selector)
	if not desc then
		-- LAR/LSL report success with ZF=1 and leave the destination untouched;
		-- ZF=0 means the selector/descriptor could not be read.
		cpu:setbits(ZF, false)
		return
	end
	local value
	if isLar then
		-- 16-bit form: access-rights byte in AH, AL=0. 32-bit form also carries
		-- the descriptor flags nibble in bits 16-19 (Intel 386 LAR mask
		-- 00FxFF00).
		value = bor(lshift(desc.access, 8), lshift(band(desc.flags, 0xF0), 16))
	else
		value = desc.limit
	end
	if cpu.operand32 then
		cpu:wr32(e.reg, value)
	else
		cpu:wr(e.reg, band(value, 0xFFFF))
	end
	cpu:setbits(ZF, true)
end

local function movControl(cpu: any, op: number)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	if e.mod ~= 3 then
		error("MOV CR/DR with memory operand")
	end
	if op == 0x20 or op == 0x21 then
		local value: number = 0
		if op == 0x20 then
			if e.reg == 0 then
				value = cpu.cr0
			elseif e.reg == 3 then
				value = cpu.cr3
			else
				value = cpu.cr[e.reg] or 0
			end
		else
			value = cpu.dr[e.reg] or 0
		end
		-- MOV from CRn/DRn always moves the full 32-bit register, with or without 0x66.
		cpu:wr32(e.rm, value :: number)
	else
		-- MOV to CRn/DRn reads the full 32-bit register regardless of operand size
		-- (WIN.COM writes CR0 = 805B0001h from real mode with no 0x66 prefix).
		local value = cpu:rr32(e.rm)
		if op == 0x22 then
			if e.reg == 0 then
				if cpu.fpu then
					value = bor(value, CR0_ET)
				end
				local oldCr0 = cpu.cr0
				cpu.cr0 = value
				cpu.cr[0] = value
				if band(oldCr0, CR0_PG) ~= band(value, CR0_PG) then
					cpu:flushTlb()
				end
			elseif e.reg == 3 then
				cpu.cr3 = value
				cpu.cr[3] = value
				cpu:flushTlb()
			else
				cpu.cr[e.reg] = value
			end
		else
			cpu.dr[e.reg] = value
		end
	end
end

local function movExtend(cpu: any, fromBits: number, signed: boolean)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const raw = if fromBits == 8 then cpu:readRM8(e) else cpu:readRM16(e)
	local value = raw
	if signed then
		value = if fromBits == 8 then sign8(raw) else sign16(raw)
	end
	if cpu.operand32 then
		cpu:wr32(e.reg, band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF))
	else
		cpu:wr(e.reg, band(value, 0xFFFF))
	end
end

local function bitScan(cpu: any, reverse: boolean)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 32 else 16
	const mask = if width == 32 then 0xFFFFFFFF else 0xFFFF
	const value = band(if width == 32 then cpu:readRM32(e) else cpu:readRM16(e), mask)
	if value == 0 then
		cpu:setbits(ZF, true)
		return
	end
	cpu:setbits(ZF, false)
	local index = 0
	if reverse then
		for bit = width - 1, 0, -1 do
			if band(rshift(value, bit), 1) ~= 0 then
				index = bit
				break
			end
		end
	else
		for bit = 0, width - 1 do
			if band(rshift(value, bit), 1) ~= 0 then
				index = bit
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if width == 32 then
		cpu:wr32(e.reg, index)
	else
		cpu:wr(e.reg, index)
	end
end

local function bitTest(cpu: any, operation: number, immediate: boolean?)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 32 else 16
	local op = operation
	local index
	if immediate then -- 0F BA /4../7 r/m,imm8
		op = e.reg - 4
		index = band(cpu:fetch8(), width - 1)
	else
		const raw = if width == 32 then cpu:rr32(e.reg) else cpu:rr(e.reg)
		index = band(raw, width - 1)
		if e.mod ~= 3 then
			-- Register bit offsets reach past the operand: the signed offset
			-- selects the word/dword at off + (offset >> log2 width) * size. The
			-- Win9x VMM sets I/O-permission bits with BTS [bitmap], port.
			const signed = if raw >= 2 ^ (width - 1) then raw - 2 ^ width else raw
			const disp = (signed // width) * (width // 8)
			const mask = if cpu.address32 then 0xFFFFFFFF else 0xFFFF
			e.off = band((e.off :: number) + disp, mask)
		end
	end
	const value = if width == 32 then cpu:readRM32(e) else cpu:readRM16(e)
	const bit = band(rshift(value, index), 1)
	cpu:setbits(CF, bit ~= 0)
	if op == 0 then
		return
	end
	local updated
	if op == 1 then
		updated = bor(value, lshift(1, index))
	elseif op == 2 then
		updated = band(value, bnot(lshift(1, index)))
	else
		updated = bxor(value, lshift(1, index))
	end
	if width == 32 then
		cpu:writeRM32(e, updated)
	else
		cpu:writeRM16(e, band(updated, 0xFFFF))
	end
end

-- 0F B0/B1 CMPXCHG r/m, reg (486+): compare AL/AX/EAX with the r/m operand,
-- set ZF from that compare; on ZF store the source register into r/m, else
-- load r/m into the accumulator. The compare flags come from the ALU.
local function cmpXchg(cpu: any, width: number)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	local acc, dest
	if width == 8 then
		acc = cpu:rb(0)
		dest = cpu:readRM8(e)
		doALU(cpu, 7, acc, dest, 8)
	elseif cpu.operand32 then
		acc = cpu:rr32(0)
		dest = cpu:readRM32(e)
		doALU(cpu, 7, acc, dest, 32)
	else
		acc = cpu:rr(0)
		dest = cpu:readRM16(e)
		doALU(cpu, 7, acc, dest, 16)
	end
	if cpu:getF(ZF) then
		if width == 8 then
			cpu:writeRM8(e, cpu:rb(e.reg))
		elseif cpu.operand32 then
			cpu:writeRM32(e, cpu:rr32(e.reg))
		else
			cpu:writeRM16(e, cpu:rr(e.reg))
		end
	else
		if width == 8 then
			cpu:wb(0, dest)
		elseif cpu.operand32 then
			cpu:wr32(0, dest)
		else
			cpu:wr(0, dest)
		end
	end
end

local H0F: { [number]: (cpu: any) -> () } = {}

-- 00: SLDT/STR/LLDT/LTR/VERR/VERW
H0F[0x00] = function(cpu: any)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	if e.reg == 0 then
		cpu:writeRM16(e, cpu.ldtr)
	elseif e.reg == 1 then
		cpu:writeRM16(e, cpu.tr)
	elseif e.reg == 2 or e.reg == 3 then
		const selector = cpu:readRM16(e)
		if e.reg == 2 and selector == 0 then
			-- LLDT with a null selector is legal and invalidates LDTR.
			cpu.ldtr = 0
			cpu.ldtrBase = 0
			cpu.ldtrLimit = 0
			return
		end
		const desc = readDescriptor(cpu, selector)
		if not desc then
			cpu:fault(13, band(selector, 0xFFFC))
			return
		end
		if e.reg == 2 then
			cpu.ldtr = selector
			cpu.ldtrBase = desc.base
			cpu.ldtrLimit = desc.limit
		else
			const tssType = band(desc.access, 0x1F)
			if tssType ~= 0x01 and tssType ~= 0x03 and tssType ~= 0x09 and tssType ~= 0x0B then
				error(
					("#GP: LTR selector %04X is not a TSS (access %02X)"):format(
						selector,
						desc.access
					)
				)
			end
			cpu.tr = selector
			cpu.trBase = desc.base
			cpu.trLimit = desc.limit
			cpu.tr32 = tssType == 0x09 or tssType == 0x0B
			-- Mark the TSS busy like LTR does (bit 1 of the type field).
			const addr = if band(selector, 4) ~= 0
				then cpu.ldtrBase + band(selector, 0xFFF8)
				else cpu.gdtr.base + band(selector, 0xFFF8)
			cpu:write8(addr + 5, bor(desc.access, 2))
		end
	elseif e.reg == 4 or e.reg == 5 then
		-- VERR/VERW: set ZF when the selector denotes a readable (reg 4) or
		-- writable data (reg 5) segment reachable at CPL/RPL. These never
		-- fault on the selector; a null/invalid selector just clears ZF.
		const selector = cpu:readRM16(e)
		local ok = false
		if selector ~= 0 then
			const desc = readDescriptor(cpu, selector)
			if desc and band(desc.access, 0x80) ~= 0 and band(desc.access, 0x10) ~= 0 then
				const segType = band(desc.access, 0x0F)
				const dpl = band(rshift(desc.access, 5), 3)
				const cpl = band(cpu.cs, 3)
				const rpl = band(selector, 3)
				const isCode = segType >= 8
				const conforming = isCode and band(segType, 4) ~= 0
				const reachable = if e.reg == 4 and conforming
					then true
					else dpl >= cpl and dpl >= rpl
				if reachable then
					if e.reg == 4 then
						ok = not isCode or band(segType, 2) ~= 0
					else
						ok = not isCode and band(segType, 2) ~= 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
		cpu:setbits(ZF, ok)
	else
		error("bad 0F 00 /" .. e.reg)
	end
end

-- 01: SGDT/SIDT/LGDT/LIDT/SMSW/LMSW/INVLPG
H0F[0x01] = function(cpu: any)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const reg = e.reg
	if reg == 0 then
		storeTable(cpu, e, "gdt")
	elseif reg == 1 then
		storeTable(cpu, e, "idt")
	elseif reg == 2 then
		loadTable(cpu, e, "gdt")
	elseif reg == 3 then
		loadTable(cpu, e, "idt")
	elseif reg == 4 then
		if e.mod == 3 then
			if cpu.operand32 then
				cpu:wr32(e.rm, cpu.cr0)
			else
				cpu:wr(e.rm, band(cpu.cr0, 0xFFFF))
			end
		else
			cpu:write16(cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, 2), band(cpu.cr0, 0xFFFF))
		end
	elseif reg == 6 then
		const value = cpu:readRM16(e)
		-- LMSW loads only PE/MP/EM/TS and cannot clear PE.
		local nextCr0 = bor(band(cpu.cr0, bnot(0x0F)), band(value, 0x0F), band(cpu.cr0, CR0_PE))
		if band(cpu.cr0, CR0_PG) ~= band(nextCr0, CR0_PG) then
			cpu:flushTlb()
		end
		cpu.cr0 = nextCr0
		cpu.cr[0] = nextCr0
	elseif reg == 7 then
		-- INVLPG drops one cached translation. The register form (mod==3) is
		-- #UD on real hardware; keep the old lenient no-op for it.
		if e.mod ~= 3 then
			cpu:flushTlbPage(cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, 1))
		end
	else
		error("bad 0F 01 /" .. reg)
	end
end

H0F[0x02] = function(cpu: any)
	larLsl(cpu, true)
end
H0F[0x03] = function(cpu: any)
	larLsl(cpu, false)
end
H0F[0x06] = function(cpu: any)
	cpu.cr0 = band(cpu.cr0, bnot(CR0_TS))
	cpu.cr[0] = cpu.cr0
end
H0F[0x08] = function() end -- INVD (no caches in this model)
H0F[0x09] = function() end -- WBINVD
H0F[0x20] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level < CPU_386 then
		error("#UD: MOV CR0 requires 386")
	end
	movControl(cpu, 0x20)
end
H0F[0x21] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level < CPU_386 then
		error("#UD: MOV DR requires 386")
	end
	movControl(cpu, 0x21)
end
H0F[0x22] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level < CPU_386 then
		error("#UD: MOV CR0 requires 386")
	end
	movControl(cpu, 0x22)
end
H0F[0x23] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level < CPU_386 then
		error("#UD: MOV DR requires 386")
	end
	movControl(cpu, 0x23)
end

H0F[0xA0] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.operand32 then
		cpu:push32(cpu.fs)
	else
		cpu:push16(cpu.fs)
	end
end
H0F[0xA1] = function(cpu: any)
	cpu:loadSeg("fs", if cpu.operand32 then cpu:pop32() else cpu:pop16())
end
H0F[0xA8] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.operand32 then

H0F[0xA9] = function(cpu: any)
	cpu:loadSeg("gs", if cpu.operand32 then cpu:pop32() else cpu:pop16())

local function loadFarSeg(cpu: any, e: ModRM, reg: string)
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 6 else 4
	const addr = cpu:linear(e.seg :: string, e.off :: number, width)
	if cpu.operand32 then
		cpu:loadSeg(reg, cpu:read16(addr + 4))
		cpu:wr32(e.reg, cpu:read32(addr))
	else
		cpu:loadSeg(reg, cpu:read16(addr + 2))
		cpu:wr(e.reg, cpu:read16(addr))
	end
	if reg == "ss" then
		cpu.irqDelay = 1 -- LSS also inhibits interrupts for one instruction
	end
end
H0F[0xB2] = function(cpu: any)
	loadFarSeg(cpu, cpu:modrm(), "ss")
end
H0F[0xB4] = function(cpu: any)
	loadFarSeg(cpu, cpu:modrm(), "fs")
end
H0F[0xB5] = function(cpu: any)
	loadFarSeg(cpu, cpu:modrm(), "gs")
end

H0F[0xB6] = function(cpu: any)
	movExtend(cpu, 8, false)
end
H0F[0xB7] = function(cpu: any)
	movExtend(cpu, 16, false)

H0F[0xBE] = function(cpu: any)
	movExtend(cpu, 8, true)

H0F[0xBF] = function(cpu: any)
	movExtend(cpu, 16, true)
end
H0F[0xBC] = function(cpu: any)
	bitScan(cpu, false)
end
H0F[0xBD] = function(cpu: any)
	bitScan(cpu, true)
end

for index = 0, 15 do
	H0F[0x80 + index] = function(cpu: any)
		local delta
		if cpu.operand32 then
			delta = sign32(cpu:fetch32())
		else
			delta = sign16(cpu:fetch16())
		end
		if COND[index + 1](cpu.flags) then
			cpu.ip = band(cpu.ip + delta, cpu:ipMask())
		end
	end
	H0F[0x90 + index] = function(cpu: any)
		const e = cpu:modrm()
		cpu:writeRM8(e, if COND[index + 1](cpu.flags) then 1 else 0)
	end
end

H0F[0xA3] = function(cpu: any)
	bitTest(cpu, 0)
end
H0F[0xAB] = function(cpu: any)
	bitTest(cpu, 1)
end
H0F[0xB3] = function(cpu: any)
	bitTest(cpu, 2)
end
H0F[0xBB] = function(cpu: any)
	bitTest(cpu, 3)
end
H0F[0xBA] = function(cpu: any)
	bitTest(cpu, 0, true) -- /4..7 applied inside after decoding modrm
end

-- 0F B0/B1 CMPXCHG r/m, reg (486+).
H0F[0xB0] = function(cpu: any)
	cmpXchg(cpu, 8)
end
H0F[0xB1] = function(cpu: any)
	cmpXchg(cpu, if cpu.operand32 then 32 else 16)
end

-- 0F 18-1F hintable-NOP family (P6+; treated as modrm-consuming no-ops so
-- newer toolchains' multi-byte NOPs run on this 486-class CPU).
for nop = 0x18, 0x1F do
	H0F[nop] = function(cpu: any)
		cpu:modrm()
	end
end

H0F[0x0B] = function(cpu: any): ()
	invalidOpcode(cpu, ("#UD: UD2 at %04X:%08X"):format(cpu.cs, cpu.ip))
end
H0F[0xA2] = function(cpu: any) -- CPUID
	const leaf = cpu:rr32(0)
	if leaf == 0 then
		cpu:wr32(0, 1)
		cpu:wr32(3, 0x756E6547) -- "Genu"
		cpu:wr32(2, 0x49656E69) -- "ineI"
		cpu:wr32(1, 0x6C65746E) -- "ntel"
	elseif leaf == 1 then
		cpu:wr32(0, 0x00000400) -- 486-class signature
		cpu:wr32(3, 0)
		cpu:wr32(1, 0)
		local edx = 0x00000010 -- TSC (RDTSC is implemented)
		if cpu.fpu then
			edx = bor(edx, 0x00000001) -- FPU present
		end
		cpu:wr32(2, edx)
	elseif leaf == 0x80000000 then
		cpu:wr32(0, 0x80000000)
		cpu:wr32(3, 0)
		cpu:wr32(1, 0)
		cpu:wr32(2, 0)
	else
		cpu:wr32(0, 0)
		cpu:wr32(3, 0)
		cpu:wr32(1, 0)
		cpu:wr32(2, 0)
	end
end

H0F[0x31] = function(cpu: any) -- RDTSC (monotonic instruction count)
	cpu:wr32(0, band(cpu.tsc or 0, 0xFFFFFFFF))
	cpu:wr32(2, band(rshift(cpu.tsc or 0, 32), 0xFFFFFFFF))
end

H0F[0xAF] = function(cpu: any) -- IMUL r, r/m
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	if cpu.operand32 then
		const a = sign32(cpu:rr32(e.reg))
		const b = sign32(cpu:readRM32(e))
		const product = a * b
		cpu:wr32(e.reg, band(product, 0xFFFFFFFF))
		cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), product < -0x80000000 or product > 0x7FFFFFFF)
	else
		const a = sign16(cpu:rr(e.reg))
		const b = sign16(cpu:readRM16(e))
		const product = a * b
		cpu:wr(e.reg, band(product, 0xFFFF))
		cpu:setbits(bor(CF, OFLG), product < -0x8000 or product > 0x7FFF)
	end
end

local function doubleShift(cpu: any, left: boolean, immediate: boolean)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const width = if cpu.operand32 then 32 else 16
	const mask = if width == 32 then 0xFFFFFFFF else 0xFFFF
	const bits = width
	const count = if immediate then cpu:fetch8() else band(cpu:rb(1), 0x1F)
	local dest = if width == 32 then cpu:readRM32(e) else cpu:readRM16(e)
	const src = cpu:rrw(e.reg)
	const cnt = band(count, 0x1F)
	if cnt == 0 then
		return
	end
	const old = dest
	const shift = cnt % bits
	if shift == 0 then
		cpu:setbits(CF, band(dest, 1) ~= 0)
		return
	end
	if left then
		dest = band(bor(band(lshift(old, shift), mask), rshift(src, bits - shift)), mask)
		cpu:setbits(CF, band(rshift(old, bits - shift), 1) ~= 0)
	else
		dest = band(bor(rshift(old, shift), lshift(src, bits - shift)), mask)
		cpu:setbits(CF, band(rshift(old, shift - 1), 1) ~= 0)
	end
	if width == 32 then
		cpu:writeRM32(e, dest)
	else
		cpu:writeRM16(e, dest)
	end
	cpu:setSZP(dest, width)
end
H0F[0xA4] = function(cpu: any)
	doubleShift(cpu, true, true)
end
H0F[0xA5] = function(cpu: any)
	doubleShift(cpu, true, false)
end
H0F[0xAC] = function(cpu: any)
	doubleShift(cpu, false, true)
end
H0F[0xAD] = function(cpu: any)
	doubleShift(cpu, false, false)
end

H0F[0xC0] = function(cpu: any)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const a = cpu:readRM8(e)
	const b = cpu:rb(e.reg)
	cpu:writeRM8(e, band(a + b, 0xFF))
	cpu:wb(e.reg, a)
end
H0F[0xC1] = function(cpu: any)
	const e = cpu:modrm()
	const a = cpu:readRM(e)
	const b = cpu:rrw(e.reg)
	cpu:writeRM(e, band(a + b, if cpu.operand32 then 0xFFFFFFFF else 0xFFFF))
	cpu:wrw(e.reg, a)
end

for index = 0, 7 do
	H0F[0xC8 + index] = function(cpu: any)
		const value = cpu:rr32(index)
		cpu:wr32(
			index,
			bor(
				lshift(band(value, 0xFF), 24),
				lshift(band(value, 0xFF00), 8),
				rshift(band(value, 0xFF0000), 8),
				rshift(band(value, 0xFF000000), 24)
			)
		)
	end
end

H[0x0F] = function(cpu: any)
	if cpu.level < CPU_286 then
		if cpu.config.popCS == false then
			error("opcode 0F (POP CS) disabled; reserved for 386 two-byte escape")
		end
		cpu:loadSeg("cs", cpu:pop16())
		return
	end
	const op = cpu:fetch8()
	const h = H0F[op]
	if not h then
		-- Undefined 0F opcodes are #UD. With PE set the IDT may carry a real
		-- handler: DOSX/DPMI hosts deliberately execute invalid opcodes to test
		-- exception delivery (WIN98 SETUP does exactly this at 0367:AF59 with
		-- 0F FF after registering a handler via INT 31h AX=0203 BL=06). Deliver
		-- the exception and let the guest decide. In real mode an undefined
		-- opcode is almost always a slide into data, so keep the loud error.
		if band(cpu.cr0, 1) ~= 0 then
			cpu:fault(6, nil)
			return
		end
		error(
			("unimplemented 0F opcode %02X at %04X:%04X"):format(
				op,
				cpu.cs,
				band(cpu.ip - 2, 0xFFFF)
			)
		)
	end
	h(cpu)
end

-- Real-mode interrupt dispatch. The machine materialises an IVT stub
-- (`int 90h+i; iret`) for every service it emulates so guest code can hook and
-- chain vectors. Two rules keep the emulated handlers' flag results (CF/ZF are
-- how DOS and BIOS report errors) visible to callers:
--   * while a vector still points at our stub, dispatch the Lua handler
--     inline. Pushing the interrupt frame and letting the stub IRET would
--     restore the pre-interrupt flags and silently drop the result bits.
--   * when a guest chains to a saved stub itself (`pushf; call far F100:xxxx`),
--     the stub's IRET pops the frame the guest built; write the handler's flags
--     into that frame, exactly like a real DOS/BIOS ISR does.
function Cpu.interrupt(self: Cpu, n: number, errorCode: number?, software: boolean?)
	self.intCounts[n] = (self.intCounts[n] or 0) + 1
	if band(self.cr0, 1) ~= 0 then
		if self.idtr.limit == 0 then
			-- No usable IDT: #GP -> double fault -> triple fault/reset. DOSX
			-- standard mode triggers this deliberately to switch to real mode.
			self:tripleFault()
			return
		end
		self:pmInterrupt(n, errorCode, software)
		return
	end
	local mem = self.mem
	local base = lshift(n, 2)
	local lo = mem:read16(base)
	local hi = mem:read16(base + 2)
	if self.traceEnabled and software and n == 0x10 then
		const ssBase = self:baseOf("ss")
		const sp = self:getSP()
		self.lastSwInt = {
			cs = self.cs,
			ip = self.ip,
			flags = self.flags,
			ss = self.ss,
			sp = sp,
			s0 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp, 0xFFFF)),
			s1 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 2, 0xFFFF)),
			s2 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 4, 0xFFFF)),
			s3 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 6, 0xFFFF)),
			s4 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 8, 0xFFFF)),
			s5 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 10, 0xFFFF)),
			s6 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 12, 0xFFFF)),
			s7 = mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 14, 0xFFFF)),
		}
	end
	const handler = self.defaultInts[n]
	const stub = self.intStubs[n]
	if handler and stub and lo == stub.off and hi == stub.seg then
		handler(n)
		return
	end
	if lo ~= 0 or hi ~= 0 then
		const returnIP = if software then self.ip else (self.faultIP or self.ip)
		if self.traceEnabled and n == 8 then
			const ssBase = self:baseOf("ss")
			const sp = self:getSP()
			self.lastIrqTrace = self:traceDump(512)
			self.lastIrq = {
				cs = self.cs,
				ip = returnIP,
				flags = self.flags,
				ss = self.ss,
				sp = sp,
				s0 = self.mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp, 0xFFFF)),
				s1 = self.mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 2, 0xFFFF)),
				s2 = self.mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 4, 0xFFFF)),
				s3 = self.mem:read16(ssBase + band(sp + 6, 0xFFFF)),
			}
		end
		self:push16(self.flags)
		self:push16(self.cs)
		self:push16(returnIP)
		self.flags = bor(band(self.flags, bnot(bor(TF, IFF))), ALWAYS)
		self.ip = lo
		self.cs = hi
		self.faultIP = nil
		self.faultCS = nil
		return
	end
	if not handler then
		error(
			("unhandled interrupt %02X (zero IVT entry) at %04X:%04X"):format(n, self.cs, self.ip)
		)
	end
	const chained = self.stubSeg ~= nil and self.cs == self.stubSeg
	handler(n)
	if chained then
		-- frame on entry to the stub: [SP]=return IP, [SP+2]=return CS,
		-- [SP+4]=saved FLAGS (the word the stub's IRET will pop). Propagate
		-- the handler's result bits (CF/ZF) but keep the caller's IF: the
		-- inline dispatch already cleared IF for the INT, and writing that
		-- cleared bit into the frame makes the stub's IRET leave the whole
		-- guest with interrupts disabled. This happens when a guest INT 2Fh
		-- handler jumps into our stub, which then executes its own INT 9Ch.
		const frame = band(self:baseOf("ss") + band(self.r[5] + 4, 0xFFFF), 0xFFFFF)
		const previous = mem:read16(frame)
		mem:write16(frame, bor(band(self.flags, bnot(IFF)), band(previous, IFF)))
	end
end

-- Prefix bytes; any other opcode leaves the prefix loop after one lookup
-- instead of a dozen comparisons.
const IS_PREFIX: { [number]: boolean } = {
	[0x26] = true,
	[0x2E] = true,
	[0x36] = true,
	[0x3E] = true,
	[0x64] = true,
	[0x65] = true,
	[0x66] = true,
	[0x67] = true,
	[0xF0] = true,
	[0xF2] = true,
	[0xF3] = true,
}

function Cpu.executeStep(self: Cpu): number
	if self.halted then
		return 0
	end
	if self.irqDelay > 0 then
		self.irqDelay -= 1
	end
	self.opIP = self.ip
	self.opCS = self.cs
	self.opSP = self.r[5]
	self.opActive = true
	self.faultIP = nil
	self.faultCS = nil
	self.oseg = nil
	self.osegReg = nil
	self.rep = nil
	self.baseOperand32 = self.level >= CPU_386
		and band(self.cr0, CR0_PE) ~= 0
		and band(self.segFlags.cs or 0, 0x40) ~= 0
	self.baseAddress32 = self.baseOperand32
	self.operand32 = self.baseOperand32
	self.address32 = self.baseAddress32
	local op = 0
	while true do
		op = self:fetch8()
		if not IS_PREFIX[op] then
			break
		end
		if op == 0x26 then
			self.oseg, self.osegReg = self.es, "es"
		elseif op == 0x2E then
			self.oseg, self.osegReg = self.cs, "cs"
		elseif op == 0x36 then
			self.oseg, self.osegReg = self.ss, "ss"
		elseif op == 0x3E then
			self.oseg, self.osegReg = self.ds, "ds"
		elseif op == 0x64 and self.level >= CPU_386 then
			self.oseg, self.osegReg = self.fs, "fs"
		elseif op == 0x65 and self.level >= CPU_386 then
			self.oseg, self.osegReg = self.gs, "gs"
		elseif op == 0x66 and self.level >= CPU_386 then
			-- Size-override prefixes select the opposite of the segment's
			-- default and are idempotent: 66 66 is one override, not two
			-- toggles (WIN98's blitter emits 67 67 2E FF A0 for a jump table).
			self.operand32 = not self.baseOperand32
		elseif op == 0x66 and self.level >= CPU_286 then
			self.operand32 = true
		elseif op == 0x67 and self.level >= CPU_386 then
			self.address32 = not self.baseAddress32
		elseif op == 0xF2 then
			self.rep = 2
		elseif op == 0xF3 then
			self.rep = 1
		elseif op == 0xF0 then
			-- LOCK: ignore
		else
			break
		end
	end
	const h = H[op] :: ((cpu: any) -> ())?
	if not h then
		-- #UD through the IDT in protected mode/V86 (same rationale as the 0F
		-- escape: guests register #UD handlers on purpose); loud error in real
		-- mode, where an undefined opcode is usually a slide.
		if band(self.cr0, 1) ~= 0 then
			self:fault(6, nil)
			return 1
		end
		error(
			("unimplemented opcode %02X at %04X:%08X"):format(
				op,
				self.cs,
				band(self.ip - 1, self:ipMask())
			)
		)
	end
	h(self)
	-- Prefix state is cleared at the start of the next instruction; clearing
	-- it here as well only added three stores to every retired instruction.
	self.tsc += 1
	return 1
end

-- Paging faults unwind the faulting instruction after #PF has been delivered.
-- The pcall is only paid while CR0.PG is set; real-mode/PM bring-up stays fast.
function Cpu.step(self: Cpu): number
	if self.traceEnabled then
		self.traceIndex = (self.traceIndex % 4096) + 1
		self.trace[self.traceIndex] = ("%04X:%08X"):format(self.cs, self.ip)
		if self.badCsTrace == nil and self.cs == 0x0202 and self.ip == 0 then
			self.badCsTrace = self:traceDump(40)
		end
	end
	if band(self.cr0, bor(CR0_PG, CR0_PE)) == 0 then
		const steps = (self :: any):executeStep()
		self.opActive = false
		return steps
	end
	-- pcall(f, self) instead of a wrapping closure: no allocation per
	-- instruction while paging is on.
	const ok, result = pcall((self :: any).executeStep, self)
	self.aborting = false
	self.opActive = false
	if not ok then
		if result == ABORT_INSTRUCTION then
			return 1
		end
		error(result, 0)
	end
	return result :: number
end

function Cpu.traceDump(self: Cpu, count: number): { string }
	const out: { string } = {}
	const total = math.min(count, #self.trace)
	for index = total, 1, -1 do
		const slot = ((self.traceIndex - index) % 4096) + 1
		out[#out + 1] = self.trace[slot] or "?"
	end
	return out
end

function Cpu.dump(self: Cpu): { [string]: number }
	return {
		ax = self.r[1],
		cx = self.r[2],
		dx = self.r[3],
		bx = self.r[4],
		sp = self.r[5],
		bp = self.r[6],
		si = self.r[7],
		di = self.r[8],
		cs = self.cs,
		ds = self.ds,
		es = self.es,
		ss = self.ss,
		ip = self.ip,
		flags = self.flags,
	}
end

return Cpu

--!strict
-- Hex and base64 encoding for buffers.

local Codec = {}

local HEX = "0123456789abcdef"
local B64 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

local b64Bytes = table.create(64, 0)
for i = 1, 64 do
	b64Bytes[i] = string.byte(B64, i)
end

function Codec.toHex(data: buffer): string
	local length = buffer.len(data)
	local out = buffer.create(length * 2)
	for i = 0, length - 1 do
		local byte = buffer.readu8(data, i)
		buffer.writeu8(out, i * 2, string.byte(HEX, byte // 16 + 1))
		buffer.writeu8(out, i * 2 + 1, string.byte(HEX, byte % 16 + 1))
	end
	return buffer.tostring(out)
end

function Codec.fromHex(text: string): buffer
	assert(#text % 2 == 0 and string.match(text, "^%x*$") ~= nil, "malformed hex")
	local out = buffer.create(#text // 2)
	for i = 0, #text // 2 - 1 do
		buffer.writeu8(out, i, tonumber(string.sub(text, i * 2 + 1, i * 2 + 2), 16) :: number)
	end
	return out
end

function Codec.toBase64(data: buffer): string
	local length = buffer.len(data)
	local out = buffer.create((length + 2) // 3 * 4)
	local position = 0
	for i = 0, length - 3, 3 do
		local n = buffer.readu8(data, i) * 65536 + buffer.readu8(data, i + 1) * 256 + buffer.readu8(data, i + 2)
		buffer.writeu8(out, position, b64Bytes[n // 262144 + 1])
		buffer.writeu8(out, position + 1, b64Bytes[n // 4096 % 64 + 1])
		buffer.writeu8(out, position + 2, b64Bytes[n // 64 % 64 + 1])
		buffer.writeu8(out, position + 3, b64Bytes[n % 64 + 1])
		position += 4
	end
	local rest = length % 3
	if rest > 0 then
		local i = length - rest
		local n = buffer.readu8(data, i) * 65536
		if rest == 2 then
			n += buffer.readu8(data, i + 1) * 256
		end
		buffer.writeu8(out, position, b64Bytes[n // 262144 + 1])
		buffer.writeu8(out, position + 1, b64Bytes[n // 4096 % 64 + 1])
		buffer.writeu8(out, position + 2, if rest == 2 then b64Bytes[n // 64 % 64 + 1] else 61)
		buffer.writeu8(out, position + 3, 61)
	end
	return buffer.tostring(out)
end

return Codec

--!strict
-- Dma.lua -- two PC/AT 8237 DMA controllers.
--
-- The master controller (channels 4-7) uses the PC/AT word-spaced register
-- window at 0xC0-0xDF; the slave controller (channels 0-3) uses 0x00-0x0F.
-- Page registers are the standard ISA ports. Memory access is injectable so
-- the machine can wire RAM later; an unwired controller reads 0xFF and writes
-- nowhere.

const band, bor, lshift, rshift = bit32.band, bit32.bor, bit32.lshift, bit32.rshift

const CMD_MEMORY_TO_MEMORY = 0x01
const CMD_CH0_ADDRESS_HOLD = 0x02

const MODE_VERIFY = 0
const MODE_WRITE = 1
const MODE_READ = 2
const MODE_ILLEGAL = 3

const PAGE_PORTS: { [number]: number } = {
	[0x87] = 0,
	[0x83] = 1,
	[0x81] = 2,
	[0x82] = 3,
	[0x8B] = 5,
	[0x89] = 6,
	[0x8A] = 7,
}

export type Channel = {
	index: number,
	baseAddress: number,
	currentAddress: number,
	baseCount: number,
	currentCount: number,
	page: number,
	mode: number,
	transferType: number,
	modeType: number,
	autoinit: boolean,
	decrement: boolean,
	terminalCount: boolean,
}

export type Controller = {
	channels: { Channel },
	flipFlop: boolean,
	command: number,
	status: number,
	request: number,
	mask: number,
	master: boolean,
}

export type Config = {
	read8: ((address: number) -> number)?,
	read16: ((address: number) -> number)?,
	write8: ((address: number, value: number) -> ())?,
	write16: ((address: number, value: number) -> ())?,
}

const Dma = {}
Dma.__index = Dma

export type Dma = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		slave: Controller,
		master: Controller,
		pages: { [number]: number },
		read8: (address: number) -> number,
		read16: ((address: number) -> number)?,
		write8: (address: number, value: number) -> (),
		write16: ((address: number, value: number) -> ())?,
		in8: (self: Dma, port: number) -> number,
		out8: (self: Dma, port: number, value: number) -> (),
		reset: (self: Dma) -> (),
		request: (self: Dma, channel: number, asserted: boolean?) -> (),
		isMasked: (self: Dma, channel: number) -> boolean,
		getChannel: (self: Dma, channel: number) -> Channel?,
		read: (self: Dma, channel: number, byteCount: number) -> buffer?,
		write: (self: Dma, channel: number, data: buffer) -> number,
		memoryToMemory: (self: Dma, maxBytes: number?) -> number,
		takeTerminalCount: (self: Dma, channel: number) -> boolean,
		setMemory: (self: Dma, config: Config) -> (),
	},
	Dma
))

local function newChannel(index: number): Channel
	return {
		index = index,
		baseAddress = 0,
		currentAddress = 0,
		baseCount = 0,
		currentCount = 0,
		page = 0,
		mode = 0,
		transferType = MODE_VERIFY,
		modeType = 0,
		autoinit = false,
		decrement = false,
		terminalCount = false,
	}
end

local function newController(master: boolean): Controller
	local channels = {}
	for index = 0, 3 do
		channels[index] = newChannel(index)
	end
	return {
		channels = channels,
		flipFlop = false,
		command = 0,
		status = 0,
		request = 0,
		mask = 0x0F,
		master = master,
	}
end

local function resetController(controller: Controller)
	controller.flipFlop = false
	controller.command = 0
	controller.status = 0
	controller.request = 0
	controller.mask = 0x0F
	for index = 0, 3 do
		const channel = controller.channels[index]
		channel.currentAddress = channel.baseAddress
		channel.currentCount = channel.baseCount
		channel.terminalCount = false
		channel.mode = 0
		channel.transferType = MODE_VERIFY
		channel.modeType = 0
		channel.autoinit = false
		channel.decrement = false
	end
end

local function controllerFor(self: Dma, channel: number): (Controller?, number?)
	if channel < 0 or channel > 7 then
		return nil, nil
	end
	if channel < 4 then
		return self.slave, channel
	end
	return self.master, channel - 4
end

local function physicalAddress(controller: Controller, channel: Channel): number
	local address = bor(lshift(channel.page, 16), channel.currentAddress)
	if controller.master then
		address = lshift(address, 1)
	end
	return band(address, 0xFFFFFF)
end

local function readWord(self: Dma, address: number): number
	if self.read16 then
		return self.read16(address)
	end
	return bor(self.read8(address), lshift(self.read8(address + 1), 8))
end

local function writeWord(self: Dma, address: number, value: number)
	if self.write16 then
		self.write16(address, value)
	else
		self.write8(address, band(value, 0xFF))
		self.write8(address + 1, band(rshift(value, 8), 0xFF))
	end
end

local function setTerminalCount(controller: Controller, channel: Channel, index: number)
	channel.terminalCount = true
	controller.status = bor(controller.status, lshift(1, index))
	if channel.autoinit then
		channel.currentAddress = channel.baseAddress
		channel.currentCount = channel.baseCount
	else
		controller.request = band(controller.request, bit32.bnot(lshift(1, index)))
		channel.currentCount = 0xFFFF
	end
end

local function consumeUnit(channel: Channel)
	channel.currentAddress =
		band(channel.currentAddress + (if channel.decrement then -1 else 1), 0xFFFF)
	if channel.currentCount == 0 then
		return true
	end
	channel.currentCount -= 1
	return false
end

local function canTransfer(controller: Controller, index: number): boolean
	const bit = lshift(1, index)
	return band(controller.mask, bit) == 0 and band(controller.request, bit) ~= 0
end

function Dma.new(config: Config?): Dma
	local self = setmetatable({}, Dma) :: any
	self.slave = newController(false)
	self.master = newController(true)
	self.pages = {}
	for index = 0, 7 do
		self.pages[index] = 0
	end
	self.read8 = function()
		return 0xFF
	end
	self.write8 = function() end
	self.read16 = nil
	self.write16 = nil
	if config then
		self:setMemory(config)
	end
	self:reset()
	return self
end

function Dma.setMemory(self: Dma, config: Config)
	if config.read8 then
		self.read8 = config.read8
	end
	self.read16 = config.read16
	if config.write8 then
		self.write8 = config.write8
	end
	self.write16 = config.write16
end

function Dma.reset(self: Dma)
	for index = 0, 7 do
		self.pages[index] = 0
		const controller, channelIndex = controllerFor(self, index)
		if controller and channelIndex ~= nil then
			controller.channels[channelIndex].page = 0
		end
	end
	resetController(self.slave)
	resetController(self.master)
end

function Dma.getChannel(self: Dma, channel: number): Channel?
	const controller, index = controllerFor(self, channel)
	if not controller or index == nil then
		return nil
	end
	return controller.channels[index]
end

function Dma.isMasked(self: Dma, channel: number): boolean
	const controller, index = controllerFor(self, channel)
	if not controller or index == nil then
		return true
	end
	return band(controller.mask, lshift(1, index)) ~= 0
end

function Dma.request(self: Dma, channel: number, asserted: boolean?)
	const controller, index = controllerFor(self, channel)
	if not controller or index == nil then
		return
	end
	const bit = lshift(1, index)
	const on = if asserted == nil then true else asserted
	if on then
		controller.request = bor(controller.request, bit)
	else
		controller.request = band(controller.request, bit32.bnot(bit))
	end
end

function Dma.takeTerminalCount(self: Dma, channel: number): boolean
	const controller, index = controllerFor(self, channel)
	if not controller or index == nil then
		return false
	end
	const value = controller.channels[index].terminalCount
	controller.channels[index].terminalCount = false
	controller.status = band(controller.status, bit32.bnot(lshift(1, index)))
	return value
end

local function readChannelRegister(controller: Controller, offset: number): number
	const index = rshift(offset, 1)
	if index > 3 then
		return 0xFF
	end
	const channel = controller.channels[index]
	const value = if band(offset, 1) ~= 0 then channel.currentCount else channel.currentAddress
	const result = if controller.flipFlop then rshift(value, 8) else band(value, 0xFF)
	controller.flipFlop = not controller.flipFlop
	return band(result, 0xFF)
end

local function writeChannelRegister(controller: Controller, offset: number, value: number)
	const index = rshift(offset, 1)
	if index > 3 then
		return
	end
	const channel = controller.channels[index]
	const isCount = band(offset, 1) ~= 0
	if not controller.flipFlop then
		if isCount then
			channel.baseCount = band(bor(band(channel.baseCount, 0xFF00), value), 0xFFFF)
		else
			channel.baseAddress = band(bor(band(channel.baseAddress, 0xFF00), value), 0xFFFF)
		end
		controller.flipFlop = true
	else
		if isCount then
			channel.baseCount = bor(band(channel.baseCount, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
			channel.currentCount = channel.baseCount
		else
			channel.baseAddress = bor(band(channel.baseAddress, 0x00FF), lshift(value, 8))
			channel.currentAddress = channel.baseAddress
		end
		controller.flipFlop = false
	end
end

local function writeMode(controller: Controller, value: number)
	const index = band(value, 3)
	const channel = controller.channels[index]
	channel.mode = value
	channel.transferType = band(rshift(value, 2), 3)
	channel.modeType = band(rshift(value, 6), 3)
	channel.autoinit = band(value, 0x10) ~= 0
	channel.decrement = band(value, 0x20) ~= 0
end

local function writeControl(controller: Controller, offset: number, value: number)
	if offset == 8 then
		controller.command = value
	elseif offset == 9 then
		const index = band(value, 3)
		const bit = lshift(1, index)
		if band(value, 4) ~= 0 then
			controller.request = bor(controller.request, bit)
		else
			controller.request = band(controller.request, bit32.bnot(bit))
		end
	elseif offset == 10 then
		const index = band(value, 3)
		const bit = lshift(1, index)
		if band(value, 4) ~= 0 then
			controller.mask = bor(controller.mask, bit)
		else
			controller.mask = band(controller.mask, bit32.bnot(bit))
		end
	elseif offset == 11 then
		writeMode(controller, value)
	elseif offset == 12 then
		controller.flipFlop = false
	elseif offset == 13 then
		resetController(controller)
	elseif offset == 14 then
		controller.mask = 0
	elseif offset == 15 then
		controller.mask = band(value, 0x0F)
	end
end

function Dma.in8(self: Dma, port: number): number
	const pageChannel = PAGE_PORTS[port]
	if pageChannel ~= nil then
		return self.pages[pageChannel]
	end
	local controller: Controller? = nil
	local offset = 0
	if port >= 0x00 and port <= 0x0F then
		controller = self.slave
		offset = port
	elseif port >= 0xC0 and port <= 0xDF then
		controller = self.master
		offset = rshift(port - 0xC0, 1)
	end
	if not controller then
		return 0xFF
	end
	if offset < 8 then
		return readChannelRegister(controller, offset)
	elseif offset == 8 then
		const status = bor(band(controller.status, 0x0F), lshift(controller.request, 4))
		controller.status = band(controller.status, 0xF0)
		return status
	end
	return 0xFF
end

function Dma.out8(self: Dma, port: number, value: number)
	value = band(value, 0xFF)
	const pageChannel = PAGE_PORTS[port]
	if pageChannel ~= nil then
		self.pages[pageChannel] = value
		const pageController, pageIndex = controllerFor(self, pageChannel)
		if pageController and pageIndex ~= nil then
			pageController.channels[pageIndex].page = value
		end
		return
	end
	local controller: Controller? = nil
	local offset = 0
	if port >= 0x00 and port <= 0x0F then
		controller = self.slave
		offset = port
	elseif port >= 0xC0 and port <= 0xDF then
		controller = self.master
		offset = rshift(port - 0xC0, 1)
	end
	if not controller then
		return
	end
	if offset < 8 then
		writeChannelRegister(controller, offset, value)
	else
		writeControl(controller, offset, value)
	end
end

function Dma.read(self: Dma, channel: number, byteCount: number): buffer?
	const controller, index = controllerFor(self, channel)
	if not controller or index == nil or byteCount <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if not canTransfer(controller, index) then
		return nil
	end
	const state = controller.channels[index]
	if state.transferType == MODE_WRITE or state.transferType == MODE_ILLEGAL then
		return nil
	end
	const unitBytes = if controller.master then 2 else 1
	const available = state.currentCount + 1
	const units = math.min(math.floor(byteCount / unitBytes), available)
	if units <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	const data = buffer.create(units * unitBytes)
	local cursor = 0
	for _ = 1, units do
		const address = physicalAddress(controller, state)
		if state.transferType == MODE_READ then
			if controller.master then
				const word = readWord(self, address)
				buffer.writeu8(data, cursor, band(word, 0xFF))
				buffer.writeu8(data, cursor + 1, band(rshift(word, 8), 0xFF))
			else
				buffer.writeu8(data, cursor, band(self.read8(address), 0xFF))
			end
		end
		cursor += unitBytes
		if consumeUnit(state) then
			setTerminalCount(controller, state, index)
		end
	end
	return data
end

function Dma.write(self: Dma, channel: number, data: buffer): number
	const controller, index = controllerFor(self, channel)
	if not controller or index == nil then
		return 0
	end
	if not canTransfer(controller, index) then
		return 0
	end
	const state = controller.channels[index]
	if state.transferType == MODE_READ or state.transferType == MODE_ILLEGAL then
		return 0
	end
	const unitBytes = if controller.master then 2 else 1
	const available = state.currentCount + 1
	const units = math.min(math.floor(buffer.len(data) / unitBytes), available)
	for unit = 0, units - 1 do
		const address = physicalAddress(controller, state)
		if state.transferType == MODE_WRITE then
			if controller.master then
				const offset = unit * 2
				const word =
					bor(buffer.readu8(data, offset), lshift(buffer.readu8(data, offset + 1), 8))
				writeWord(self, address, word)
			else
				self.write8(address, buffer.readu8(data, unit))
			end
		end
		if consumeUnit(state) then
			setTerminalCount(controller, state, index)
		end
	end
	return units * unitBytes
end

function Dma.memoryToMemory(self: Dma, maxBytes: number?): number
	const controller = self.slave
	if band(controller.command, CMD_MEMORY_TO_MEMORY) == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	const source = controller.channels[0]
	const destination = controller.channels[1]
	const available = destination.currentCount + 1
	const units = if maxBytes
		then math.min(available, math.max(0, math.floor(maxBytes)))
		else available
	for _ = 1, units do
		const value = band(self.read8(physicalAddress(controller, source)), 0xFF)
		self.write8(physicalAddress(controller, destination), value)
		if band(controller.command, CMD_CH0_ADDRESS_HOLD) == 0 then
			source.currentAddress =
				band(source.currentAddress + (if source.decrement then -1 else 1), 0xFFFF)
		end
		if consumeUnit(destination) then
			setTerminalCount(controller, destination, 1)
		end
	end
	return units
end

return Dma
